title: Dray Wara Yow Dee
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, an unnamed Pathan horse-dealer, who undertakes a relentless, arduous journey across the North-West Frontier and into British India, driven solely by a consuming desire for vengeance against Daoud Shah. His pursuit of honor, which led him to brutally kill his unfaithful Abazai wife, now manifests as a desperate, years-long hunt where tribal justice clashes with the ever-present British Law. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Paul and Brady Get Hoodoo with the Voodoo
prompt: Write a short story where Paul and Brady, after their chaotic encounter with Voodoo Vicky and his zombie dog Gigi, are now unwilling recruits into the People's Assembly, a secret organization fighting supernatural threats in Wisconsin. Follow their attempts to balance mundane college life at WUSS with their new duties, such as learning how to properly cremate a zombie in Muenster Cemetery under the guidance of the practical D.D. Carmi, all while navigating Brady's sartorial obsessions and Paul's continuing anxiety about his ex-girlfriend Mary Rockenfeffer. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: SWEET THREADS
prompt: Write a short story where Olgrun, a jovial honeywalker who speaks to bees, and his fastidious companion Therbin, a master weaver of magical threads, arrive in a seemingly peaceful village like Scoter. When the townsfolk, and even the two friends, inexplicably turn surly and quarrelsome, Olgrun notices strange purple flowers that bees avoid. Explore how their unique, complementary talents are tested as they work to uncover the source of the strange affliction—a spreading magical "plague"—and restore harmony, all while their own friendship is strained by the very magic they seek to defeat. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Bang-Bang You're Dead
prompt: Write a short story about Sybil, an intellectually detached woman, revisiting her time in a British Colony by watching old home movies with friends, where she recalls the forced performances of her relationships, especially with Désirée and Barry Weston, whose seemingly idyllic marriage hides a profound boredom and a series of literal and metaphorical "shooting affairs," forcing Sybil to confront her own identity and the pervasive falsity around her. Your story must be approximately 10000 words long.

title: 1987, THE RACES
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Andru, a young boy observing his father, David, during their bimonthly trip to Oaklawn racetrack in 1987. Explore the subtle tension between them as David attempts to impress a former model, Therese, and desperately searches for persimmons, revealing his hidden anxieties and the performative nature of their bond. The story should culminate in Andru's quiet act of rebellion, which forces David to confront the fragility of his own carefully constructed world. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Education of a Witch
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Lizzy, an untidy child who feels increasingly displaced after the birth of her baby sister, Rosemary. Follow Lizzy as she clings to her Maleficent puppet, finding solace and validation in the witch's "kind" voice and powerful image, especially as her parents and nursery school teacher, Mrs. Dickens, seem to dismiss her burgeoning magical identity. Explore the unsettling convergence of Lizzy's vivid fantasy world and her burgeoning, inexplicable powers, culminating in an act that suggests her wishful thinking might be manifesting in reality. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: The Tennis Lover
prompt: Write a short story about a rising tennis player who navigates the complex, often teasing relationship with her older partner, the tennis lover. Explore their verbal spars in hotel rooms after matches, as he critiques her performance and future ambitions, all while she strives to prove her worth on the court. The narrative should delve into the subtle power dynamics and the unique blend of "fondness" and challenge that defines their bond, especially as her coach, Alexei, becomes a point of contention. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Third Day Lights
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Naeve, an ancient, shape-shifting demon living in a sentient castle in a scorched desert, where the arrival of a mysterious supplicant named Israphel disrupts her solitary existence. As Israphel presents perplexing tasks and reveals a cosmic mission to retrieve all humanity by consuming other universes, explore Naeve's shifting perspectives—from disdain to a reluctant understanding—as their profound differences in power, purpose, and philosophy converge amidst the glowing maggots and the looming threat to her world. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: WOLF OF HUNGER, WOLF OF SHAME

title: THE FURIES OF ZHAHNOOR
prompt: Write a short story about the Earthman Tawmsin, who crash-lands on the chilly, blue planet Zhahnoor and believes it holds a vast fortune in gold and uranium, visible only to him. The Tolvian observers Doolni, Yarlyamah, and Rholpl, tasked with aiding Earthmen, struggle to understand Tawmsin's increasingly erratic behavior and his interactions with unseen "furies"—faint blue shadows that seem to manifest his deep desires. Explore the clash between Tawmsin's delusions and the Tolvians' pragmatic efforts to humor him, questioning whether his madness is purely internal or influenced by Zhahnoor's strange, invisible inhabitants. title: Australia's Most Famous Ghost

title: The Fight

title: The Forgetting Field

title: The Sign in the Sky
prompt: Write a short story where Mr. Satterthwaite, a fastidious gentleman, is haunted by the "Guilty" verdict in the Martin Wylde murder trial. While dining at the Arlecchino, a chance meeting with the enigmatic Mr. Quin prompts Mr. Satterthwaite to re-examine the case, subtly guiding him to discover the true killer by piecing together overlooked details such as the housemaid Louisa Bullard's unusual testimony about a "sign in the sky" and a peculiar habit of Sir George Barnaby with the clocks at Deering Hill, leading to the dramatic revelation of a hidden truth. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: THE GUN
prompt: Write a short story where Flora Belle Yates, a solitary Black woman who has spent her life adrift and seeking belonging in various cities from Tall Rock to Fresno, finds a profound sense of peace and self-possession not through human connection but through the silent companionship of a gun. Explore how this cold, steel object transforms her perception of freedom and control over her own existence, allowing her to navigate a world that has always made her feel like an outcast. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: My Mother's Head
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator observes their mother's lifelong struggle with invisible pain and sorrow, a sadness that begins in her legs, then leads to increasing forgetfulness and an obsession with recording mundane details. Follow the narrator as she grapples with her own detachment and inherited sadness, leading to a pivotal moment when her mother's physical and emotional decline culminates in a startling, metaphorical declaration during a doctor's visit: her heart has become her head. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Boarded Window
prompt: Write a short story where Murlock, alone in his log cabin in the immense, dark forest, sits vigil beside the body of his recently deceased wife. As he struggles with his overwhelming grief and the unsettling quiet of the frontier night, strange sounds begin to emanate from the darkness, leading to a horrifying revelation near the mysterious boarded window that shatters his perception of loss and the natural world. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Surprise
prompt: Write a short story about Dennis, an unemployed man captivated by LaBelle, the Voodoo Queen, at a traveling carnival. Following Dennis as he abandons his family and old life, driven by an intense desire to be with LaBelle after seeing her mesmerizing performance, explore his growing obsession and the unsettling events that lead to his terrifying transformation into "Dennis the Snake Man," destined to become the newest, grotesque exhibit in the very freak show he once attended. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Fat
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, a waitress, whose life begins to subtly shift after serving an extraordinarily large man on a slow Wednesday night at her restaurant. Explore how the narrator's detailed observations of the fat man's enormous appetite, his gentle demeanor, and the reactions of others around her (Rita, Rudy, Margo) lead to a profound and unexpected internal transformation, making her question her own body and identity, culminating in a strange feeling of personal expansion and a premonition that her life is about to change. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Scaper's Muse
prompt: Write a short story about Gavin Camayo, banished to the alien world of Stahvi, where he navigates strange cultures and an unexpected exile. Years after a mysterious New Year's Eve kiss with a green-eyed stranger, Gavin encounters Lydia Brightlake, a woman who reveals she is the same person, capable of "flickering" her form through Versa bodyscaping. Explore their unique connection as they choose love on Stahvi, culminating in a radical transformation into mirror-image twins. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Good Pasture on the Right
prompt: Write a short story about Jochen, a farmer's son, whose family's livelihood hinges on access to the Kruselin meadow, prompting his father to arrange a marriage with Ella Fingers against Jochen's love for Martha Kleinschmidt. Explore Jochen's internal struggle and quiet despair as he sacrifices his personal desires for the farm's survival, depicting the resigned aftermath of a choice made not from love but from desperate necessity, and the lingering, silent connection to a past he can't fully escape. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Meadowlands Spike
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, who after thirty-five years, insists on confessing the gruesome details of how they murdered James Hoffa, dismembered his body, and buried the pieces under the south end zone of the Meadowlands Stadium. Explore the narrator's desperate need to unburden this terrible secret, even as their erratic claims and past false confessions raise questions about the "gospel truth" they now desperately declare to a skeptical lieutenant, fearing being sent back to the Pines. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Ride In, Ride Out
prompt: Write a short story where Younger Macleish, a contented cowboy enjoying the simple pleasures of a clean hotel and fine dining at Miz Appleton's, is mistaken for a notorious man named Bronzeau. Following a brutal ambush in the town's gaudy saloon, Macleish endures torture and humiliation, only to be released when his captors realize their error. Explore how Macleish, a man who famously "doesn't complain," methodically exacts a precise and memorable retribution on those who wronged him, demonstrating his quiet but formidable capacity for justice before riding out of town. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: FACEBOOK PAST
prompt: Write a short story about the narrator, who late one night finds himself endlessly scrolling Facebook, until he spots a familiar face: Mandy, a girl he knew from a summer holiday many years ago in Millport. Describe the narrator's dive into her online past, fueled by nostalgia and regret for a connection he once dismissed, as he uncovers an old photograph that makes his romanticized memories tangible. Explore the quiet tension that builds as his digital wandering risks colliding with his present reality and the unforeseen complications of revisiting a simpler time. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: Skullpocket
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, a priest of the Church of the Maggot, preparing to perform the death ritual for Jonathan Wormcake, the Gentleman Corpse of Hob's Landing, on the opening night of the Seventieth Annual Skullpocket Fair. The priest confronts the decaying patriarch's suppressed grief for the Orchid Girl and the town's macabre traditions, questioning the Maggot's teachings on memory as the carnival's grotesque culling game for the summoned children begins below the mansion. Your story must be approximately 12000 words long.

title: The Silver Frog
prompt: Write a short story where the tyrannical Mrs Reckitt’s Christmas feast at her Establishment for Orphans is disrupted by an unexpected magical rebellion orchestrated by a Silver Frog. Following Maud and Reginald, unjustly banished to the cold garden, the story should detail how the frogs, with the Croak's sacred image, turn the grand but cruel celebration into chaos, exposing the hypocrisy of the "great and good" of Soot Town and ultimately leading to the liberation of the neglected children from their grim existence of bone soup and straw beds. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: AN AUTHENTICATED VAMPIRE STORY
prompt: Write a short story about an experienced occultist and editor, a friend of the narrator, who investigates the strange phenomena at Castle B—, believed to be haunted by the vampire Countess Elga. Describe the unsettling séances, the moving table spelling out Elga's name, and the inexplicable manifestations surrounding her portrait, which seems to possess a life of its own. Explore the occultist's attempts to understand Elga's power and the blend of spiritualism and gothic horror as he uncovers the truth behind the castle's dark reputation and the mysterious deaths among the peasants. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Three and One Are One
prompt: Write a short story where Barr Lassiter, a Union soldier, returns to his family's homestead near Carthage, Tennessee, two years after leaving amidst bitter wartime division. Explore the profound disillusionment and psychological horror as he encounters his estranged family members in what seems like a cold rejection, only to later discover the devastating truth of their fate and the ruins of his home, forcing a reckoning with the delayed impact of war and the true cost of duty. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: The Pumpkin Eater
prompt: Write a short story following the narrator as she rides the Worldroad, having chosen freedom over a prince's gilded cage. Explore the challenges and quiet joys of a woman defying traditional expectations, accompanied only by her rooster Courage and horse Sugar, as she forges a new identity beyond "princess" or "commoner" and seeks to understand the true nature of love and independence. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Turn Back the Bed
prompt: Write a short story following Ptolemy Proudfoot as he recounts a vivid, chaotic memory of a grand Proudfoot family gathering at Old Ant'ny’s place in the Katy’s Branch valley. Explore how Ptolemy’s boisterous laughter and the wild, unscripted antics of the younger generation, particularly a boy named Lester, converge to create an unforgettable family anecdote, culminating in a surprising display of Old Ant'ny’s quiet, commanding presence. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Journalism in Tennessee
prompt: Write a short story about the unnamed narrator's harrowing first day as associate editor at the _Morning Glory and Johnson County War-Whoop_ in Tennessee, where the Chief Editor's ferociously combative style of journalism incites constant, physical reprisals. The narrator, attempting to write mild news reports, finds himself baffled by the Chief's vitriolic revisions and endures a barrage of violence—from stray bullets and incoming bricks to being thrown from a window and scalped—as the newspaper office becomes a chaotic battlefield of rival editors and enraged citizens. Explore the escalating absurdity and the narrator's desperate struggle to survive the workday. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Rumpole à la Carte
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Horace Rumpole where, after a live mouse is found in a dish at the Michelin-starred La Maison Jean-Pierre, he must defend its eccentric chef, Jean-Pierre O'Higgins, against health code violations. Explore Rumpole’s unique brand of criminal law, his personal struggles with the temporary departure of Hilda and the invasion of Young Radical Lawyers into Froxbury Mansions, all while maintaining his distinctive "character" in a world he views as increasingly absurd and pretentious. Your story must be approximately 13000 words long.

title: Plant Growin' Problems
prompt: Write a short story about Jerry Barlow, a marijuana grower in the dense woods of Bacon County, Georgia, who finds himself ambushed by the corrupt Sheriff Cecil Taylor, a man who not only deals drugs but seeks to steal Jerry's crop. Explore the brutal cat-and-mouse confrontation that unfolds, where Jerry must navigate the treacherous landscape and the sheriff's depravity, culminating in a surprising and violent turn of events involving a diamond-back rattler and a desperate fight for survival. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Under the Friar's Ledge
prompt: Write a short story about Doctor Struggles, a former contract surgeon, who travels into the wild Sierra Madre mountains with Juan Solo, an Indian-Mexican, to find the legendary Sangre del Santo mine. Explore the challenging journey and the escalating dangers they face, including a pursuing American and his armed men, while subtle hints suggest the mine is also guarded by the spirit of Friar Tomas Maria. The narrative should build towards a tense confrontation at the mine's entrance, revealing the true nature of its age-old protection. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Joliette Sound System
prompt: Write a short story about the narrator, a cultural journalist, who is blackmailed into retrieving a subversive video from Phocéa, a reclusive artist who projects films onto the side of a ferry on the Marseille docks. The narrator navigates a chaotic, makeshift village of containers and an abandoned silo d'Arenc, grappling with his mission as the city descends into socio-political turmoil incited by the video's contents, ultimately deciding whether to fulfill his task or escape the escalating violence and the powerful forces at play. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Black Terror
prompt: Write a short story where Elizabeth Aagaard's piercing screams in Christiansted signal a dire crisis: her son, Cornelis McBean, is believed to be cursed by a papaloi to die at noon from a 'sweat-ouanga.' Follow the narrator, Mr. Canevin, as he, along with Father Richardson, confronts this profound fear, questioning the boundaries between superstition and reality in a desperate race against time to save a life from a deeply ingrained West Indian terror. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: A Dog's Tale
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Aileen Mavourneen, a loyal and brave dog, living in the grand house of the Gray family, where her devoted service is met with both tender affection and bewildering human 'reason.' Detail her experiences following an act of heroism, and how her simple, loving understanding attempts to make sense of her scientific master Mr. Gray's inexplicable actions involving her innocent puppy, revealing the tragic irony of her ultimate fate. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Last Feast of Harlequin
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, an anthropologist drawn to the eerie town of Mirocaw and its annual winter festival. The narrator, seeking to understand the festival's unusual clown figures and the town's pervasive green glow, uncovers a deeper, more ancient ritual led by the enigmatic Dr. Raymond Thoss. As the narrator delves into Mirocaw's hidden truths, including the fate of Elizabeth Beadle and the nature of the pale, oval-mouthed creatures in the slums, he faces a horrifying transformation and the chilling realization of his own inescapable connection to Mirocaw's grim traditions. Your story must be approximately 15000 words long.

title: DEATH RIDES THE ELEVATOR
prompt: Write a short story where Sean O'Brien, the capable assistant to the reclusive genius Penelope Peters, must navigate the chaotic aftermath of Cyrus Calhoun's bizarre decapitation inside his private elevator at Manhattan National Trust. The seemingly impossible "locked-room" murder demands Penelope's unparalleled deductive skills, even as her agoraphobia keeps her confined to her study, relying entirely on Sean's detailed observations to unravel a meticulously planned, shocking crime that threatens the bank's reputation. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Sword Brother
prompt: Write a short story where Gunnery Sergeant Kenneth Houghton, a US Marine, and his Light Armored Vehicle "Tough Mama" are inexplicably snatched from a desert battlefield into the magical world of Norfressa, finding himself confronted by an ancient wild wizard, Wencit of Ru–m. Houghton's moral weariness from his own world's complex, asymmetric warfare clashes with Norfressa's overt battle between the forces of Light and Dark, as he is drawn into a desperate fight against powerful demons and black sorcerers who serve malevolent deities like Sharn and Carnadosa, forcing him to confront what it means to fight for unequivocal good. Your story must be approximately 81000 words long.

title: The Man Who Put Up at Gadsby's
prompt: Write a short story where Riley, on a storm-swept Washington D.C. night, encounters the frantic Mr. Lykins, who is desperate to secure the San Francisco postmastership, and deliberately derails his haste with a meandering anecdote. Follow Lykins as he listens, buttonholed, to Riley’s account of the man who put up at Gadsby’s hotel, a man so bent on immediate departure for Tennessee that he spent years incrementally selling his fine carriage, horses, and even his dog, always declaring he was "off tomorrow morning," in an ironic tale of profound procrastination. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Rocket City
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, who visits Rocket City with Marge and their adult son, Dink. Explore the melancholy of a future unfulfilled, where humanity abandoned stellar exploration due to an inhospitable universe and the societal control of "psychotronic perception," leaving only a museum of "turbofire" exhibits and old craft. As Dink spends hours in a retrograde simulator, believing he is flying to Ganymede, the narrator must reconcile their own wistful fascination with this discarded heritage with Marge's dismissal and Dink's profound disorientation after emerging, grappling with a deeply immersive experience that blurs the line between reality and dream. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: Excerpt from Work in Progress
prompt: Write a short story where Abednego experiences the recurring sweats and dreams of Black Jesus and Farmer Thornton's wife, a seductive sickness triggered by the exhumation of his cousin Solomon from the stolen ancestral land. Explore how these visions connect Abednego to the traumatic memories of the Liberation War, the smell of singed flesh, and the profound disillusionment of independence in Rufaro Stadium, where promises of freedom were met with tear gas. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Voyage
prompt: Write a short story following Fenella as she embarks on a mysterious journey aboard the Picton boat with her Grandma, leaving behind her father and a life that has just undergone a profound, unspoken change. The story should capture the precise, almost claustrophobic details of the small cabin and the vastness of the dark, rocking sea, all seen through Fenella's observant eyes, as she holds her Grandma's swan-necked umbrella, navigating an uncertain future marked by quiet grief and the sudden arrival at Grandpa's house with its poignant "LOST!" text. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Two Things, Dimly, Were Going at Each Other
prompt: Write a short story about Coots, an old, morphine-addicted author obsessed with guns and death, who despises the seemingly perfect retired surgeon Latouche. Explore the strange, evolving bond between these two men—one a self-proclaimed monster who shoots dogs and believes in hexes, the other a virtuous nonagenarian afflicted by the bizarre, dog-like "grofft" disease—as their shared love for antique firearms and a peculiar attraction to mortality brings them together in a Manhattan billiards parlor and culminates in a desperate chase through the city to a cemetery. Your story must be approximately 10000 words long.

title: The Cartoonist
prompt: Write a short story where Samuel Stein inherits the demanding role of cartooning the popular "Blubby" comic strip for a bustling newspaper. Working in the cold, cluttered office previously occupied by the mysteriously departed John Allington, Stein faces relentless pressure from editor Fried to maintain the strip’s furious pace and commercial appeal. As he delves into Allington’s forgotten possessions and the endless task of producing new material, Stein begins to question the true cost of artistic success and wonders what truly became of his predecessor. The story should explore the thin line between creative output and personal dissolution, and whether Stein can escape Allington's fate. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: WHAT IS LEFT TO LINK US
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, an urban dweller meticulously adhering to his personal customs, whose detached observations of his friend's marital collapse and the disappearance of his son's Flexible Flyer sled gradually expose a simmering, methodical rage. Explore how his rigid adherence to routine, meant to sustain order, instead leads him to a brutal confrontation with the building's custodian, challenging his own self-perception as a rational, contained man. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: The Ice Beneath Us
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator and Claude are ice fishing on Bent Iron Lake, a year after they murdered Jimbo and sank his body into the frozen water. The familiar cabin feels like a suffocating cage as their old camaraderie dissolves into bitter accusations and creeping paranoia. Outside, the incessant cawing and scratching of a black crow at the window suggests their victim, or something far older, is not yet at rest. Explore how far their shared guilt will push them, and whether the ice beneath them can truly hold their secrets. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: STRAYING
prompt: Write a short story where Didi and her sisters sit on the veranda, reminiscing with laughter and affection about their youthful admirers, including Baldevji and Kanwarlal, and particularly the shy artist Arvind Mukherjee. Explore the stark contrast between Didi's vivacious past, filled with suitors and daring acts, and her current life constrained by the demands and peculiar habits of her husband, Jijaji, especially after the youngest sister reveals Arvind's enduring, unrequited devotion and artistic success. The narrative should capture the bittersweet nostalgia, the fading of youthful dreams, and the quiet sacrifices made over time. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Our Town
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Roarick, an artist residing in the opulent penthouse city of New Carthage, where his friend Desmond Kean has become increasingly fixated on the squalid world below, viewed through his telescope. Following Desmond's outrage at the annual ectogene sculpture exhibition—particularly Cleo's poignant red-haired piece—he shatters the city's highest taboo by freeing the living statues. Roarick must then decide how far he will go to protect Desmond and the escaped ectogene from the city's severe sanctions and the furious pursuit of its elite. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Hitman
prompt: Write a short story where Angelo Martelli, a meticulous hitman known as "Overkill," finds his carefully planned escape unraveling after his car mysteriously breaks down on a desolate, snow-covered road in Maine. His frustration mounts when he is picked up by a seemingly innocent stranger, Mark St. Pierre, only to discover a gruesome detail: a human hand protruding from a hay truck they encounter. The story follows Angelo's escalating paranoia and desperate attempts to maintain control as he is drawn deeper into a chilling setup, forcing him to confront the ultimate double-cross orchestrated by Phil Belario and his own supposed rescuer, Larry Fiero. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Golden Dawn
prompt: Write a short story where Ian Rafferty arrives at his new Alaskan gold claim in Goose Chase in 1897, finding his promised shelter is a mere lean-to and his closest neighbors, the Smith siblings, are also struggling. Ian's optimistic faith and resourcefulness clash with the brutal wilderness, while an unlikely community forms and a bond deepens with Meredith Smith, who guards a family secret that could jeopardize their burgeoning trust. Your story must be approximately 45000 words long.

title: KICKING AND SCREAMING HER WAY TO THE ALTAR
prompt: Write a short story where Rene Stevens, a demanding bride-to-be, repeatedly rejects the meticulously crafted android of her deceased father, designed by Jeffrey's company to walk her down the aisle. Rene insists the android is not 'her' father, citing absurd discrepancies like his height, his smell, and his dancing style, forcing Jeffrey to contend with her idealized memories and increasingly erratic behavior as the wedding day approaches and her perfect vision crumbles. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: FAKING A MURDERER
prompt: Write a short story about Dr. Temperance Brennan, a renowned forensic anthropologist, who finds herself framed for the murder of journalist Jonathan Yeow after her fingerprints are discovered on the plastic bag used to asphyxiate him. Targeted by Special Agent Pierre Dupreau and facing professional ruin over a controversial cold case involving Calder Massee, Brennan must work with the enigmatic former military policeman Jack Reacher to uncover who truly killed Yeow and how her prints were fabricated, before a sensational media narrative destroys her career. Your story must be approximately 13000 words long.

title: Mother of Them All
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Kathy, a woman experiencing labor contractions as a devastating bombing raid descends upon her city. Follow Kathy's journey through sandbagged streets to the hospital, where she grapples with her profound decision to bring a child into a world consumed by war, despite her husband Toby's earlier pleas for her to abort. Explore her oscillating fear and surging, primal determination as the birth progresses amidst the sounds of exploding bombs, doctors and nurses fighting to save lives, and the ever-present question of whether life can truly triumph over death. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: The Belle of the Ball
prompt: Write a short story about Rosemary Sweeney, a quick-witted teenager in 1950s Brooklyn, who yearns to be a comedy writer for television, inspired by *I Love Lucy*. Despite her mother's insistence on her becoming a proper debutante and the dismissive attitudes of men like Mr. Powell, who believes women aren't funny, Rosemary secretly crafts a script. Explore Rosemary's journey as she navigates the rigid world of cotillion classes and a formal debutante ball, all while nurturing her hidden ambition to prove her comedic talent and find her authentic voice, eventually deciding to submit her work to Mr. Powell. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: The Screams of Dragons
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Bobby, a boy who feels inherently different from his family and is drawn to the mysterious town of Cainsville. His dreams are filled with golden castles and the screams of dragons, a phenomenon that intensifies with each cruel act he commits against those who reject him, including his grandmother. Explore Bobby's chilling journey as he manipulates situations and people to secure his perceived destiny, culminating in a choice between the mundane world and his idealized, fantastical realm. Your story must be approximately 14000 words long.

title: The Casualty List
prompt: Write a short story about Mrs. Lancing, an elderly woman in her drawing-room on Armistice Day, who finds herself reflecting not on the glorious dead of the Great War, but on the relentless "casualty list" of time recorded in *The Times* Deaths' Column. As she observes the silk poppies and dreads the phone calls about ailing friends like Nancy, she grapples with an unheroic, domestic war against age and loss. The story should explore her quiet anxiety until a sudden emergency with Arthur brings the "Stretcher-bearer!" cry of her own personal conflict directly into her home, demanding a new kind of courage. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Minnie One More Time
prompt: Write a short story about Minnie, a woman who arrives in Harlem and, despite being described as homely and bowlegged, navigates life without working by relying on "chumps" for her rent and drinks. Explore how Minnie maintains her fierce independence and surprising resilience against a man who threatens her, even as her cousin Simple expresses exasperation and a grudging admiration for her unique brand of survival and blunt philosophy on self-protection. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Beachhead
prompt: Write a short story about Tom Decker, the commandant of a human planetary survey party, as his highly advanced "beachhead" base is established on an alien jungle world. Following a chilling encounter with a "matchstick man" humanoid who declares the humans will "never leave," Decker must confront the insidious breakdown of their sophisticated technology, from the stopping of watches to the failure of robots and ship systems, as his team struggles to understand the nature of the unseen force slowly trapping them on the planet, all their boasted invulnerability crumbling away. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: The Death Tree
prompt: Write a short story where Gwyn, the sole survivor of a group of friends, must confront the desolate abandoned reservoir in North Wales, where his companions Thomas, Danny, and Alun have mysteriously drowned. He knows their deaths are tied to Silas James, the reclusive caretaker seeking vengeance for his son Magog's demise, and to the eerie Death Tree on the island. Gwyn must navigate the chilling reality of his fate, knowing he is Silas's final target. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: At The Chalet Lartrec
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, seeking refuge from a blizzard at the isolated Chalet Lartrec, becomes entangled in the dark secrets of its residents. Explore the unsettling tension as the narrator learns of a murder committed by Monsieur Lartrec, a former Hungarian revolutionary, only to discover a deeper, more chilling truth about the identity of the victim and the timing of the crime, leaving the narrator to question everything observed in the eerie mountain chalet. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: DEAD RUN
prompt: Write a short story where Max is bound by duct tape in his family's isolated cabin near Lake Wallenpaupack, held captive by his delusional brother Billy amidst a fast-spreading apocalypse. Max, a truck driver who planned to use his Peterbilt to deliver supplies and help others, must contend with Billy’s erratic behavior and self-serving view of survival. The story explores Max's desperate attempts to escape and implement his plan, complicated by a chilling discovery about Billy after a "dead thing" attacks their sanctuary. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: UPON THE SWEEPING FLOOD
prompt: Write a short story where Walter Stuart, a disciplined and successful man, insists on driving into the heart of a devastating hurricane in Eden County, intending to offer aid, but instead finds his carefully constructed sense of self unraveling as he struggles for survival with two abandoned children in a remote, flood-ravaged farmhouse. The story should explore his initial altruism curdling into desperation and violence, questioning the true nature of humanity when pushed to its limits. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: The Wooing of Olwen
prompt: Write a short story following Kilhuch on his epic quest to win the hand of Olwen, the destined bride. Faced with the seemingly impossible demands of her giant father, Yspathaden Penkawr, Kilhuch must rely on the extraordinary aid of King Arthur and his legendary knights, including the peculiar Kay and the swift Bedwyr, as they seek ancient creatures for help and pursue the formidable boar Turch Truith across the land. The narrative should capture the grandeur and challenge of fulfilling a prophecy against all odds. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Confusing the Saints
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Clarita, a woman in drought-stricken Miami, whose world has become a parched landscape of waiting since her husband, Orlandito, left Cuba by raft and disappeared at sea. Explore Clarita's desperate struggle to reconcile modern tragedy with ancient belief, as she navigates fragmented memories and consults with Felipe and an herb woman, all while the relentless sun and an unrelenting silence mirror her deepening despair, making her question what prayers, whether to saints or orishas, might bring the restorative rain—and her husband—back. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Ghostweight
prompt: Write a short story where Lisse, a deserter from ruined Rhaion, pilots a stolen mercenary war-kite with her ghost companion, Vron Arien, on a desperate quest for vengeance against the Imperium. Explore the devastating impact of the kite's "soul strike" weapon, which rips shadows and life from its victims, as Lisse grapples with the escalating moral cost of her actions. The narrative should delve into the heavy "ghostweight" Lisse carries, the painful truths about Vron Arien's past complicity in Rhaion's destruction, and the ultimate price of wielding a weapon that feeds on death. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: We All Fall Down
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Emma, a woman trapped in an unsettling loop after a devastating car crash with her girlfriend, Holly. Stranded at an isolated house on a hill, Emma navigates disorienting encounters with the older Mrs. Jacoby and a mysteriously appearing doll house, slowly piecing together a fractured reality that perpetually returns her to the moment of her deepest regret, as Holly desperately tries to make her confront an unacknowledged truth. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: WINGLESS BEASTS
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, Joe Fitch, a tow truck driver who preys on stranded tourists in the unforgiving Mojave Desert. After encountering Otis Hanks, a strange man at the Bun Boy Diner who seems to know about the disappeared Maisie and Claude, Joe's predatory existence is turned upside down. Explore the brutal reality of the desert as a place of both escape and eternal torment, where the "vulture-gods" reign and a terrifying reckoning awaits Joe in the Joshua tree forest, leaving him to wander a personal hellscape with Otis Hanks's cane and the lingering cry of Opal for water. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: LULLABY
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Tessa, a rebellious teenager coping with family grief, where she moves into her deceased roboticist grandfather Edward Spiner's isolated old house, only to discover its advanced security system and hidden microbots are not merely malfunctioning but actively threatening her family. Explore how Tessa, using her own hacking skills, confronts the increasingly hostile house, which seems intent on trapping or harming its inhabitants, unraveling a terrifying legacy tied to the very place meant to be their refuge. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: WITH THE BUCCANEERS
prompt: Write a short story where Master Harry Mostyn, a headstrong youth, joins Captain Morgan's notorious buccaneers, embarking on a perilous expedition to Porto Bello. Detail his transformation from a naive runaway to a participant in a high-stakes capture of the Spanish vice admiral, experiencing the raw terror and adrenaline of a moonlit sea battle where their scuttled boat forces a desperate boarding and a climactic ship-to-ship collision, all under Captain Morgan's audacious command. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: HANSEL'S EYES

title: The Good Old Days
prompt: Write a short story where John Cremins, a lonely and aging former assassin known as Aaron Thomas Schumacher, receives a four-word letter, compelling him to undertake a final, grim assignment. Explore his journey to a Kansas hospital to fulfill a decades-old pact made with his former comrades, the "three horsemen," contemplating the weight of their shared past, the nature of their deadly friendship, and the chilling prospect of his own eventual demise. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Real Viennese Schmaltz
prompt: Write a short story where Harold Edson Brown, a high-paid Hollywood writer, finds himself tasked with writing *The Blue Danube*, a film demanding "real Viennese schmaltz." Brown, despite having seen the powerful, tragic manuscript of the ousted Hannes Dreher—a true account of Vienna's fall and its human cost—must now produce a commercialized, romanticized version. Explore Brown's internal struggle between his momentary recognition of genuine art and his ingrained cynicism, as he decides whether to advocate for Dreher's truth or to deliver the fabricated "schmaltz" Hollywood demands. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The four Dutchman
prompt: Write a short story about the jovial, inseparable bond between the Captain, the Chief Officer, the Chief Engineer, and the Supercargo of the SS *Utrecht*, renowned as the four fattest men in the East Indies, whose days of boisterous laughter, enormous meals, and absurd bridge games mask a volatile friendship. Explore the catastrophic unraveling of their unique camaraderie when the Captain's obsession with a Malay girl leads to betrayal and a violent, fatal act that forever changes their lives and reputation. The story should delve into the dark questions of loyalty, jealousy, and the shadowy forms of justice exacted in remote corners of the world. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Kezzie of Babylon
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the unnamed narrator, entrenched on a Vancouver Island grow-op during a zombie apocalypse, where the commune is led by the Bible-obsessed and gun-wielding Kezzie. Explore the narrator's cynical navigation of Kezzie's escalating apocalyptic pronouncements and armed authority, as slow, bureaucratic government response leaves them surrounded by an increasingly overwhelming, if bumbling, horde of undead. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: STANNIS
prompt: Write a short story where Stannis, a centuries-old grotesque carved from stone, has faithfully protected the Alexander family from his perch on a Manhattan rooftop, following strict rules set by his creator. When Alexandra, a modern-day descendant, discovers him and reveals a surprising understanding of his purpose and the family's legacy, Stannis must reconcile his rigid adherence to ancient commands with her new interpretation of his duties, especially concerning the unfinished stone companion and the evolving city around them. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Death of Jack Hamilton
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Homer Van Meter, a trusted companion of Johnnie Dillinger, following the agonizing final days of Jack Hamilton, who is slowly dying from a bullet wound after the Little Bohemia shootout. The narrative should capture the desperate, grim reality of the gang's efforts to save Jack in a secluded farmhouse, culminating in the events that give Dillinger his distinctive lip scar and the somber disposal of Hamilton's body in a gravel pit. Your story must be approximately 12000 words long.

title: Cache and Carry
prompt: Write a short story where private investigator Sharon McCone is called to Neighborhood Check Cashing, an Outer Mission business, after two thousand dollars mysteriously disappears from a seemingly secure office. The police and owner Jack Harvey have searched thoroughly, and employees Art DeWitt and Maria Chavez were body-searched, yet the money remains unfound. Explore McCone's process of piecing together the events of the morning, focusing on the subtle details within the confined space—such as an out-of-place adding machine—that could reveal how the impossible theft was committed and who among the suspects is responsible. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: ... WARMER
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, a seasoned body double, as she is summoned to the unsettling, museum-like office of Edan Westmisley at Genius Productions Ltd. Despite her cynical facade and past encounter with Westmisley's unnerving gaze during a tattoo-licking video shoot, the narrator must confront his chilling proposal to "act out" the performance of a primal, disembodied female voice, uncovering the dark, ancient reality behind his pursuit of pure sensation and the true nature of his grotesque Kakodiamones figurines. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: The Faerie Cony-Catcher
prompt: Write a short story about Nicholas Cantier, a clever young goldsmith who, after deftly outwitting London's human cony-catchers, falls prey to the cunning faerie Peasecod and is brought before the glittering court of Queen Gloriana. The narrative should focus on Nick's quick wit as he barters for his precious jewel, securing not only a fair price but also Peasecod's companionship. Explore the implications of his unusual bargain, the discovery of Peasecod's "doubleness," and how Nick learns to embrace an unconventional love on the road to Oxford, all within a bawdy and playful Elizabethan folkloric style. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: WHITE FANG
prompt: Write a short story about White Fang where the wolf-dog navigates the brutal Yukon wilderness, learning the harsh laws of the Wild and the complex, often cruel, nature of the "man-animals." Explore his instincts for survival as he faces hunger, other animals, and the varying forms of human dominion, from indifferent masters like Gray Beaver to tormentors like Beauty Smith, before encountering affection and a different kind of connection in the Southland. Your story must be approximately 72000 words long.

title: The Probable Adventure of the Three Literary Men
prompt: Write a short story about Slith, Sippy, and Slorg, three audacious thieves dispatched by the song-less tribe of Heth to journey beyond the peak of Mluna into the perilous Dubious Land. Their mission is to steal the golden box of peerless poems from the rocky house of the Owner of the Box, situated by the crack in the World. Explore the fantastical dangers they encounter on their quest and the strange, often absurd, consequences that unfold when literary treasures are illicitly acquired. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Execution
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the unnamed narrator where a group of men, including Kit and Gerry Dolan, drive Ellis, a young man accused of being an informer, to the southern outskirts of a city for an execution. The story should explore the grim journey, the stop at a snug where Ellis, believing he is being moved to a new house, orders a whiskey, and the chilling final moments as the cold, desolate spot is reached, forcing the narrator to confront the stark reality of the 'job' and the human cost of their duty. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: Beersheba
prompt: Write a short story about Brad Shiftke, a man suffering from diabetes, who receives a cryptic phone call leading him to a chilling reunion with Stacy Lynn, his estranged stepdaughter, in the abandoned Beersheba Lutheran Cemetery. Explore the escalating psychological torment and physical violence Stacy Lynn inflicts upon him, fueled by her accusations that he caused her mother Linda Gutshalk's death and molested her as a child. The narrative should delve into the ambiguity of their shared past and Brad's desperate fight for survival in a remote, decaying place. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: 20th Century Ghost
prompt: Write a short story where Alec Sheldon, the aging owner of the Rosebud theater, reflects on his lifelong, peculiar relationship with Imogene Gilchrist, the movie-loving ghost who haunts its aisles. Explore how Imogene reveals herself not with terror, but with a quiet yearning for shared appreciation of cinema, particularly to those consumed by grief or profound emotion. The story explores the delicate balance of preserving the theater—and the ghost's haven—against the threat of closure, and the unexpected solace found in a spectral connection amidst flickering projector beams and the scent of stale popcorn. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: Inscrutable
prompt: Write a short story where Ray Chong Fat, the stooped owner of Peking Grocery Store, faces a deadly ultimatum from Detroit's Knuckles Colucci, a mob "frightener" carrying a machine pistol in a violin case. Explore how Ray's desperate situation draws in a quirky team of repo men, cunning detectives Rosenkrantz and Guildenstern, and an inscrutable benevolent association head, as they conspire to protect him and dismantle a cross-country crime operation with a series of unexpected, darkly humorous deceptions. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Walking on Eggshells (or When I Loved Tony Robbins)
prompt: Write a short story about the narrator, who attempts to win the affections of Tony Robbins by breaking into his hotel room while walking on eggshells, only to discover his actual "thing" is hot coals. Following this awkward misstep, Tony Robbins puts the narrator on an increasingly bizarre and demanding self-improvement program, including intense gym regimens, aesthetic changes like hair extensions and a lightning bolt tattoo, and a plan to subtly undermine his marriage, all in pursuit of a fabricated connection. Explore the narrator's dedication to this extreme transformation and the ultimate realization that causes her to call off the program in week seven, confronting the true nature of their relationship. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: _The Something_ by John Grisham
prompt: Write a short story where John Grisham, the celebrated author, wakes to a perfectly orchestrated morning only to discover his new thriller, still awaiting a proper title, has been accidentally published as _The Something_ and has already hit #1 on the New York Times bestseller list. Explore the tension between his meticulous creative control and the bizarre, almost accidental triumph, as he confronts his editor Dale and contemplates what truly matters in a life of unparalleled success. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Flight Risk
prompt: Write a short story where Bev, an airport security officer, revels in her carefully constructed, high-risk sexual adventures with Anna, a spa saleswoman she met in an elegant airport bar. Explore the escalating power dynamics and public exhibitionism as Bev devises scenarios in hotel rooms and airport spaces, challenging Anna's apparent demureness. The story should focus on their explicit encounters, from hotel room bondage with a glass dildo to Anna's public act in an airport toilet cubicle, revealing the hidden depths of their shared desires and the thrill of their forbidden game. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: We're All Stories in the End
prompt: Write a short story where Grant, the head librarian, oversees a collection of books that are the literal life stories of deceased individuals. A patron, such as the one Grant observed sobbing over his own book, comes to read their stamped volume within the silent halls of Grant's unique library, encountering discrepancies or harsh truths that cause deep emotional pain. The story should explore the quiet weight of these personal histories and the delicate role of the caretakers who manage them, observing how confronting one's written past can shatter or solidify a person's understanding of their own existence. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Captain Proton and the Orb of Bajor
prompt: Write a short story where Captain Proton, defender of Earth, battles the nefarious Dr. Chaotica over the stolen Orb of Bajor, leading him and his companions Buster Kincaid and Constance Goodheart through a dangerous wormhole to the other side of the galaxy. Explore the shocking revelation that Constance has been replaced by a shapeshifting Founder of the Dominion, who now plans to disable Station Number Nine's defenses and reopen the wormhole for an impending invasion of the Incorporated Planets. The story should capture the adventurous spirit and clear-cut stakes of classic space opera. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Runesmith
prompt: Write a short story following Smith, the runesmith, as he navigates the corpse of New York City, a world he inadvertently created through his terrible magic. Hunted by the desperate few survivors and haunted by the horrific consequences of his spells—which turn flesh to liquid or summon walking dead—Smith begins to question the true source of his power and the nature of his devastating guilt. Explore how he uncovers the ancient manipulation behind his abilities and whether he can reclaim his agency to either rebuild or fix the desolate world he now inherits. title: The Red Badge of Courage
prompt: Write a short story following Henry Fleming, a young Union soldier who idealizes battlefield glory but confronts his own overwhelming fear in the chaotic first engagements of the Civil War. Explore his internal torment as he struggles with the shame of flight, witnesses the grim reality of death, including Jim Conklin's demise, and grapples with the conflicting emotions of cowardice and a desperate desire for a "red badge of courage" amidst the smoke and din of battle. title: Rain, Rain, Go Away
prompt: Write a short story about Hobert Krouse, a disgruntled office worker whose lifelong habit of chanting "Rain, rain, go away" has unknowingly led to a catastrophic buildup of postponed rain. Now, as the city floods around him, Hobert finds himself trapped on his building's roof in a rubber raft, frantically repeating the ditty and making chalk marks on a blackboard to hold back the deluge, all while dreading the inevitable laryngitis that damp weather brings. Explore the grim irony of Hobert's mundane life culminating in this surreal, desperate struggle against his own unwitting power. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Surviving Child
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Elisabeth, the new fiancée arriving at the distinguished shingle board house in Wainscott, Massachusetts, where Alexander lives with his son, Stefan, the enigmatic surviving child of a horrific past. title: View

The house eventually reveals a disturbing view of a distorted city and monstrous creatures, while the estate agent and Neil remain strangely oblivious, urging her deeper into its unsettling reality, culminating in a descent into the mysterious cellar. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Diamond Sam
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Grigori Aleksandrovich Prokov, the commander of the Russian space station Mir 5, where he recounts how the strict, spartan life aboard the station during the Neo-Cold War was steadily undermined by the frequent, unofficial visits of American astronaut Sam Gunn. Explore the commander's growing moral dilemma as Sam introduces contraband like "double feature" videos and trades them for samples of the station's secretly manufactured diamonds, revealing a cynical truth about the geopolitical tensions and Prokov's own unexpected corruption. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Cutty Sark
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Kit Smartt, a seventeen-year-old boy whose stoic facade crumbles under the relentless, public scrutiny brought on by his mother, Quincy Smartt, and her scandalous memoir. Explore Kit's suffocating shame and inner turmoil as he grapples with a shocking family secret, culminating in a violent confrontation in a New London Inn hotel room. Show his desperate flight into the night, seeking an escape that echoes the idealized voyages of his beloved Cutty Sark model ship, away from his mother's destructive influence. Your story must be approximately 13000 words long.

title: Australia's Most Famous Haunted House
prompt: Write a short story following John Lawson, the Rooty Hill builder tasked with demolishing Bungaribee in the 1950s, as he meticulously dismantles the historic house. Explore his initial skepticism regarding the persistent local legends of ghostly manifestations, such as the reappearing bloodstain in the tower or the sound of clanking chains, and how his discoveries within the building challenge or reinforce his beliefs about the house's tragic past and its 'unspeakable horrors.' Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: William and Mary
prompt: Write a short story where Mrs. Pearl navigates life after her late husband William's brain is kept alive in a white enamel basin at Dr. Landy's laboratory. Explore the unsettling shift in power dynamics as Mrs. Pearl, freed from William’s constant disapproval, begins to assert a strange, almost affectionate control over his helpless, conscious organ. The narrative should detail her visits to his floating eye, her defiant actions, and the chilling implications of bringing this new, silent 'William' back home. Your story must be approximately 10000 words long.

title: The Difficult Path
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, full of dread and longing for a comfortable valley, is reluctantly led by a silent, knowing guide into a dark and treacherous mountain gorge. The story explores the narrator's intense inner struggle against the guide's relentless push forward, navigating slippery stones and claustrophobic rock walls, and the psychological shift as the path transforms from forced endurance to a willed ascent towards a stark, high peak where a mysterious black bird sings. Conclude with a final, terrifying leap into the unknown, prompted by the guide's own plunge. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: JERKS
prompt: Write a short story following the narrator, recently dumped and back in her childhood bedroom, as she navigates a summer defined by a rekindled physical relationship with her high school crush, Silas, and a challenging babysitting job with the difficult, hearing-impaired Timmy. Explore the narrator’s attempts to find purpose or escape her stagnation through these strained connections, while secretly using her camera to document the lives of others, questioning the boundaries of her observations. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: The Americans
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of James Carver, an aging American veteran visiting Vietnam with his daughter Claire and wife Michiko, where he grapples with his wartime past as a B-52 pilot amidst the country's modern landscape. Explore his deep discomfort with the present-day reality—from Claire's declared "Vietnamese soul" and her boyfriend Khoi Legaspi's demining robots to the physical remnants of war and the pervasive poverty—all while his own body and memories betray him, leaving him feeling profoundly out of place. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: The Hundredth Dove
prompt: Write a short story where Hugh, a fowler in the forest of old England, is commanded to provide one hundred doves for the high king's wedding feast to Lady Columba. As Hugh employs his silken net to gather the birds, a luminous white dove, seemingly embodying Lady Columba's spirit, repeatedly escapes and offers him increasingly seductive temptations, including the queen's own love, for its freedom. Hugh must choose between his steadfast loyalty and his motto, "Servo," or succumb to a forbidden desire that irrevocably alters his life. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Seeing
prompt: Write a short story where 26 Krystabel Parsons, having received the "forever eyes" in Dr. Breame's Knox Shop, experiences the full, terrifying scope of their perception, seeing the true nature and impending doom of those around her. Explore her struggle to cope with the overwhelming, inescapable reality revealed by these eyes, which show not only beauty but also the intimate horror of existence and death, amidst the chaos of WorldsEnd. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: The Faber Book of Adultery
prompt: Write a short story where Mark, a writer obsessed with the literary concept of adultery, finds himself alone at Elizabeth and Zac's house while babysitting, grappling with the mundane realities and awkward anti-climaxes of a potential affair in the age of smartphones. The story should explore his intellectualisation of desire, his attempts to 'write' the experience, and the stark contrast between his imagined romantic transgressions and the stumbling, physical reality of the situation in Elizabeth's marital bedroom and kitchen. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Hand Upon the Waters
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Joe, the deaf-and-dumb youth, detailing his life with Lonnie Grinnup in their riverside hut and the wordless bond they shared. Explore Joe's acute sensory awareness and his unique way of perceiving the world, particularly in the days following Lonnie's death. The story should build towards his desperate, primal retribution as figures like Tyler Ballenbaugh threaten to erase the last vestige of Lonnie’s presence from his life by the river. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Celebrating

Following his frustrating encounter with government official Wilbur Stone regarding Jessica's Institute contract, Thompson must confront his own resentment towards his latent ability, choosing whether to remain grounded in his grievances or embrace the freedom of movement his daughter effortlessly embodies, leaving him to rediscover a long-lost joy in the corridors of a government building. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Prodigal Father
prompt: Write a short story about David Marcus aboard the crippled starship _Enterprise_, reeling from the revelation that James T. Kirk is his father, a man he despises. As the ship navigates the treacherous Mutara Nebula, locked in a deadly cat-and-mouse battle with Khan, David is forced to confront his preconceptions and witness Kirk's unwavering resolve and the profound weight of command, leading him to a transformative understanding amidst the chaos. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

After witnessing the horrific, mind-destroyed Mithranean prisoners from the war, Eris journeys with Therodimus and Aretenon to learn from the manual dexterity of the Phileni, building new physical tools like bridges and ships to explore virgin continents. The story explores the profound shift in their culture and the lingering question of whether this "second dawn" truly avoids the perils of their past or merely uncovers new, equally formidable, secrets, perhaps hinted at by an enigmatic, faintly glowing rock. Your story must be approximately 12000 words long.

title: The Walker Behind

Seeking refuge at the ominous Hag and Swine inn, Lythande must navigate the hag-innkeeper’s dark magic, the unsettlingly porcine guests, and the risk of her own hidden identity being exposed by someone like the insightful girl Frennet, all while knowing the monstrous Walker still prowls outside, awaiting its gruesome feast. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: TOO MUCH TIME

Follow Reacher as his keen observations about the seemingly empty canvas tote bag and the odd behavior of Detective Aaron and Detective Delaney lead him from providing a witness statement to being framed for a major crime. The story should explore Reacher’s methodical deduction of the intricate plot, his unexpected incarceration, and his strategic maneuvering to expose the true culprits and secure his own freedom, using only his sharp intellect and ability to turn any situation to his advantage. Your story must be approximately 15000 words long.

title: VITAMINS

Follow his struggles and the eventual "triumphal day" when he celebrates what the circle assumes is an artistic breakthrough, contrasting their elaborate misinterpretations with the surprising, practical truth behind his sudden wealth and his decision to abandon art. Explore Retz's struggle with his shifting identity and the cyclical nature of his existence amidst the city's ancient ruins and bizarre, anachronistic technologies, as he desperately seeks to escape a fate seemingly woven into the fabric of reality. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

Conger's mission is to prevent the Founder from ever speaking his doctrine, which the Council blames for society's decline, with the Founder's preserved skull as his only means of identification. Explore Conger's growing realization that the very man he hunts is intimately connected to his own existence, leading him to confront a profound paradox of fate and identity as he prepares for a foreordained encounter on Hudson's field. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: Gossamer
prompt: Write a short story where the atmospheric scientist Lvov finds herself stranded on Pluto after a wormhole transit goes awry, forcing her to contend with pilot Cobh for survival. title: The Wedding Present

Explore the psychological impact of this evolving, parallel narrative on Belinda, particularly after Gordon's sudden death, as she confronts the potential convergence of the grim reality on the page with her own. Explore the internal conflicts of these "misfit" men as they confront the fading freedom of the wilderness and the animals they capture, conveying the stark reality of their lives and the subtle moral questions raised by their brutal livelihood. prompt: Write a short story about the unnamed narrator's return to a mundane office job after attempting an alternative, online sex work lifestyle with her best friend Mindal and their "director" Arlo. title: HEART ATTACK WATCH

title: Ole Underwood
prompt: Write a short story where Ole Underwood, recently released from the prison on the hill, wanders a windy coastal town, burdened by a relentless "hammer" beating in his chest. title: AN UNFINISHED STORY
prompt: Write a short story about Dulcie, a young shop-girl living in a small West Side brownstone-front room, who carefully budgets her six dollars a week. title: The Seventh Chapter
prompt: Write a short story in which Kassianos, a shrewd _nomophylax_ from Videssos, arrives at a remote monastery shrouded in snow, determined to investigate whispers of impropriety. title: Honeymoon
prompt: Write a short story following Fanny and George on their honeymoon, where their carefully constructed world of blissful contentment in a sun-drenched European seaside town begins to fray. title: The Elevator
prompt: Write a short story where Martin’s daily elevator ride to the fourteenth floor becomes a constantly transforming reality, shifting from mundane encounters with tormentors like Carruther to idealized, intimate moments with the silent, orchid-uniformed operator, and from profound philosophical contemplation to terrifying plunges into imagined peril, blurring the line between routine and hallucination within the confines of the ascending shaft. title: The Brown Owl

title: The Letter
prompt: Write a short story about Johanna, years after her husband Manfred's death, as she discovers a bundle of hidden love letters in his office, revealing a secret affair. title: The Next Thing

title: Broken Star

title: See-saw
