The narrative should follow Washington as he embarks on an epic quest, facing mythical versions of American landmarks and battling monstrous foes like the living Mount Rushmore and the giant Britannia the Great, all while carrying his enchanted battle-axe Valleyforge and striving to rediscover the true spirit of freedom for his land. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: A Night at the Theatre
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, attending a theatre performance with Christine, experiences a profound, disorienting mental collapse. Delve into his escalating internal horror as he struggles to lift his head or engage with the stage, his mind fixated on vivid, disturbing images of war and the 'real' nature of torture, which he perceives as sadism and masochism. Explore his desperate reliance on Christine's warmth and her silver shoes as his only connection to reality, and his overwhelming urge to flee the repugnant auditorium. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Story of the King of the Two Rivers, Saihun and Jaihun, His Son Kaukab and His Experience with t
prompt: Write a short story where Prince Kaukab, son of King Fulk, endures a journey of trials and betrayal, from being captured by black men at a stinking lake and feigning a false identity to survive, to suffering the cruelties of the chamberlain who orders his hands and feet severed. Explore his miraculous restoration and his determined return to exact justice, reunite with his family, and claim his rightful place with Princess Yaquta. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: Last Day on Earth
prompt: Write a short story about the narrator, a fifteen-year-old, accompanying his mother and their aging hunting dogs, Shorty and Ranger, on what is meant to be their final journey to an animal shelter. The trip unexpectedly leads them to Grunion Beach, where the narrator witnesses his mother's increasing despair, her surprising, forgotten talent for walking on her hands, and his own desperate attempts to call his absent father. The story explores the narrator's dawning understanding of his family's financial ruin and emotional abandonment, all set against the bittersweet backdrop of what feels like a last day of fragile normalcy. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: I Sing the Body Electric!
prompt: Write a short story where Tom, Timothy, and Agatha receive their Electrical Grandmother following their mother's death. This wondrous, adaptable machine is designed to embody perfect love and care, but the children harbor varying degrees of skepticism and grief. Explore how the Electrical Grandmother works to fulfill her programmed purpose, navigating their complex emotions and proving her unique, seemingly indestructible nature, and the enduring impact she has on their lives, even as they reach old age and long for her return. Your story must be approximately 12000 words long.

title: THE GHOST IN THE CAP'N BROWN HOUSE
prompt: Write a short story about the enduring mystery surrounding the Cap'n Brown house in Oldtown, where Sam's tale of a ghostly woman seen by Cinthy Pendleton clashes with Aunt Sally Dickerson's eyewitness account of a cloaked figure leaving by carriage. Explore how these conflicting narratives, fueled by whispers and speculation, spread through the community, challenging the piety and perceptions of its inhabitants, and leaving the truth about Cap'n Brown's secrets—whether supernatural or scandalous—an unsettling, unconfirmed local legend. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: THE ANGLER
prompt: Write a short story about the veteran angler, a man with a wooden leg who resides in a nautical-themed cottage with a one-eyed cat and a seafaring parrot. Explore how his tempest-tossed past, including losing a leg at the battle of Camperdown, led him to find profound, self-contained contentment in the quiet practice of angling along the streams of the English countryside, becoming a beloved oracle to the villagers and a testament to the serene wisdom gleaned from a simple life. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Old Boys
prompt: Write a short story where Henry Kendrick, revisiting his old school after fifteen years, unexpectedly encounters his former schoolmate, Clamp, whose long-held resentment over a forgotten adolescent rivalry involving Veronica Fry resurfaces, leading to a ludicrous physical altercation and an absurd escape from the Headmaster, before culminating in a darkly humorous and surprising revelation about Veronica's identity. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: THE CASE OF THE THREE-HANDED WIDOW
prompt: Write a short story where a young Sherlock Holmes, still establishing his reputation, is tasked by the skeptical Rev. Samuel Whittlemore to solve the curious case of the "three-handed widow" who robbed a parishioner in broad daylight. The investigation must lead Holmes into the intricate deceits of London's criminal underworld, revealing the shocking truth behind the "widow's" impossible method and the hidden exploitation of children. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: The Screaming Woman
prompt: Write a short story about Margaret Leary, a ten-year-old girl who hears a woman screaming from under the ground in the empty lot behind her house, but finds all the adults—her parents, the neighbors, and even the police—dismiss her desperate pleas for help. Explore Margaret's growing frustration and isolation as she alone carries the terrifying burden of the buried woman's plight, and how a surprising detail—the woman's faint, mournful song—becomes the only way for the truth to finally penetrate the adults' disbelief and spur them into action. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The lotus eater
prompt: Write a short story about Thomas Wilson, a former bank manager who, at 35, moved to Capri to live a life of perfect leisure, having purchased an annuity for exactly twenty-five years, after which he planned to take his own life. Explore the profound irony where such a meticulously planned existence, devoid of struggle, gradually weakens his very will, ultimately leaving him unable to execute his final, grim resolution and instead leading to a quiet, unforeseen decline amidst the island’s unchanging beauty. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Muck-a-Muck. - A MODERN INDIAN NOVEL.
prompt: Write a short story where Genevra Octavia Tompkins, a refined young woman in a remote Sierra cottage, navigates a series of wildly improbable and melodramatic events, from encountering a philosophical Muck-a-Muck who steals her silver, to being saved from a multi-species animal attack by the heroic Natty Bumpo, only for her romantic destiny to be overturned by a misunderstanding involving a hairpiece. The story should maintain an exaggerated, formal tone that clashes with its absurd occurrences, leading to an ironically tragic end. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: THE LAST STAND
prompt: Write a short story where Specialist Kit Murphy returns from Iraq with a debilitating foot injury, expecting a warm reunion with his wife, Helena, but instead finds her emotionally distant in a Padre's Motel room with two separate beds. Explore Kit's raw disillusionment as his idealized vision of home clashes with Helena's desire for independence, leading him to seek solace and escape with his military buddies at The Last Stand Bar and Grill, only to confront the painful reality of a love that has already moved on. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Spa Day
prompt: Write a short story where Marie Vittorio visits a luxurious, secluded salon for a massage, anticipating only relaxation but finding herself drawn into an intensely sensual experience with her masseur, Robert. Explore the escalating intimacy and the shocking, yet deeply desired, physical encounter that unfolds, pushing her boundaries and revealing a hidden aspect of her desires, culminating in a powerful release within the quiet treatment room. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Revelations
prompt: Write a short story where Monica Tyrell struggles through a morning of escalating "nerves" and perceived miseries, dismissing the world around her, even her husband Ralph's attempts to connect, until a wild, windy taxi ride takes her to her hairdresser's shop and a sudden, stark revelation from George about his profound grief forces her to confront the true meaning of suffering, leaving her to grapple with how such raw emotion fits into her carefully constructed reality. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Page-Boy's Ghost
prompt: Write a short story where the spectral page-boy of the Granville Crescent house continues to haunt its new occupants, appearing suddenly in crooked passages and at stairways. Explore the escalating dread felt by the family as they are constantly followed by unseen footsteps and confronted by the pale, haggard boy, his emaciated figure and trailing rope a constant, terrifying presence until the building's tragic history of suicide is uncovered. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Good for the Soul
prompt: Write a short story following Father Ledet, a brandy-loving priest in a small Louisiana town, as he navigates a series of escalating moral dilemmas. After a drunk-driving accident on his way to administer last rites to Clyde Arceneaux, Father Ledet finds himself entangled in a secret about a stolen car, revealed in confession. Explore how he is pressured into a "good deed" that ultimately leads to public humiliation and confronts his understanding of faith, duty, and true absolution, especially when Patrolman Vic Garafola is involved. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Counting the Shapes
prompt: Write a short story where Biantha, a mathemagician in Evergard, grapples with an intractable Prophecy foretelling a second war against the demons. As the demon emperor's forces advance, bringing destruction with his serpent-eyed scepter, Biantha must reconcile the cold logic of her spells with the return of her estranged son, Marten, the former emperor's champion, and confront the twisted symmetries of betrayal and forgiveness that define her past and Evergard's uncertain future. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: The Space Between
prompt: Write a short story following Joan MacKimmie, a young Scottish woman who, seeking solace and understanding for her unsettling gift of hearing voices and seeing auras of impending death, travels to Paris in 1778 to enter the Convent of Angels. Her journey entwines with that of Michael Murray, a grieving wine merchant, as they are drawn into a clandestine world of ancient powers, immortal beings like the enigmatic Comte St. Germain, and whispers of a mysterious figure known as La Dame Blanche, all lurking beneath the city's familiar streets and within its forgotten chalk mines. Your story must be approximately 36000 words long.

title: The Doll's House
prompt: Write a short story where Kezia Burnell, still reeling after Aunt Beryl's cold dismissal of the Kelvey children from the courtyard, begins to truly see the invisible, cruel lines of social class that govern her world. Following her quiet act of kindness, explore Kezia's internal struggle with the ingrained prejudice surrounding the beautiful new doll's house, particularly the luminous little lamp, and her growing awareness of who is deemed worthy of experiencing beauty and belonging. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Dr. Lash Remembers
prompt: Write a short story where Dr. Lash, a physician in a steam-powered Republic, treats patients afflicted by a virulent disease whose telltale symptom is a slow trickle of green ink from the ear, dissolving memory into hallucinatory imagination. The Republic refuses to abandon its steam engines, which activate the disease-causing spores, leading to widespread societal collapse. Dr. Lash grapples with his futile medical duties and the horrifying truth revealed by Millicent Garana, all while the city descends into delusional chaos, ultimately confronting the seductive new reality promised by the mysterious Prisoner Queen. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: We Sink or Swim Together
prompt: Write a short story following Gerda Nielsen, a young woman sailing on the RMS Lusitania, who finds an unexpected, whirlwind romance with Jack Welsh even as the ominous threat of U-boat attacks intensifies. Explore their swift engagement and the harrowing test of their nascent love when the ship is struck, forcing Gerda to overcome her deep-seated insecurities and fight with fierce determination to save Jack amidst the chaos of the sinking vessel and the unforgiving, icy water, revealing an unforeseen strength within herself. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: Dusk
prompt: Write a short story where Norman Gortsby, observing the "defeated" in Hyde Park at dusk, encounters a distressed young man who claims to have lost his hotel and a crucial cake of soap. Explore Gortsby's cynical judgment and his later attempt to aid the young man after finding the lost soap, only for him to realize that appearances were meticulously crafted to deceive, leading to a final encounter that reveals the full extent of the cunning scheme. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: ON THE WESTERN CIRCUIT
prompt: Write a short story about Edith Harnham, a lonely, unhappily married woman who finds herself secretly pouring her own passionate heart into love letters written for her illiterate maid, Anna, to Charles Bradford Raye. Explore the escalating deception as Raye falls deeply in love with the sophisticated voice in the letters, unaware it belongs to Edith, leading to tragic consequences when the truth is inevitably revealed after his marriage to Anna. The story should capture the constraints of Victorian society and the emotional cost of hidden desires and mistaken identities. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: ON THE DOWNHILL SIDE
prompt: Write a short story where Paul Ordahl, a ghost damned for loving too much, wanders the spectral streets of New Orleans with his faithful unicorn, searching for Lizette, a virgin ghost trapped for never having loved. The two are granted a single chance at redemption before dawn, but the "downhill side" brings them to the ancient Saint Louis Cemetery, where terrifying, transparent claiming creatures await their due. The story should explore the nature of their intertwined fates, the sacrifices they are willing to make, and the bittersweet hope of a final, merged rebirth. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Angel's Island
prompt: Write a short story where Vortex "Bits" Arnold arrives at Angel's Island, a technologically advanced private prison in the East Indian Ocean, where pervasive silence and visually disorienting, non-reflective surfaces amplify the inmates' dehumanization. Convicts are fitted with a "snake pack," a bio-monitoring device that governs every aspect of life—suppressing urges, controlling movement, and inflicting pain for any transgression. Explore Bits's sharp intelligence and rebellious spirit as he navigates this system of total control, seeking to uncover its hidden cruelties and forge a desperate path toward agency or liberation for himself and fellow prisoners. Your story must be approximately 12000 words long.

title: The Famous Gilson Bequest
prompt: Write a short story where Mr. Brentshaw, having spent five years defending the posthumous reputation and immense wealth of the executed Mr. Gilson, confronts the true nature of his "benefactor." Following the tumultuous litigation that corroded Mammon Hill's moral sense, a flood exposes Gilson's simple pine coffin and Brentshaw's grand monument in the cemetery. Drawn to this disturbing scene, Brentshaw, now aged and mentally frayed, witnesses a macabre apparition of Gilson himself, engaged in a final, revealing act among the disturbed graves. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Unholy Grail
prompt: Write a short story where Glavas Rho's apprentice, Mouse, returns to find his master's cottage burned and Glavas Rho dead, pushing Mouse toward forbidden black magic to exact vengeance on Duke Janarrl. Follow Mouse's cold, calculated plan to use Ivrian, the Duke's daughter, as an unwilling conduit for his dark power during his own torture, staining her soul and his own with the cost of ultimate revenge. Your story must be approximately 10000 words long.

title: Miss Molly's Manners
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Miss Molly Manners, observing her human companions, Miss Lovely and Rags, as they introduce a new, puzzling object or routine into their shared household. Detail Miss Molly’s formal analysis of this perplexing human behavior, including her droll observations on their limited sensory perception and occasional obtuseness. Show her efforts to apply her refined canine etiquette and discerning intellect to patiently guide these "dear creatures" through their latest peculiar endeavor. Your story must be approximately 14000 words long.

title: THE HONEYMOON OF MRS. SMITH (Version II)
prompt: Write a short story about Mrs. Smith during her honeymoon in a temporary apartment, where the local grocer, Mrs. Jones, and other neighbors are openly fascinated by her husband, whom they suspect is "the man in the paper" – a notorious murderer. Mrs. Smith, though aware of their morbid curiosity and the impending "dreadful fact," maintains a detached, passive demeanor, quietly waiting for her inevitable destiny to unfold, while navigating the town's suffocating scrutiny and Mrs. Jones’s offers of help should she need to "scream." The story should explore her internal state as she observes the mundane details of her new life, knowing its likely violent conclusion. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Dark Water
prompt: Write a short story where Gretchen, a poet who burns her finest work, draws Brad into a relationship fueled by intense, almost violent physical connection. As a storm gathers over the lake, Gretchen's compulsive need to swim in the dark, intertwined with her deep-seated grief for her father and a primal desire for control, pushes Brad into a struggle for his life, hinting at the unsettling complicity of Carlos. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: A Trail to the West
prompt: Write a short story about Chick Bowdrie, a Texas Ranger operating deep undercover, who infiltrates a dangerous outlaw gang led by John Queen. Bowdrie must maintain his disguise, known as Shep Harvey, to rescue Jeanne Buck, a spirited young woman kidnapped to influence a Texas trial. The narrative should follow Bowdrie's tense journey as he navigates the treacherous Western trails and outlaw camps, constantly on the brink of exposure, culminating in a desperate showdown to free Jeanne and escape with his life. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: SHORT AND NASTY
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator as he recounts the final, horrifying hours of his estranged friend, Henry. Explore the narrator's bitter memories of their shared past—their youthful Gothic affectations and later resentments—as he navigates the rain-slicked streets of Philadelphia to Henry's decaying house. Focus on the growing dread and the physical manifestation of Henry's death, which the narrator himself unknowingly summoned with the help of Laura Howard, now relentlessly pursuing him with the sound of scraping rats and an increasingly distorted human form. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Doctor Kismet
prompt: Write a short story where Fayez Akwande, co-chair of the Sixth Radical Congress, arrives at Doctor Kismet's opulent island nation, Home, seeking justice and aid for starving Mali. Akwande navigates Kismet's seductive offers of power and pleasure, from a faux-petro project to "collecting" the world's finest minds in Atlantis. The story explores the tense, high-stakes negotiation between Akwande's unwavering commitment to collective liberation and Kismet's absolute, technologically-augmented control, revealing how one man tries to bend the will of the world's most powerful individual. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: THE BABY
prompt: Write a short story where Ben Herstein, an aspiring novelist, discovers his unborn son is not only a prodigious writer but also appears to be stealing his literary ideas. The story should explore Ben's escalating jealousy and professional anxiety as his wife, Sue, nears her due date, pushing Ben to frantic lengths to complete his own historical novel before the baby's manuscript can be born and published, all while struggling with the impending loss of his writing office to a nursery. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Black Box (2012)
prompt: Write a short story following Sylvester Horse-Kicker, a parapsychologist overseeing Carraclough Devize, a powerful but fragile medium who navigates the Freihoeven Institute and the Clarke Centre for Addiction and Mental Health. When tasked with assessing the "Thanatoscopeon," a vintage spirit cabinet notorious for desiccating its victims, Sylvester witnesses Carraclough confront a parasitic entity born from a medium's own psychic substance. The story explores the harrowing personal cost of immense paranormal abilities and the unsettling bond that forms between observer and subject when facing such deeply internal, grotesque horrors. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Louly and Pretty Boy
prompt: Write a short story following Louly Ring as she escapes her oppressive cotton-picking life to join bank robber Joe Young, quickly discovering the harsh reality of an outlaw existence is a far cry from the daring exploits of her romanticized crush, Pretty Boy Floyd. Explore Louly's shrewd navigation of danger and the surprising notoriety that arises from her act of self-preservation. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Sweet Spots
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Arpad Stroll, a teenager who discovers he can manipulate "sweet spots" to trigger improbable chains of events for his personal gain, starting with a chaotic escape from Mrs. Christelli's physics class. Explore Arpad's journey as he navigates the ethical implications of this power, from trying to win over Veronica Kingslake to facing the existential threat of the asteroid Perses, all while grappling with unintended consequences and a surprising connection with Blueberry Chefafa, culminating in a daring act at the Willis Tower. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: COME TO THE FAIR
prompt: Write a short story where Miss Helen Spencer, a reclusive fifth-grade teacher, unexpectedly finds herself thrust into the role of "Madame Mystery" at the annual village fair. She must navigate telling fortunes for her skeptical neighbors and acquaintances, including the charming Mrs. Miller and the familiar Dr. Atherton, all while struggling with her own deep-seated loneliness and social anxieties. Explore how this bizarre evening transforms Helen's perception of herself and her place within the town, as she grapples with the surprisingly accurate insights the cards seem to offer about others' lives—and perhaps her own. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Childhood
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator about a childhood defined by relentless discipline and discomfort rather than carefree joy. Explore the daily struggles under the strict watch of figures like Aapa, who enforced painful ablutions and meager meals, and Master Saheb, whose lessons brought pinches and blue marks. Show how the narrator, as a young girl, endured constant restrictions on play and movement, contrasting her plight with the relative freedom of boys like Chunnu, and how these experiences shaped her eventual fiercely independent adulthood. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: INCOMING ROUNDS
prompt: Write a short story about Lydia, a woman grappling with profound anxiety amidst the chaotic urban landscape of Chicago, where her husband Bruce's erratic, New Age-infused pronouncements about "guns and Buddhism" and Vietnam exacerbate her fears. Explore Lydia's internal world as she seeks refuge in places like the Lincoln Park Zoo conservatory, yearning for the imagined safety of living inside a glass paperweight, even as the city's dangers—from muggers to unseen illnesses—press in and her relationship fragments, leaving her adrift in a reality that feels increasingly surreal and beyond her control. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: The Adventure of the Antiquarian's Niece
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, Dr. Watson, years after the terrifying events at Depewatch Priory, where the memory of the blue-lit abyss, the chittering congregation, and the enigmatic Judith Delapore holding Lord Rupert Grimsley's skull continues to haunt his waking hours and dreams. Explore the enduring psychological impact of confronting a reality Mr. Sherlock Holmes refuses to fully explain, leaving Watson to grapple with the possibility that his fever-induced delirium revealed unspeakable truths, challenging his very sanity. Your story must be approximately 11000 words long.

title: A Birthday Party
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, Leon Barlow, a forty-year-old author, spends his birthday in a grimy, desolate bar, his thoughts veering between his deceased father's war experiences and his own financial ruin. Capture the bleakness of the setting as he observes the desperate patrons and drinks an Orange Driver, wrestling with disillusionment and a profound sense of loss that pushes him towards a reckless night. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Subtler Art
prompt: Write a short story where The Dark, a retired assassin, and her lover Tericatus, a wizard, engage in a friendly but fierce competition in the multi-dimensional city of Serendib to prove whose 'art' is more subtle. Start with them at their favorite noodle shop, debating nuances of flavor, when Cathay, a Trickster mage, appears. Explore how their past professions manifest in unexpected, long-game ways, leading to events with far-reaching consequences across Serendib, from the bizarre gardens of Caran Sul to the Home for Dictators. Let their subtle actions demonstrate the quiet, intricate power they still wield. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Stone Cold Truths
prompt: Write a short story about Zak Kebron, a Brikar father with rock-like skin, as he recounts his experiences in the Dominion War to his young son, Cal, for a school assignment. Cal's Mentor champions the "glories of war," but Zak initially spins a fantastical tale involving grappling hooks and space pirates, only to later confront the Mentor and his son with the grim, dishonest realities of conflict, including severed heads and strategic lies, in an effort to counter dangerous propaganda. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: CRAVAT OF THE DAMNED
prompt: Write a short story where Vernon, a centuries-old vampire, has finally settled back into his undisturbed solitude after the demise of his misguided thrall, Brice, only to find his carefully cultivated routine upended by a new, unexpected intrusion at his "haunted" house. Explore Vernon's struggle to maintain his cynical detachment and practical vampiric existence when confronted with a bizarre challenge that forces him to engage with the modern world or his own past in ways he never anticipated, making him question his hard-won peace. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Why Mr. Dog Runs Brother Rabbit
prompt: Write a short story about Brother Rabbit, a wily and resourceful creature determined to acquire a new pair of shoes for his family despite his own worn-out footwear. Follow Brother Rabbit as he encounters Mr. Dog, who is proudly wearing a brand-new pair, and uses cunning flattery to trick Mr. Dog into lending him first one, then all of his shoes. Explore the immediate aftermath of Brother Rabbit's audacious theft, detailing Mr. Dog's realization of the deception and the initiation of the never-ending chase that defines their relationship. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: A Brand New You
prompt: Write a short story where Annie, recently turned forty and striving for personal perfection by adhering to Caleb Crantz's strict "A Brand New You" philosophy, unexpectedly reconnects with her charming but exasperating ex-husband Ben in her Brooklyn apartment after nine years. Explore how their spontaneous reunion, marked by his familiar habits and a surprising exchange of poetry, prompts Annie to re-evaluate her newfound liberation, the true meaning of self-improvement, and whether the messy reality of old connections offers a more authentic transformation than any prescribed regimen or revitalizing cream. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Fire Water
prompt: Write a short story where Dr. Jo Haxton and Betty Dew, two elderly literary women, are fishing on Wall Doxey Lake as a sudden ring of fire engulfs the perimeter and a rural church burns fiercely nearby. Following their bewildered escape to shore, a massive, burned man named Jimmy Canarsis emerges from the water, his pain driving a distorted sense of justice. Explore the unsettling collision between the women's insulated intellectual world and the raw, violent reality of this surreal night as they confront the giant's accusations and the source of the inferno. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: A Pair of Silk Stockings
prompt: Write a short story where Mrs. Sommers, a woman accustomed to strict frugality, unexpectedly comes into fifteen dollars and initially plans to spend it on necessities for her children. Following an impulsive decision to purchase a pair of silk stockings, she finds herself drawn into a day of unprecedented self-indulgence, buying new shoes and gloves, dining at a fancy restaurant, and attending a matinee. Explore the liberating yet fleeting sensation of luxury and autonomy she experiences, and the poignant contrast between this momentary escape and the realities of her everyday life. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The House Beyond Your Sky
prompt: Write a short story where Matthias, the creator of simulated universes, resides in a house beyond the sky, surrounded by a dying cosmos. He struggles with his immense responsibility, finding solace only by subtly intervening, as a teddy bear, in the violent life of a six-year-old girl named Sophie. When an ancient pilgrim arrives, seeking to seize control of Matthias's brewing new universe, he must choose between the grand cosmic design and the singular fate of a child. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: That Only a Mother
prompt: Write a short story where Margaret, living in a world grappling with the aftermath of atomic warfare, awaits the birth of her baby, trying to ignore pervasive news of radiation-induced mutations. Focus on her fierce, almost blind, maternal love for her child, Henrietta, who exhibits impossibly precocious mental development while remaining physically hidden. The narrative should explore Margaret's denial and the chilling, inevitable moment when her husband, Hank, returns home from service and confronts the unvarnished truth about their baby. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: A BOY AND HIS DOG
prompt: Write a short story about Vic, a hardened survivor navigating a brutal, post-apocalyptic wasteland with his telepathic dog, Blood, where the currency is often scavenged canned goods and survival means constant vigilance against other "roverpaks." Explore Vic's cynical worldview as he is manipulated into venturing into a "downunder" society like Topeka by a cunning woman named Quilla June, forcing him to brutally redefine loyalty, the meaning of "civilization," and the savage boundaries of "love" in a world stripped bare of conventional morality. Your story must be approximately 15000 words long.

title: The Voice in the Dark
prompt: Write a short story following Mr. Satterthwaite as he travels to Abbot's Mede to investigate unsettling whispers and strange occurrences plaguing Margery Gale, who believes her house is haunted by her deceased Aunt Beatrice. Explore the layers of family secrets and deception that unfold, revealing a decades-old tragedy connected to the "Uralia" shipwreck and a hidden identity, forcing Satterthwaite to question who truly holds a claim to the Stranleigh inheritance and who is capable of murder. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Mudman
prompt: Write a short story where Tom Snedegar, a lonely farmer overwhelmed by endless labor, crafts a mudman to help him on his isolated farm. After embedding a dirt dauber's nest into its chest, the mudman takes on a terrifying life of its own, enacting a brutal, primal justice that reflects Snedegar's deepest, most unspoken desires, culminating in grotesque displays of power and a chilling understanding between creator and creation as the rain falls on his fields and groundhogs appear crucified on fenceposts. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: One Leg Gone to Judgment
prompt: Write a short story where young Clebe, a boy with one leg living on Troublesome Creek, recounts the solemn and deeply unconventional funeral his brother Tom organized for his severed limb on a remote hillside. Explore Clebe's practical concerns about the delayed arrival of a store-bought wooden leg and his peculiar anxieties about a partial body facing judgment day, all while his family navigates the harsh realities of their Appalachian homeseat, from squirrel hunting to the uncertainty of a missing fifty dollars. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: A Lady from Redhorse
prompt: Write a short story about Mary Jane Dement, a wealthy heiress from Redhorse, who pens letters to her friend Irene detailing her intense infatuation with the enigmatic Dr. Barritz, a man she suspects of being a powerful "Thug" or magician. Explore her anxieties about her rough past as "Gunny" and how it might impact her standing with this sophisticated man, leading to a dramatic sunset encounter where a shocking revelation about Dr. Barritz's true identity as "Dumps" from her childhood fundamentally shifts her perception of love and social pretense. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Sexual Dimorphism
prompt: Write a short story about Dr. Andrew Smith, a paleogenomicist on Mars, whose research into ancient dolphin DNA begins to reveal startling patterns concerning human sexual dimorphism, even as his personal life collapses following his violent breakup with Selena. Explore how his scientific findings on inherent differences between sexes mirror or complicate his intense feelings of shame, anger, and alienation, culminating in a profound, almost primal, connection to the marine environment of Eumenides Point. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: PLAYING THE GAME
prompt: Write a short story where Jimmy Rodgers, a solitary boy, retreats to the Leistershire cemetery to play "the Game," a method he uses to mentally reshape or navigate to a reality where his family and surroundings are "correct" and stable. Explore Jimmy's meticulous efforts to adjust concrete details—such as the number of smokestacks or the type of a sign—as he tries to align the current world with his elusive memory of home, grappling with the subtle but persistent "wrongness" of his constantly shifting parents and environment, and the profound exhaustion of his relentless, solitary quest for stability. Explore how Elijah, adopting the combative persona of "Gerald," navigates this uncomfortable encounter while grappling with his own hunger, drowsiness, and the philosophical question of what truly constitutes salvation amidst the absurdity. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: WORLDS TO KILL
prompt: Write a short story about Jared, the world-killer, a mercenary who disguises himself as a legless cripple to infiltrate planets like Reef and Khaine. Explore the grim reality of his conquests, from the stadium sacrifices he observes to the devastating use of alienation dust and psycheprobes, as he executes the cold directives of the sentient Machine housed in his moon's core. Depict Jared's profound isolation and the unsettling burden of his mission, as he acquires "The Metal" and even takes High Irina as payment, working towards a galactic order whose ultimate nature remains a closely guarded secret known only to him and the Machine. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: A Holy Terror
prompt: Write a short story where Jefferson Doman excavates a grave in the desolate Hurdy-Gurdy cemetery, driven by a letter from Barney Bree about a hidden gold strike. Follow Doman as his determined search for treasure in the grave of "Scarry" devolves into a nightmarish confrontation with the macabre, challenging his sanity amid unsettling details: an inverted coffin and the chilling realization of a profound past connection, as the moonlit desolation closes in. title: The Bus-Conductor
prompt: Write a short story where Hugh Grainger recounts a chilling premonition that began in the narrator's house on Graeme Street. Following a strange encounter with an empty hearse and its peculiar driver, who eerily resembles a bus-conductor, Hugh grapples with the unshakeable feeling that an appointment has been made for him. Explore Hugh's growing dread and his desperate attempts to understand the supernatural 'spy-hole' that seems to be opening for him, culminating in a fateful journey to Sloane Square and the chilling repetition of the conductor's invitation. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: GETTING USED TO IT
prompt: Write a short story about Herbert Miller, a man who cannot get used to his wife Evelyn's terrible brisket and dissatisfying sexual attention, leading him to find unexpected culinary and physical pleasure with his neighbor, Minnie Williams. Explore how Herbert navigates these secret satisfactions and the subtle ironies of domestic life, especially when his quest for "something new" is unexpectedly disrupted by changed circumstances or even surprising new attempts by his wife. title: Kate's Garden
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the unnamed narrator, a freelancer working from home, who becomes quietly fascinated by his neighbour Kate's garden. After her husband Tom Williams mysteriously disappears, Kate transforms her once-attractive plot into a vibrant, untamed work of art, which the narrator observes with a growing, unspoken affection. Explore the unsettling return of Tom, marked by a strange "black light" aura, and the way his presence unearths the fragile, often imagined, nature of love and commitment, revealing the secrets and hidden truths within ordinary suburban lives. title: ONE FUNERAL AND...
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, a young man adrift after university, travels to Endes, the vast Scottish estate, for the funeral of his Uncle Max. Following the unexpected reunion with his reclusive second cousin Felix, the narrator confronts buried attractions and the societal expectations weighing on Felix, who is set to inherit Endes and marry Rhona, exploring how an old family home becomes the crucible for an unlikely and deeply felt new love. title: The Eighth Voyage of Sinbad
prompt: Write a short story where Sinbad the merchant, resting in his courtyard garden in Baghdad under an orange tree, contemplates the truth of his seven legendary voyages. As sunlight filters through the leaves and the sundial casts its shadow, Sinbad finds the vivid tales he has told blurring into each other, their sequence and details shifting. The line between lived experience and invented memory dissolves, prompting him to wonder if his ongoing internal journey through these evolving narratives constitutes an eighth, most mysterious voyage of all. prompt: Write a short story where Carter Druse, a Union soldier positioned as a sentinel in western Virginia during the American Civil War, awakens to find a lone Confederate horseman atop a perilous cliff. Explore his harrowing internal conflict as he recognizes the enemy and must decide whether to uphold his military duty, knowing the profound and irreversible personal cost of his decision. title: OMAN

Follow her decades of silent endurance through joy and sorrow, raising children who never hear her voice, and examine the weight of her unspoken truth and the mysterious bond that ties her fate to the very man who imposed her solemn vow. title: Car Pool

title: The Body in the Doorway

prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, living in New York, as they grapple with the unfolding news of the EU referendum. title: What I Didn't See

title: Toad

title: The Lions of Al'Kalamir

title: Hemlock at Vespers
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Sister Fidelma as she investigates the sudden death of Sillán in the Kildare abbey's refectory, poisoned by hemlock during vespers. Delve into the complex loyalties and ancient Brehon laws that shape her decision as the mystery deepens with the death of Follaman. Your story must be approximately 10000 words long.
