When Jan, Ron, and Tasha, three white outsiders with varying motives, try to enter the club and breach this circle, their presence tests the limits of the music's spiritual energy. Explore the consequences as the afro-horn's "lethal vibrations" confront those who seek to appropriate or misunderstand its profound force. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Ghost in the Doctor
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Julian Welles Orson, a frontier physician burdened by a ghost that dictates life or death for his patients, making him leave Grover's Gulch in a desperate bid to find Iron Hawk at the Sioux encampment. Explore Julian's harrowing journey as he grapples with the ghost's unsettling judgment, which forces him to confront its power over his skills and conscience, deciding fates amidst a clash of cultures. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Tinian on Trial
prompt: Write a short story about the heiress Tinian I'att, who volunteers to demonstrate I'att Armament's revolutionary anti-blaster field to Imperial Moff Eisen Kerioth in a tense, high-stakes presentation. When Kerioth brutally executes Tinian's grandparents to seize the technology, the story explores Tinian's frantic escape from the factory on Druckenwell, clad in the very armor she helped create, as she grapples with devastating loss and channels her grief into a resolute desire to bring down the Empire. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: A World of Her Own
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, the practical older sister of Lisa, an eccentric artist whose life is a restless pursuit of various creative mediums, from collage to pottery to enamelling in Morocco. The story follows the family's long-suffering support for Lisa, particularly their mother's unwavering belief in her talent despite a trail of financial and familial disruptions, including Lisa's neglected children, prompting reflection on the true meaning and cost of artistic freedom versus responsible living. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Seven Dials
prompt: Write a short story where Ellen Farrell, following her husband Tony's death, discovers a hidden property deed from her father Harold inside a clock he crafted during the London Blitz. This deed pertains to an empty plot of land adjacent to the MI5 building in Vauxhall. The story explores Ellen's confrontation with the powerful governmental forces seeking to claim the land, as she navigates long-buried family secrets and decides how to leverage this unexpected legacy for her own liberation from a life of quiet subservience. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: From A Voyage to Laputa
prompt: Write a short story following the narrator's arrival on Laputa, the flying island, where its inhabitants are so absorbed in abstract mathematics and music they require "flappers" to rouse them from thought. Detail the narrator's bewildered observations of their impractical customs, from geometrically shaped meals to their poorly constructed homes. Then, as the narrator descends to Lagado, explore the equally absurd projects of the Grand Academy, where professors devise useless inventions like extracting sunbeams from cucumbers or mixing colors with blind apprentices, highlighting the profound disconnect between theoretical knowledge and practical reality. Your story must be approximately 14000 words long.

title: Brother Fox and the White Muscadines
prompt: Write a short story where Brer Rabbit convinces Brer Fox to seek out elusive "white muscadines" in the deep woods, leading the hungry Fox to climb a scaly-bark tree full of bitter, unripe nuts. The story should explore Brer Fox's growing frustration and eventual pain as Brer Rabbit manipulates the situation, culminating in a humiliating fall. Focus on the clever deception and the comeuppance, capturing the spirit of a trickster tale. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: Happiness and Woe
prompt: Write a short story where the man, living in a summer house with his wife Elise and young son Noni, navigates the harsh realities of unemployment and poverty. Follow his arduous daily routine, from stealing wood at dawn to his long walk into the city for meager unemployment benefits, as he grapples with despair and temptation on Friedrichstraße, seeking a brief, costly escape before returning to the quiet fortitude of his wife and the pure, uncomplicated joy of their child, Noni, who remains his anchor in a world of woe. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Keeper of the Gate
prompt: Write a short story where Nial O'Gordon, a Scot carrying a crucial missive from Barka Khan, finds himself entangled in the intrigues of the mythical Gutchluk Khan and his treacherous servant Mir Farash, leading him and his companions Alai and Abu Harb on a perilous journey through the desolate Zarafshan valley towards a legendary mountain pass known as the Gate, where ancient fears and hidden powers reside. Your story must be approximately 30000 words long.

title: BREATHING
prompt: Write a short story about Jeff, whose dead wife Val returns on the day the world goes mad and all the dead come back. Jeff clings to her renewed presence, finding solace in her breathing and familiar quirks, even as the news reports global chaos and Val herself grows increasingly distant and absorbed in strange sensations. Explore Jeff's unraveling perception of reality as he grapples with Val's changing demeanor and his own body's growing coldness, leading to the chilling realization of the true nature of their reunion and the personal hell born of his own darkest decision. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: CAROLINE VERNON
prompt: Write a short story following Caroline Vernon as her naive romanticism clashes with the manipulative power of the Duke of Zamorna. From her sheltered life at Eden Cottage to the deceptive allure of Verdopolis, Caroline finds herself ensnared by the Duke's cruel games, which she initially mistakes for passionate attention. Explore how her journey through Angria exposes the harsh realities of aristocratic society and the dangerous nature of her guardian, threatening to corrupt her innocence even as she defies her father, Lord Northangerland. Your story must be approximately 41000 words long.

title: When the Neighbors Love You
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, a Russian-American teenager in Squirrel Hill, who navigates the expectations of her immigrant parents and the close-knit community around her. As she decides between attending the local University of Pittsburgh or her dream school in Boston, explore the quiet tension between duty and personal freedom, complicated by an unmailed college deposit check and the lingering presence of her past rebellion with Maks. Delve into the pressure she feels to conform versus her longing for a life beyond the watchful eyes of her neighbors. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Giulia Lazzari
prompt: Write a short story where Ashenden, a British agent, meticulously manages Giulia Lazzari in the quiet French town of Thonon, ostensibly allowing her freedom while subtly controlling her every move to entrap her lover, Chandra Lal. Explore the psychological manipulation involved in forcing Giulia to write impassioned, contradictory letters to Chandra. The story should capture the bleak reality of this spy game, culminating in Chandra's tragic arrival and a final, cynical revelation about Giulia’s true priorities, exemplified by her concern for a twelve-pound wrist-watch. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: DOG OR DEMON
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Captain Harry Glennie where, after participating in the callous eviction of an old tenant and the accidental death of his dog at Castle Kilmoyle, a creeping horror begins to haunt his new family life. Following Lily's increasingly vivid visions of a "black and burnt-looking dog" and the inexplicable death of their infant, Harry grapples with his wife's descent into madness and his own sanity, questioning if a vengeful entity is exacting a chilling curse upon him for his past brutal actions in Kerry. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Nightingale and the Rose
prompt: Write a short story about the Nightingale's profound sacrifice to create a red rose for the young Student, detailing her agonizing struggle against the thorn of the Rose-tree in the moonlight. Explore the bittersweet beauty of her song as her life ebbs away, leading to the creation of the crimson bloom. The story should capture the tragic irony of her ultimate devotion to a love that proves to be superficial and ungrateful, considering how the red rose is ultimately discarded in the street for trivial reasons by the Professor's daughter. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Invisible Boy
prompt: Write a short story where Old Lady, convinced her folk magic can make Charlie invisible, uses a bat and a silver needle to perform the ritual. Describe the strange days that follow in her remote cabin, as Charlie, supposedly unseen, tests the boundaries of his "invisibility" and Old Lady's willingness to maintain the charade, all while she grapples with her profound loneliness and the question of whether her miracles are truly working or just a shared delusion. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Monster of Lake LaMetrie
prompt: Write a short story following Dr. McLennegan at Lake LaMetrie, where his daring brain transplant experiment on the elasmosaurus takes an unexpected turn as Edward Framingham's human intellect degenerates within its monstrous new form. Explore the horrifying process by which Framingham's mind loses its refinement, embracing a coarse, bestial nature, culminating in the echoing, discordant songs of the man-beast amidst the isolated Wyoming wilderness. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Legend of Atlantis
prompt: Write a short story following the stationmaster, the chandler, and the taverner as they face the impossible task of informing their village of its imminent inundation by the new hydroelectric dam. Explore the community's desperate, collective struggle to resist their forced relocation, from the sherry-stained petition rejected by the prefect to the final, haunting moments when the rising waters engulf their homes and turn the valley into a silent lake, fulfilling the fate of Atlantis. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Bells of the Mountains
prompt: Write a short story about Rorik the Yngling, a naive Dane who ventures into the Swiss mountains seeking glory and gold in a looming battle, only to become a 'mock king'—a decoy for the emperor. Explore his experience fighting 'foot to foot' against the fierce Swiss pikemen, his unexpected encounter with the resourceful local girl Maera, and how his grand illusions of conquest are replaced by a surprising offer of a quiet life amid the echoing church bells. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Dead Molly
prompt: Write a short story where Richard, a schoolboy, plays the unsettling game "Dead Molly" with his friends on a hot summer day, only to find himself plunged into a series of increasingly vivid and disturbing dreams. Explore his desperate attempts to discern reality as familiar details, like a broken water tap or his mother's cold words, seep from nightmare to waking life, blurring the lines between what is real and the persistent, chilling presence of the thin woman in the gray dress. The narrative should capture his growing dread and isolation as the boundaries of his world dissolve. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Abominations of Yondo
prompt: Write a short story about the narrator, abandoned by the Inquisitors of Ong, as they try to escape the desolate, alien desert of Yondo. Describe their journey through a landscape of corroding planets' dust and extinguished suns' ashes, where "orb-like mountains" and crumbling cities attest to ancient ruin. Show the narrator's encounters with grotesque, unearthly creatures and phenomena, from the spider-like entity to the "monstrous mummy," as they grapple with inescapable dread and the psychological torment of this cursed land. Explore the futility of escape when the ultimate horror lies in turning back. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Closed Window
prompt: Write a short story where Sir Mark de Nort dwells in the isolated Tower of Nort, a dwelling haunted by the legacy of his grandfather, old Sir James. When a growing, inexplicable compulsion leads Mark and his cousin, Roland Ellice, to breach the long-sealed window in the ancient turret-room, an unspeakable terror is unleashed upon their lives, drawing them into a horrifying confrontation with an unseen malevolence and leaving one forever altered by a glimpse into another, dreadful reality. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Ghosts of Yarralumla
prompt: Write a short story where Sir Murray Tyrrell, private secretary at Yarralumla, encounters a hazy, male figure climbing the stairs in Government House just before a royal visit in 1963. Explore the baffling nature of this apparition, his pursuit of the figure, and the inexplicable reaction of a security guard's dog, leaving Sir Murray with no rational explanation for the encounter and the lingering question of who this "other" ghost of Yarralumla might be. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Invasion of Venus
prompt: Write a short story about Toby, a civil servant, who visits his former lover, Edith Black, a theologian, as humanity grapples with the sudden arrival of an alien entity, the "Incoming," in the solar system. The story explores the bewildering revelation that these beings, far from engaging humanity, engage in a devastating war on Venus, culminating in the destruction of Neptune. Following this cosmic violence, the narrative should delve into how humanity, now acutely aware of its insignificance and the universe's indifference, redefines its purpose and finds hope amidst the literal debris of alien conflict, as Edith and Toby continue their philosophical debates while facing the new reality. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Evil Clergyman
prompt: Write a short story following the narrator as he explores a dusty attic chamber in a quiet seaport, warned by a grave-bearded man against touching a peculiar match-box object on a dusty table. Despite the ominous atmosphere and tales of a previous occupant, an evil clergyman, the narrator succumbs to curiosity, activating the device with a strange violet light. Explore the terrifying aftermath as the narrator discovers an inexplicable physical transformation, mirroring the very figure he sought to understand, and grapples with a new, inescapable identity in a world that now recoils from his presence. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: THE RETURN
prompt: Write a short story where the Shipmaster returns to the desolate, plasma-scarred planet Kholo, a world he annihilated two decades prior as a Covenant commander, now seeking a new purpose for his fractured Sangheili people. Following a mysterious column of smoke, he discovers humans excavating ancient Forerunner artifacts adorned with the sacred glyph of Faith, the very symbol his actions carved into Kholo's surface, forcing him to confront the profound lies of his past and a terrifying, unlooked-for revelation. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: IN ANOTHER COUNTRY
prompt: Write a short story about the narrator, an American soldier with a wounded knee, as he undergoes rehabilitation in a Milanese hospital after the war. Follow his interactions with other injured Italian officers, particularly the stoic Major who is obsessed with grammar, and explore the stark reality of their physical and emotional wounds. Show how the Major's seemingly unshakeable detachment is shattered by a devastating personal loss, revealing the profound and arbitrary nature of suffering in the aftermath of conflict, even as they gather daily around the new, hopeful "machines." Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Loves of Alonzo Fitz Clarence and Rosannah Ethelton
prompt: Write a short story where Alonzo Fitz Clarence, a wealthy bachelor in snowy Eastport, Maine, falls deeply in love with Rosannah Ethelton of San Francisco through disembodied conversations over an early, unreliable telephone system. Explore how their intense, imaginative romance develops despite the primitive technology and the villainous Mr. Burley's vocal impersonations, and the dramatic lengths Alonzo goes to reunite with his beloved, navigating deception and vast distances for an improbable, long-distance wedding. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: DEVOTION
prompt: Write a short story where Owen and Hillary, siblings living a quiet, codependent life in their Wimbledon house, prepare for the long-anticipated visit of Ben, a man from Owen's past and an unspoken part of Hillary's affections. Explore the lingering impact of old desires, unspoken secrets like hidden letters, and the delicate balance of their shared devotion, as the truth of their history threatens to surface amidst the domestic calm. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Living Proof
prompt: Write a short story where Gary Davenport, a former investigative journalist working as a biographer-for-hire, is commissioned by the astute Mr. Sui-Ho to write a completely honest account of his life. As Gary delves into Mr. Sui-Ho's past, particularly the disappearance of his business partner Enrico Characo and the unsettling discovery of severed hands, he must decide whether to publish the unvarnished truth or censor the biography, knowing the looming six-week deadline for the book "Living Proof" also marks the end of his own life. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: The Forged Coupon
prompt: Write a short story where the petty crime of a forged coupon, committed by the schoolboy Mitya Smokovnikov to settle a debt, sets off an escalating chain of moral degradation and unexpected spiritual awakening across Russian society. Follow the ripple effects as a mild act of deception leads to theft, violence, and murder among peasants like Ivan Mironov and Stepan Pelageyushkin, while also unexpectedly inspiring profound acts of mercy and a re-evaluation of justice and faith among characters, revealing how divine and human laws clash and transform souls. Your story must be approximately 28000 words long.

title: Lucifer
prompt: Write a short story where Carlson, the sole survivor in a silent, dead city, struggles inside the mountain-tall broadcast building to reactivate the generators and power grid. His goal is to bring the city's lights back to life, even if only for a fleeting moment, confronting the vast emptiness and the immense physical challenge of restoring machinery that has been dormant for years, knowing that any success will be brief and ultimately cannot overcome the profound desolation. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: My Other Half
prompt: Write a short story about the narrator, a British-Pakistani woman, and her mother’s complex return to Karachi after decades away. Explore the narrator’s struggle to reconcile her inherited sense of belonging with the city’s changed reality and her mother’s critical view of her homeland. The story should delve into moments of cultural dissonance, such as the airport’s rigorous security checks and the family’s social interactions, as the narrator grapples with being simultaneously accepted and marked out, questioning what it truly means to be "from" a place she barely remembers. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Flowering Judas
prompt: Write a short story where Laura endures the oppressive presence of Braggioni, a self-absorbed revolutionary leader whose gluttonous bulk and coarse singing embody the corruption of her ideals. Explore Laura's quiet stoicism and her struggle to reconcile her romanticized vision of revolution with the cynical reality she navigates daily, as she performs thankless errands for Braggioni and his comrades, all while an unseen danger steadily closes in. Let the narrative capture her internal "No" against a world that demands her compliance, questioning the true nature of her faith and the path to liberation. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: I.O.U.
prompt: Write a short story where Miss Honoria Athens, a newly retired schoolteacher, finds her meticulously prepared garden trampled by children using it as a shortcut and devises a system of negotiable "I.O.U." slips for two hours of labor from Allen Stuart and other offending boys. Explore the comical, unexpected ways these handwritten promises circulate through the town, becoming a peculiar form of currency exchanged between parents, grocers, and teenagers for everything from stuffed cabbage to a baseball game, dramatically altering community favors and obligations. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Madame Rosette
prompt: Write a short story where RAF pilots Stag, Stuffy, and William, on leave from the Libyan desert, embark on a mischievous scheme in Cairo. Driven by the stark realities of wartime and a peculiar sense of "military chivalry," they orchestrate the "rescue" of young women from Madame Rosette's notorious establishment, posing as Military Police. Explore their elaborate ruse to liberate the girls, not for typical reasons, but to share a night of unexpected camaraderie, beer, and a bizarre charade of authority, bringing a moment of defiant joy amidst the bleakness of their posting. Your story must be approximately 11000 words long.

title: All Wounds
prompt: Write a short story where Becky, a seemingly ordinary teenager caring for her grandmother Nana, discovers her family's hidden legacy when Ryan Dugan, a "bad boy" from school, is brought wounded into a secret healing enclave within their house by the vampire Sydney. Becky must quickly confront the truth that her senile Nana is a powerful Healer for supernatural beings like hellhounds and vampires, and Becky herself possesses a dormant, vital healing power. Explore Becky's struggle to embrace this new, dangerous birthright and the profound responsibility of healing creatures she never believed existed, knowing her Nana's lucidity and the lives of Ethereals depend on her untrained gift. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: RURAL FUNERALS
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of a lone traveler traversing the quiet English countryside who unexpectedly encounters a rural funeral procession adorned with ancient customs, such as the strewing of flowers or the singing of psalms. Explore the traveler's profound contemplation of grief, love, and memory as they witness these tender, simple rites, contrasting them with the detached formality of city burials. The narrative should delve into how the enduring beauty of nature and the unpretentious acts of remembrance perpetuate the deceased's presence and offer a solace beyond the tomb. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Whitest Lie
prompt: Write a short story following Herald Wil, a grieving father with a unique Gift, as he grapples with duty and family while investigating the mysterious death of Trainee Jalay and his deceased wife Lelia's coded ledgers. Wil uncovers Lelia's secret life as a spy and a high-ranking conspiracy threatening Valdemar, forcing him to choose between leaving his daughter Ivy behind for Circuit duty or taking her into the unpredictable field with an unexpected ally, Aubryn. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: The Seraph and the Zambesi
prompt: Write a short story where Samuel Cramer, a former Parisian man of letters now running a petrol pump near Victoria Falls, prepares a Nativity Masque for Christmas Eve, only for a literal Seraph to appear in his corrugated-iron garage. The Seraph's unearthly presence challenges Cramer's mundane life, literary aspirations, and very notion of ownership, sparking a dryly absurd conflict as the sweltering African heat intensifies and the surreal event threatens to consume Cramer's carefully constructed reality. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: SPECIMEN
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the unnamed Zade narrator, an official reporter assigned to observe John Wilson, the Earthling specimen. The Zade society, which values strength above all else, has subjected John Wilson to the grueling "Big Run," a massive urban maze designed to test his physical and mental fortitude. Explore the narrator's shifting perceptions of John Wilson as he navigates the deadly challenges, proving his ingenuity and resilience, and how his performance will ultimately determine the fate of humanity against the Zades' "survival of the fittest" philosophy. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Swami Sand Castle
prompt: Write a short story about the narrator's stay in the coastal village of Varkala, where an enigmatic sadhu, dubbed Swami Sand Castle, performs elaborate sand rituals on the beach, drawing the narrator and Howie into his orbit. Explore the growing fascination with this holy man and the subsequent visit to a local tea hut that culminates in a sudden illness, leaving the narrator to grapple with the landlord's culturally charged explanation and the enduring mystery of what truly transpired in India. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Refuge of Insulted Saints
prompt: Write a short story where the Master of Massey College finds his academic life profoundly disrupted when a chaotic assembly of desanctified saints, including the demanding Saint George with his horse and "dog"-dragon, the assertive Saint Catherine with her own beast, and the charming Cleodolinda, seek refuge in his institution. Explore the Master's increasingly exasperated attempts to house these volatile, attribute-laden figures within the college's strictures, from assigning Saint Barbara and her cannon to the Printing Room to managing Saint Patrick's naked appearances, as he struggles to maintain decorum and secrecy while the College Fellows begin to notice their miraculous guests. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Negative Space
prompt: Write a short story about Lan, a young woman in a ruined Las Vegas, who possesses a unique nanocore that allows her to manipulate memories and data in a world scarred by a data plague and corporate infowars. Follow Lan as she is relentlessly pursued by a corporation that seeks to exploit her abilities, forcing her to make a desperate decision to erase her own past to protect Alexis, her adoptive mother, from their grasp. Explore the true cost of forgetting and the unexpected ways identity can be preserved when everything else is stripped away. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Black Ships Seen South of Heaven
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Susannah, a weary guard in a fortified Chicago, who is secretly infected by a cosmic plague and working to hasten the world's end. As she takes her shift on the eastern wall, watching the fungal forest and dreading the onset of her full transformation, Susannah receives a cryptic, wax-sealed message from the Black Pharaoh, guiding her in the final ritual to summon the annihilating Shuggoth. Explore her resigned acceptance of humanity's insignificance and the chilling "meaning" she finds in orchestrating the final, inevitable collapse. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: The Shrine
prompt: Write a short story about Grady, a police chief consumed by grief after the death of his wife, Helen, and son, John, who discovers a remote compound bequeathed to him by his deceased friends, Brian and Betsy Roth. Explore Grady's descent into a fragile reality at the 'shrine' where he believes he can interact with the dead, as he clings to this solace while battling his own growing delusions, self-destruction, and the relentless legal challenge from Brian's sister, Ida, who seeks to strip him of this last, desperate connection. Your story must be approximately 16000 words long.

title: Dear Dryad
prompt: Write a short story about Aunt Rachel, who on Christmas Eve sits by an old walnut chair that will not rock, having received a mysterious visitor. The story should then extend back through the ages to reveal the enduring, mystical connection between an ancient oak tree and a lineage of women with red hair and milky skin, from the primal "girl" who makes an offering, to La Beale Alys navigating courtly love, and to Bronwen in the modern era. Explore how the essence of human bonds, possession, and the power of nature persist and transform through time. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: THE WINNER
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Harry, the boxing manager, where his fighter, Pretty Boy Bobby Barker, is getting brutally beaten by Tony Musso in a nationally televised match, enduring red welts and internal injuries. Harry, pragmatic and cynical, urges Bobby to quit to save his career and health, but Bobby stubbornly refuses. Explore the sudden, visceral shift in the fight's momentum and the manager's calculated response to Bobby's unexpected victory, revealing the true, unsentimental nature of success in the boxing world. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: _CIGARRO TARDE_
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, a middle-aged woman, visits a Bed-Stuy cigar lounge to rent it for a friend's birthday party. She finds herself unexpectedly drawn to the younger, white lounge owner, whose confident demeanor and sensual interaction during a cigar smoking lesson ignite a deep, long-dormant desire. Explore how this unforeseen intimacy, amidst the sepia-toned ambiance of vintage leather and tobacco, challenges her preconceived notions of herself and allows her to reclaim a potent sense of pleasure and vulnerability, culminating in a bold, uninhibited sexual encounter with the ever-present surveillance camera in the background. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: THE GHOSTS OF STRANGERS
prompt: Write a short story where Elexa, a young girl in Mountainknee Village with the unique ability to capture and converse with human ghosts, finds her world upended by the sudden arrival of wild dragons who break the ancient peace by snatching humans. Follow Elexa as she guides the ghost of old Peder to his dragon and later grapples with the death of her brother Kindal, wrestling with the implications of her rare gift for the living and the dead when confronted by dragon violence and the strictures of Headman Yan. Your story must be approximately 21000 words long.

title: THE BILL
prompt: Write a short story about Sean, who just wants to pay a bill but is thwarted by automated phone menus and a missing account number, which he blames on his wife. As his frustration with the call-centre agent, Mark, mounts, Sean's conversation veers from relatable annoyances about misplaced bills and keys to a chilling, whispered suggestion about "compensation" and "brain damage." Explore how mundane bureaucratic obstacles and Sean's misogynistic worldview escalate into a sinister proposition during a simple phone call, leaving the writer to decide what happens after the line goes dead. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: THE MOST CHILEAN MAN IN THE WORLD
prompt: Write a short story about Rodrigo, an impulsive Chilean man who travels to Leuven to win back Elisa, only to be harshly rejected and left to wander a cold, unfamiliar city. The story follows Rodrigo's disoriented journey as he grapples with loneliness, a peculiar dizziness, and the bitter irony of his situation, drawing parallels to the "chilliest man in the world" joke. Amidst his aimless drifting, Rodrigo finds unexpected camaraderie that helps him slowly piece together a bizarre, yet resilient, new sense of purpose and balance, symbolised by his two umbrellas. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Faerie Cony-catcher
prompt: Write a short story Nicholas Cantier, a clever but naive journeyman goldsmith in Elizabethan England, sets out from London with his most precious jewel, only to be lured into the Faerie Queen’s court by a deceptive country lass. After bargaining his way free with a strange faerie companion named Peasecod, Nicholas finds himself bound by a "weird": if he says "nay" to Peasecod for 24 hours, his gold will turn to leaves, his warrant to filth, and Peasecod to stone. The story should explore their journey and the unexpected joys and challenges of a love that embraces Peasecod's true, fluid nature. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: A Revolt of the Gods
prompt: Write a short story where the father, a deodorizer of dead dogs in the cat-worshipping city of Sardasa, is boycotted, sparking a retaliatory lock-out from his cats'-meat selling wife. This ignites an escalating, absurd conflict involving an insurrection of starving cats, a strike by the Federated Union of Old Maids, and a horrifying procession of reeking dead dogs. The narrative should explore how a domestic dispute in a bizarre society culminates in grotesque, city-wide annihilation. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: The Moment Before the Gun Went Off
prompt: Write a short story about Marais Van der Vyver, an Afrikaner farmer and local Party leader, after his gun accidentally kills Lucas, a young Black farmhand. Explore the public outcry and official inquiry on his farm in apartheid South Africa, which frames the incident as another act of white brutality, while delving into Van der Vyver's private grief and the profound, secret truth: Lucas was his son. The narrative should examine how the systemic injustices of apartheid complicate personal relationships and conceal devastating family secrets, even in the face of tragedy. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Beside the Madman's House
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, a child growing up beside the house famously known as 'the madman's house' in Siliguri. Explore the narrator's relentless childhood curiosity about the unseen occupant and the elusive nature of 'madness,' questioning what distinguishes the ordinary from the extraordinary. Delve into the family's evasiveness and the profound, philosophical lessons imparted by the Music teacher, especially after the bewildering event of objects like pots, pans, and books being mysteriously thrown from the neighbor's house, culminating in the discovery of a harmonium missing its black keys. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Lost City of Mars
prompt: Write a short story where Captain John Wilder, Cara Corelli, Sam Parkhill, and Harry Harpwell each journey into the newly-uncovered Lost City of Mars, a seemingly abandoned Martian metropolis now reanimated by ancient waters. Explore how the City, as a sentient entity, presents each visitor with their deepest desire, from an eternal stage for the actor Beaumont, to mechanical perfection for Parkhill, or a comforting illusion of youth for Corelli. Focus on the profound psychological impact of these "gifts" and whether any of the characters find genuine satisfaction or true freedom in the City's dangerous embrace, ultimately deciding whether to escape or remain lost within its dream. Your story must be approximately 10000 words long.

title: Angel Levine
prompt: Write a short story where Manischevitz, a Jewish tailor overwhelmed by relentless misfortune and his wife Fanny's grave illness, offers a desperate prayer for divine intervention, only to be visited by a mysterious Black man named Alexander Levine who claims to be a probationary angel. Explore Manischevitz's struggle with doubt and his reluctant journey into the unfamiliar world of Harlem to find Levine again, grappling with the angel's shifting appearances—from ragged to debauched—and the transformation of Bella's establishment, before finally accepting what he has been sent, forcing him to confront his preconceived notions of faith and salvation. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Helping Hands
prompt: Write a short story where Helene, a wealthy widow reeling from her husband's death, repeatedly visits the "Disabled Veterans of New Jersey Helping Hands" thrift shop in Trenton, driven by a desperate need for connection. Explore her increasingly unsettling bond with Nicolas Zelinski, a disabled veteran employee, as she projects her grief and desire to help onto him, leading to a blurring of boundaries, the erosion of her privileged life, and a shocking confrontation with exploitation. Your story must be approximately 15000 words long.

title: A Family Supper
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator returns to their estranged father's house in Kamakura, Japan, after their mother's death from fugu poisoning, anticipating a tense family supper with the Father and sister Kikuko. The reunion unfolds amidst unsettling memories of an old well and a plastic battleship model, as the family's fractured past and a chilling truth about Watanabe's fate subtly emerge, leading to a silent meal where the nature of the served fish remains dangerously unclear. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: (_) ~~~~ (-_-) The Warp and the Woof
prompt: Write a short story about an ancient manuscript written by the author Roger that surfaces in a fragmented, post-apocalyptic world and the series of strange, dangerous events that unfold as his unnamed literary agent and a distant transcriber named Amar attempt to process its contents, forcing them to confront the devastating implications of its origin and the true nature of Roger's past. Your story must be approximately 10000 words long.

title: Edison's Frankenstein
prompt: Write a short story following Archibald Chabane, an Algerian liaison at the 1893 Columbian Exhibition, as he discovers the electrocuted body of Tom Edison amidst gruesome evidence of grave-robbing and monstrous experiments fueled by forgotten electricity, forcing Chabane to choose between protecting a mysterious stranger and exposing the dark truth hidden beneath the Exhibition's gleaming "White City." Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: RURAL LIFE IN ENGLAND
prompt: Write a short story about an English gentleman returning to his country seat, where the tranquil beauty of manicured parkland, ancient groves, and meticulously tended gardens allows him to shed the cold formalities of city life. Explore how the deep connection to the land and the simple, honest interactions with laborers and villagers cultivate a unique sense of robust character, domestic bliss, and a quiet, enduring spirit, revealing the true moral fabric of the nation far from the hurried clamor of London. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Mirage
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, a surveyor on the high plains, encounters a series of increasingly bizarre and vivid mirages that challenge his perception of reality. The narrator must navigate a landscape where familiar objects like willows or distant trains transform into monstrous apparitions or entire phantom cities, testing his sanity and his understanding of the natural world. Explore the line between scientific explanation and an almost supernatural deception on the vast, empty plains. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Great Journey
prompt: Write a short story Rosa, a woman caught between her aging mother Mama's quiet dependence and Elena's sharp insistence on freedom, navigates the delicate tension of unfulfilled dreams. Rosa and Mama have long fantasized about a "great journey" to places like Gafsa, but Mama's frailties and Rosa's deep-seated guilt prevent any real action. Explore Rosa's yearning for escape as Elena, from her barren, book-strewn room, attempts to sever Rosa's ties, forcing her to confront the suffocating nature of her devotion and the true cost of independence. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: ALI BABA AND THE FORTY ALIENS
prompt: Write a short story about Alberto Barbarino, known as Ali, a loner who discovers a secret alien gold mine hidden in the disused Ballarat goldfields, accessible only by a spoken password. Explore the thrill and material gain Ali experiences from the gold nuggets, contrasted with the chilling disappearance of his brother Dean after Ali reluctantly shares the secret. The narrative should delve into Ali's subsequent transformation from an outcast into a popular figure, now sporting his coveted black leather jacket, while he grapples with his role in Dean's fate and the true cost of his newfound social acceptance, with the mysterious alien presence remaining unsettlingly close. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Automaton Ear
prompt: Write a short story about the unnamed narrator, a reclusive professor, driven to invent an "automaton ear" capable of hearing all sounds from the past. Detail the narrator's deepening isolation in the old gray church tower as they perceive both magnificent historical events and horrifying cries through the device. Explore the psychological unraveling as the narrator's grand ambition blurs the line between reality and delusion, culminating in a desperate act involving Mother Flinse and a chilling confrontation with the true nature of their own mind. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: THE SECRET MIRACLE
prompt: Write a short story about Jaromir Hladík, a writer condemned to death by a firing squad in Prague, who experiences a secret miracle: the physical world freezes in the instant before his execution. Given this sudden, incomprehensible pause in time, Jaromir must decide how to use his infinitely elongated moment, perhaps to finish a life's work, confront a past regret, or explore the strange new reality of his suspended existence before the fatal volley finally comes. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: If the War Continues
prompt: Write a short story where Emil Sinclair, a man with the ability to disappear from the world, returns to a dystopian 1920 where the war continues globally and has become the only "good thing" left. Explore his bewilderment as he navigates a city devoid of shops, where citizens require a "license to exist" and are arrested for wearing leather shoes, struggling to understand why society maintains such an all-consuming conflict at the cost of all human freedom and pleasure. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Charm
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Peter Goodwin, a lapsed Catholic English teacher at the Maurice Ducharme School in Scoggin, Maine, where his abstract appreciation for "Woman" becomes focused on Sister Mary Martha, a nun who writes evocative poetry, and Constance Lamontagne, a student who confides intimate secrets. Explore Peter’s quiet yearning for connection and meaning in a world where his faith is gone, even as the women around him seem suffused with a spiritual glow that eludes him, culminating in the school's destruction and his profound loneliness. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: The Museum of the Dearly Departed
prompt: Write a short story following Melanie Honing, who inherits the apartment of Vanessa Dillard after a gas leak kills Melanie's fiancé, Michael Salvatore, revealing his secret double life. As Melanie meticulously sifts through Vanessa's possessions, seeking answers about the betrayal, she finds herself drawn into the apartment building's complex tapestry of residents and their own deeply held secrets, including an artist's memorial project and an elderly couple's profound history of survival and complicated love. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: Dog Boys
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, Brandon, an outsider new to the dust and heat of Desert View and Rose Creek High. Follow his sudden entanglement in a conflict with the 66 Bandas after he defends Rita Young Deer, leading him to discover the ancient magic of the Kikimi tribe and an unexpected connection to their shape-shifting "dog boys." Explore Brandon's struggle to reconcile his suburban upbringing with his newfound identity and the dangerous, supernatural world he now inhabits, all while protecting his new friends from escalating gang violence. Your story must be approximately 10000 words long.

title: The Master of Rampling Gate
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Julie where she and her brother, Richard, arrive at Rampling Gate, a mysterious, ivy-mantled mansion their deceased father commanded them to tear down. Drawn by its gothic allure, Julie encounters an enigmatic young man, unchanged since a fleeting glimpse years ago, who is the true, ancient master of the house. She must navigate the unsettling truths of Rampling Gate and its master, balancing her father's "unspeakable horror" with her own intoxicating fascination. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Daddy Swore an Oath
prompt: Write a short story following Lila, a mother trying to shield her sons, True and Otis, from the escalating consequences of their father Briar's involvement in an armed standoff at the Little Charbonneau Wildlife Refuge. Explore Lila’s mounting dread as the family’s private life is thrust into the public eye by news vans and opportunistic relatives like Debra Lee, forcing Lila to confront her own complicity and the grim reality of her husband’s choices amidst the harsh winter landscape. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: ON THE ROAD
prompt: Write a short story where Sargeant, a homeless black man during the Depression, desperately seeks shelter from the cold and snow, eventually finding himself before a church whose doors are shut to him. Explore the surreal events that unfold when Sargeant's sheer will causes the entire church to crumble, freeing the stone Christ from its crucifix to walk alongside him, before Sargeant realizes the true, grim reality of his situation and whether the act of liberation can be repeated from behind jail cell bars. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Promise
prompt: Write a short story where an old man named Kamin, living a tranquil life in the village of Ressik with his wife Eline and children Meribor and Batai, finds his serene existence increasingly disrupted by suppressed memories from a past life. These memories, manifesting as vivid, painful visions of a starship crew, surface whenever Kamin tells bedtime stories, causing a "blackness" within him that he desperately tries to ignore. Explore Kamin's internal struggle as he grapples with the truth of his identity and the profound grief of lost connections, ultimately confronting the source of his pain with the quiet support of his daughter Meribor. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Out Of The Cradle, Endlessly Orbiting...
prompt: Write a short story where the unnamed narrator, Chief Co-ordinator of Project Ares on the Moon, prepares for the first static tests of the *Alpha* ship within Plato crater. The narrator's focus on technological milestones is challenged when a mysterious secret unfolds, revealing a profound shift in humanity's destiny beyond merely building spacecraft. Explore the narrator's experience of this unexpected event and its redefinition of what it means for mankind to truly conquer space, moving beyond the "cradle" of Earth. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: What a Thought
prompt: Write a short story about Margaret, a woman sitting quietly with her husband after a good dinner, whose mind is suddenly besieged by intrusive, violent thoughts about harming him. Explore the chilling contrast between her outward calm and the escalating internal urges, as mundane details of their domestic evening—a glass ashtray, a curtain cord, a simple offer of coffee—become sinister prompts for her dark imaginings. The question for Margaret is whether these unsettling thoughts are mere fleeting whims, or if the perverse impulse to act will finally break through the calm surface of her quiet home. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: The Murderer Guest
prompt: Write a short story where Elizabeth, a young girl, senses a profound unease as Mrs. Delehanty, a woman implied to be a murderer, comes to stay in her family's house. Explore Elizabeth's vivid internal world and her attempts to decipher the unspoken adult truths surrounding Mrs. Delehanty, from the nervous politeness of her parents to the unsettling feeling of being forced to eat food prepared by the guest. The story should delve into the psychological tension of a child grappling with a hidden, terrifying reality within her own home. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Christ in the House of Martha and Mary
prompt: Write a short story where Dolores, a young, tempestuous cook, resents her drudgery in a wealthy household, seeing her culinary art dismissed by her unappreciative patrons. Explore how the painter, who sketches in the kitchen, guides Dolores toward understanding her work as a profound creative act and a path to the "better part" of life, culminating in her powerful image immortalized in his painting of Christ in the House of Martha and Mary. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Snob
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of John Harcourt, a young student trying to maintain an air of sophistication for his girlfriend Grace at a bustling department store, where he suddenly spots his working-class father at the book counter. Explore John's intense shame and internal conflict as he attempts to avoid a public encounter, fearing Grace's perception and grappling with the silent, unspoken judgment that passes between father and son, leaving John with a gnawing sense of regret and the burden of his own snobbery. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: THE CONCERT
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, a former high-flyer who pursued extremes of wealth and then self-destruction, now finds solace in the perfectly ordinary. After experiencing the "extremely mediocre" Boyz II Men concert in a cheap arena with a chewing-gum floor and vandalised seat, the narrator embraces a new quest: to explore the limits of the commonplace. Show the narrator embarking on an adventure into the bland, contemplating what new "extremely run-of-the-mill" thing to experience next, and whether this pursuit of the ordinary can truly satisfy a man of extremes. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: Beautiful Grade
prompt: Write a short story where Bill, a law professor, attends Albert's New Year's Eve dinner party, an evening marked by Albert's ironic viewing of his past weddings and divorces. Explore the cynical, witty, yet deeply melancholic conversations among the academics and Bill's struggle to embrace the "present tense" while grappling with his age-gap relationship with Debbie, unspoken affections for Lina, and the lingering shadows of history and personal regret that unfold around the dining table. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: The Man Out of the Nose
prompt: Write a short story where John Hardshaw, the man who emerges daily from the nose of the face-like house in North Beach, continues his fifteen-minute pilgrimage to gaze at the dust-coated window of the factory that was once Elvira Barwell’s dwelling. Explore the profound, silent devotion of his unnamed wife, who meticulously maintains his appearance and supports their meager existence, as they grapple with the haunting remnants of a past tragedy that has shattered their former lives and confined them to this strange, repetitive routine. Delve into the psychological toll of this obsession and the unbreakable bond forged by shared misfortune. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: THE STORY OF MEDHANS LEA
prompt: Write a short story where Harland and his guests, Nare-Jones and Savelsan, spend an unsettling evening at Medhans Lea, a house notorious for its lingering and malicious spectres. Explore the psychological toll and physical manifestations that unfold as the house re-enacts its dark history: the disembodied cries of a tormented child, the sinister laughter of a figure in black, and the chilling apparition of a furrowed face at the billiard room window, all culminating in a violent, unseen assault that tests the courage and sanity of the occupants. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Current
prompt: Write a short story about Sienna, who, at a stifling potluck party, feels adrift and lost, avoiding her ex Nancy. When a mysterious woman named Clara appears and seems to "recognize" her, Sienna is drawn into Clara's unsettling orbit. Explore Sienna's internal conflict as she considers leaving the familiar world behind for Clara’s sparse, all-white house, wrestling with the fear and longing to embrace a new, transformative current that promises both peace and passion. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Prettiest Girls
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, a cynical Hollywood location scout, where he becomes entangled with Elsa Margarita, a strikingly beautiful and ambitious young woman from Tonalá, Mexico. Explore the power dynamics and emotional cost of their transactional relationship, as the narrator brings Elsa to America, only to confront her relentless pursuit of a glamorous life and his own possessive fears, culminating in a striking disappearance in Las Vegas. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: Good-bye, Robinson Crusoe
prompt: Write a short story about Piri, who lives a "second childhood" on the artificial Rarotonga Reef, a biome within Pacifica on Pluto, complete with gills and flippers. Follow Piri as his carefree existence, spent playing castaway and suppressing adult memories, is abruptly shattered by a catastrophic event and the arrival of Lee. Show his struggle to accept the forced reintegration with his past self, realizing his role as a former Finance Minister, and confronting the grim reality of an economic war that threatens to consume his artificial paradise and beloved childhood friends. Your story must be approximately 12000 words long.

title: Farmers in the Revenue Office
prompt: Write a short story about the ongoing, often absurd, war between the practical, land-bound world of farmers and the bureaucratic demands of the Revenue Office, as witnessed by the narrator. Explore how farmers, such as the Rügen farmer attempting to pay taxes with cabbages or the landowners using their wit to avoid a 'pencil thingummy,' clash with officialdom, culminating in a powerful scene of silent, collective resistance at an auction, where the very act of not speaking becomes a defiant stand against the loss of ancestral land. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: The Case of the Faithful Retainer
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Dr. Watson, where Sherlock Holmes races against time to retrieve a compromising letter that threatens to destabilize the British Empire on the eve of Queen Victoria's Diamond Jubilee. The investigation involves deciphering mysterious messages in newspaper personal columns, written in a unique burglar's argot, and outwitting an international spy who plans to use the letter for political mischief, culminating in a dramatic recovery from a most unusual hiding place, a tuba, amidst the Jubilee crowds. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: I Hate to Tell His Widow
prompt: Write a short story where Detective Joe Ragan grapples with the brutal murder of his closest friend, Ollie Burns, a case complicated by the police's immediate suspicion of Ollie's wife, Mary Burns. Following Ragan as he delves into the investigation, uncover a sophisticated blackmail ring hidden within the Upshaw Building, and explore the agonizing realization that the true perpetrators might be much closer—and more deceitful—than he could have imagined, forcing him to confront deep betrayals and personal loyalties. Your story must be approximately 14000 words long.

title: Back in that town
prompt: Write a short story about the unnamed narrator, an overweight trucker, as he takes an extended walk through a large, once-familiar town that has drastically changed. The narrator, feeling adrift and reflective, finds his attempt to reconnect with the past quickly unraveling after a persistent street hustler's bizarre offer of his 'little sister' for twenty quid hints at a darker, coercive undercurrent to the bustling city, leaving him vulnerable and profoundly uneasy. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: THE EYE OF HEAVEN
prompt: Write a short story where Torl, a squire at the plague-ridden Fort Car Bandoth, grapples with a terrible choice. After burying his master, Sir Kettigar, who returns as a spectral knight bound by an oath to light the ancient Eye of Heaven beacon, Torl must decide how to fulfill this duty. An invading Veyarri fleet is approaching across the stormy strait. The Eye's magic only responds to the living, forcing Torl to confront the profound sacrifice required to release Kettigar's spirit, and the devastating consequences that follow. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Godsend
prompt: Write a short story where Father Clemente, a young priest in the colonial town of Santo Niño, struggles with his faith and duties when a bright star appears, fulfilling an ancient prophecy of a God-Child born to free the island from Spanish rule. Explore the fervor of the local villagers, the cynicism of his elder priests, Father Julian and Father Melensio, and the brutal intervention of Isidro the blacksmith and his soldiers, leading to a tragic confrontation that shatters belief and exposes the harsh realities of power. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: The Howling Dogs of Taxco
prompt: Write a short story about Howie Steiner, a disenchanted Hollywood writer, who travels to Taxco, Mexico, seeking authentic experiences and pre-Columbian art. Explore his repeated encounters with Miguelito, a local "archaeological pirate," and the blurring lines between genuine cultural artifacts and masterful fakes. Delve into Steiner's naive desire for purity against the backdrop of Taxco's charming deceptions and the stark realities symbolized by the "howling dogs," considering the nature of truth, exploitation, and aspiration in a foreign land. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: JACK BALLISTER'S FORTUNES
prompt: Write a short story about Blackbeard, the notorious pirate captain, who hears of Governor Spottiswood's proclamation and the approach of Lieutenant Maynard's vessels at Ocracoke Inlet. Despite the impending naval attack, Blackbeard defiantly revels on shore, dancing grotesquely at a wedding and firing a pistol wildly among his men. The story should build tension towards the inevitable, brutal encounter between Blackbeard's pirate sloop and Maynard's schooner, culminating in a fierce, close-quarters battle where cannons roar and cutlasses clash until the pirate's ultimate, bloody defeat. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Burn
prompt: Write a short story where Joe Engel is the man called upon to comfort newly widowed women by sleeping in their dead husbands’ beds and providing them with an abundance of food. Explore how he navigates the grief of the living and the unexpected appearances of the deceased husbands’ ghosts, who range from irate to mundane. Show Joe’s unique methods for dealing with these lingering spirits, such as physically containing them, and how his culinary skills become intertwined with his unusual duties, even after his own death. Focus on the understated, matter-of-fact way the supernatural coexists with the everyday. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Little Bessie
prompt: Write a short story following Little Bessie as she relentlessly questions a seemingly simple theological concept, such as divine justice or the nature of suffering. Explore how her innocent yet piercing logic, informed by overheard conversations and details from science books, gradually unravels the comforting certainties of a well-meaning adult, leading to increasingly absurd or unsettling conclusions about faith and morality. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Erostratus
prompt: Write a short story following Paul Hilbert, a misanthropic man who believes himself superior to humanity and seeks infamy. He plans to commit a public massacre with his revolver on the Boulevard Edgar-Quinet, inspired by the ancient figure Erostratus, but his elaborate philosophical justifications clash with the terrifying reality of human contact and the act of violence. Explore Paul Hilbert's internal struggle as he descends from his detached seventh-floor vantage point into the teeming streets, confronting his escalating fear and the grotesque physicality of the world he despises. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: The White Road
prompt: Write a short story where Mister Fox, a charming and deceptive character, finds himself at an inn, trapped by the unfolding narratives of others. His intended bride recounts a terrifying dream of visiting his opulent house, describing it as a charnel house where he commits unspeakable acts against women. Explore how this dream, fueled by the unsettling presence of a pale fair girl, blurs the lines between fiction and horrifying truth, culminating in a violent confrontation with the intended's family when a grisly "hand" is revealed as proof of Mister Fox's monstrous nature, turning the trickster into the hunted. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Torch Goes Out
prompt: Write a short story following Janet Hunter as she prepares for her wedding reception in the meticulously manicured Wellington Gardens, a suburban haven separated from Inner London by a towering Wall. Janet grapples with her family's obsession with security and the illusion of safety, while sensing a deeper unease about her choices. Explore the simmering tension beneath the surface of the perfect event, leading to a dramatic breach of the Wall that shatters the fragile order and offers Janet an unexpected path to liberation from the life her parents and fiancé, Douglas, have planned. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: The Child Is the Meaning of This Life
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Jasper, the perceptive grandson in the Hart family, as he grapples with the enduring legacy of Ruth Hart's fierce devotion and its profound impact on her children. The story should explore how Samuel/Seymour's perpetual dependence, Rebecca's dutiful sacrifices, and Sarah's bitter pride are all shaped by their mother's unconditional love, leading to a complex web of loyalty and resentment that defines their lives within the confines of their New York City apartments across generations. Your story must be approximately 18000 words long.

title: BRIGHT SEGMENT
prompt: Write a short story where the unnamed narrator, a meticulous and isolated man, discovers a gravely injured young woman outside his apartment and brings her inside. Following his internal mantra of "I fix everything," he obsessively tends to her horrific wounds, using his janitor's ingenuity to save her life. Explore the unsettling devotion that grows in him as she heals, and the desperate lengths he will go to maintain his newfound purpose, even as the girl regains her speech and independence, threatening his carefully constructed reality. Your story must be approximately 11000 words long.

title: Lemming
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, who attends a Hallowe'en ghost tour in Echmond, meticulously tracking the trail of copycat suicides. The narrator follows the macabre path of their brother, the "Exceptional Copycat," who seems to be instigating these deaths at "hot spots" like the village's hangman tree due to his bizarre "quantum immortality." Explore the narrator's cynical quest to understand and potentially halt their brother's influence, all while grappling with their own unsettling inability to truly die, a curse that forces them into a perpetual, morbid day trip. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Flying
prompt: Write a short story where the unnamed narrator, after struggling with vivid dreams of a deep well and a limping crow, decides to master the art of flying, first in their mind, then making it a reality for all of Helsinki. Explore the sudden, joyous chaos as people abandon their mundane lives and take to the skies, picnicking on rooftops and celebrating a new, effortless existence, and what it means for a city when everyone can simply fly away. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: The Self-Seeding Sycamore
prompt: Write a short story where Jeannette, a recent widow, finds herself consumed by a furious battle against the invasive self-seeding sycamore from her neighbour Burt Cuss's neglected garden. Following Wyndham's death, Jeannette initially neglects her London garden, only to discover it overrun by thousands of resilient sycamore seedlings, symbolizing her overwhelming grief and lack of control. Explore her growing obsession with eradicating the "pest tree" and the unexpected, gruff connection that forms with Burt as her struggle against nature's relentless spread forces her out of self-imposed isolation. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: ANIMALCULA A Young Scientist's Guide to New Creatures
prompt: Write a short story where an amateur biologist, Alexander Beltley, inadvertently discovers the culinary potential of the bastrom, a creature that is most delicious when frightened. Explore the societal implications and moral compromises of a world where human pleasure is derived from the deliberate infliction of terror upon living organisms, considering how such practices desensitize individuals to suffering. Your story must be approximately 12000 words long.

title: Beatrice Trueblood's Story
prompt: Write a short story where Beatrice Trueblood, after being suddenly stricken with total deafness on the eve of her marriage to Marten ten Brink, discovers her condition may be a willed escape from a lifetime of "wrangles." Explore the unsettling nature of her eventual recovery and new marriage to Arthur Talbot, questioning if she has found true peace or merely traded one form of silence for another, as the "wrathful whitecaps" hint at persistent turmoil beneath a seemingly calm exterior. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: The Last Animal
prompt: Write a short story about Delilah, a woman on a Mexican vacation with her boisterous friend Marge, where Delilah seeks closure by burning the last letter from her husband Lew, who vanished thirty years prior. As she completes this ritual, Delilah begins to encounter a series of astonishing, rare marine animals and a mysterious man named Adam, whose presence blurs the line between mundane reality and inexplicable wonder. The story explores Delilah's quiet journey of letting go, her unexpected openness to the uncanny, and the profound, often bewildering, miracles she witnesses amidst her grief. Your story must be approximately 13000 words long.

title: A Spoiled Man
prompt: Write a short story following Rezak, a proud old man who cherishes his portable cubicle as a symbol of independence, as he enters the orbit of Sonya and the powerful Harouni family, exploring how their well-meaning yet detached patronage leads to unforeseen tragedy and a brutal encounter with the justice system, ultimately transforming his understanding of belonging and the cost of his newfound prosperity. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: The Doves' Nest
prompt: Write a short story about Milly and her Mother, Mrs. Wyndham Fawcett, as they navigate the rare social event of hosting Mr. Walter Prodger for lunch at the Villa Martin. Show how the mere presence of a male guest, smelling faintly of eau-de-Cologne, transforms their usually hushed household, invigorating their conversations and revealing unspoken longings for a world beyond their manicured garden gate. Include the staff's reactions, from Marie's dramatic orchid and palm arrangements to Yvonne's prized gorgonzola. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: IT FLOWS FROM THE MOUTH
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, a man accustomed to emotional detachment, accepts an invitation to visit his old friend Max and Max's wife Lisa years after the tragic death of their young son, Ian Wheeler. Arriving at their peculiar countryside home, the narrator finds himself increasingly unnerved by a large garden featuring an unsettling statue of Ian, and begins to observe disturbing, alternate realities through a specific bedroom window, leading to a confrontation with the true, horrifying manifestation of his friends' grief and Max's final, desperate act involving the gushing fountain. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: LAST WASH
prompt: Write a short story where Tom, a young carpenter, grapples with the unsettling revelation that his older girlfriend, Ida, once slept with a student's father. Set on a bitterly cold, snowy Saturday, the story explores the emotional fallout of this confession as Tom and Ida navigate their day, burdened by unspoken tensions, routine tasks like shoveling snow and laundry, and an increasingly surreal encounter with a strange hitchhiker named Denny. The narrative should capture the raw vulnerability and quiet absurdity of a relationship under strain, questioning what constitutes a "worst thing" and how trust survives difficult truths. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: An Account of Some Strange Disturbances in Aungier Street
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator and Tom Ludlow, two medical students, move into a sinister old house on Aungier Street in Dublin, only to be tormented by a series of disturbing and increasingly terrifying supernatural occurrences. The unsettling presence of the malevolent Judge Horrocks, a former occupant, manifests through recurring nightmares of his sinister portrait, disembodied sounds of bare feet, and even a monstrous rat. Witness the psychological toll this haunting takes as the residents' skepticism gives way to dread, forcing them to confront the house's dark history and the spectral figure still lurking within. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: Somnium, or Lunar Astronomy
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the Daemon narrator, one of the wise spirits who guides Fiolxhilde and others on a journey to the distant, mysterious island of Levania. Describe the arduous, dangerous trip to Levania, where travelers are lulled with narcotics and endure extreme cold. Detail the bizarre world of Levania, split into the Subvolva and Privolva hemispheres, where the colossal Volva dominates the sky and monstrous, rapidly growing creatures inhabit porous caves to escape the alternating fifteen-day cycles of scorching heat and freezing darkness. Explore the Daemon's observations of this alien world and its unique astronomical phenomena. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Unfired
prompt: Write a short story following Taul, an "unfired" guardian of pilgrims, on a perilous journey across a desolate wasteland inhabited by feral humans and the powerful Third Race. title: Long Ride Home

title: GIRL WITH CURIOUS HAIR
