title: The Stern-Gerlach Mice
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, who after an encounter with a giant Stern-Gerlach mouse on Nana's street, develops the ability to hear human thoughts as an incessant babble. This new, debilitating sense forces the narrator to grapple with the ongoing war against the intelligent, size-shifting rodents and the unacknowledged artistic talent of the Tin Beggar, all while trying to maintain sanity in a world where internal monologues are no longer private. The story explores the strange, cynical new normal in Jerusalem following the mouse invasion. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Confirmation Suit
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, a young boy in Dublin facing his Confirmation, where he dreads wearing a custom-made suit with "big buttons and little lapels" crafted by Miss McCann and orchestrated by his well-meaning but eccentric Aunt Jack and grandmother. The story should capture the humor and anxiety of navigating family expectations and religious rites, culminating in his desperate attempts to hide the suit on the big day, and exploring the true meaning of the garment in his life. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Worse Than The Curse
prompt: Write a short story following Princess Babette, initially a vain royal, after she is cursed by the wizard Vladimirror to gain weight, leading to her being shunned in her own palace. Explore Babette's journey as she leaves incognito to seek Vladimirror's "cure," discovering unexpected allies in Fifi La Fey and the woodcutter Burl, and ultimately learning that true beauty and her kingdom's salvation lie not in a lost figure but in her newfound character and the genuine affection of others. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: The Midnight Zone
prompt: Write a short story where the unnamed narrator, alone with her two young sons at a remote Florida hunting camp after her husband departs, suffers a severe head injury and must contend with her own disorientation and vulnerability as her children unexpectedly step into caregiver roles. Explore the chilling reality of maternal fragility and the stark, primal fears of the wilderness, as the boys navigate the dark cabin and the vast, indifferent landscape surrounding them, waiting for a promised return that may never come. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Loyalty
prompt: Write a short story where Wes, a grounded mechanic, receives an unexpected postcard from his first wife, Corinne, announcing her return years after abandoning their family. Corinne, now disheveled and disoriented, arrives at the bus station with two brown paper bags, prompting Wes to bring her back to a household already balanced by his current wife, Astrid, their daughter Lucy, his son Jeremy, and his mother Dolores. The story explores the quiet duty and complex loyalties that unfold as Wes's family attempts to integrate or reconcile with the "runaway mom" and the unsettling past she embodies. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: The Blind Man's Sighted Daughters
prompt: Write a short story where Helen, the sole caregiver for her blind and increasingly abusive father, Lyle Sebera, struggles with his physical and mental decline within their decaying Sparta, New York house. Explore the suffocating burden of her duty as her father reminisces about old grievances and demands to die, all while the unsettling family secret of a decades-old double homicide implicating Lyle Sebera hovers unspoken between Helen and her visiting sister, Abigail. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: FANTASTIC NIGHT
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, a wealthy Viennese gentleman suffering from years of emotional apathy, experiences a sudden, intoxicating reawakening after inadvertently stealing a winning betting slip from a man named Lajos at the Prater racetrack. Explore how this single, petty crime shatters his deep-seated ennui, propelling him into a night of unexpected, fervent sensation, profound human connection, and a new, almost dizzying understanding of life's vibrant chaos, far removed from his polite, indifferent existence. Your story must be approximately 22000 words long.

title: JUST PEACE
prompt: Write a short story following Chente, an agent from Earth, arriving on the technologically regressed colony world of New Canada on delta Pavonis II, where he discovers his predecessor was murdered amidst warring nation-states like the puritanical New Providence and the feudal Ontarian Confederacy. Explore Chente's ruthless mission to force these factions into cooperation, using deception and advanced Earth technology like communications bombs, against the backdrop of a planet teetering on the brink of another catastrophic core collapse. Your story must be approximately 15000 words long.

title: THE CHRISTMAS DINNER
prompt: Write a short story following the narrator as a guest at Bracebridge Hall, where the jovial Squire hosts a Christmas dinner steeped in ancient English customs. Describe the festive great hall, the procession of the boar's head, and the circulating Wassail Bowl. Explore the lively interactions among the eccentric family and guests, culminating in Master Simon leading a boisterous Christmas mummery. The story should capture the warmth, humor, and nostalgic charm of this celebration, questioning what it means to preserve traditions in a changing world. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The End of the Story
prompt: Write a short story following Christophe Morand, a law student sheltering at the abbey of Périgon, as he succumbs to a dangerous obsession with a forbidden manuscript. This text details a knight's descent into the mythical depths beneath the Château des Faussesflammes. When Christophe discovers these very ruins from his window, he is compelled to follow, seeking the beautiful, ancient sorceress Nycea and the intoxicating, illusory world she conjures, even as the abbot Hilaire warns of ultimate damnation. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: THE MONA LISA
prompt: Write a short story where Sergeant Zhao Heng Lopez and her Marines are sent to investigate the UNSC prison transport Mona Lisa, drifting eerily in the Halo debris field. They soon discover the ship is not just compromised by Covenant, but by the relentless, mutating Flood infection that transforms both human and Elite bodies into grotesque monsters. Lopez must lead her dwindling squad through the ship's ravaged decks, battling the visceral horrors and the insidious treachery of ONI operatives, as she makes desperate choices to contain the escalating threat and survive a mission more perilous than any combat. Your story must be approximately 35000 words long.

title: Hot Eyes, Cold Eyes
prompt: Write a short story about the narrator, a woman intensely aware of the "hot eyes" of men, whose pervasive gazes make her feel invaded throughout her day. After enduring hours of this unsettling attention, she deliberately transforms her appearance and steps out into the city's night, seeking out specific male gazes. Explore the unsettling shift in her perception, how she comes to relish the very attention that once tormented her, and the chilling, ritualistic collection she keeps in a box after her encounters. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Jealousy
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Liza, a young girl whose entire world feels upended by a perceived slight, such as Nanny's affectionate praise for another child while cooking jam on the terrace. Explore Liza's vivid internal drama, where ordinary objects like "murky blue stockings" become omens of death, and small acts of favoritism escalate into profound despair and thoughts of her own demise. The narrative should capture the intense, fleeting nature of childhood emotions, leading to a sudden, simple resolution that shifts her from imagined tragedy back to the joys of the present moment, perhaps involving a shared treat like jam foam. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: The Match
prompt: Write a short story where Lennox returns home from a disappointing Notts County football match, his irritability amplified by his team's unexpected loss and his failing eyesight, leading to a brutal domestic dispute over supper with his wife, Mrs. Lennox, and culminating in her decision to leave him and the children. Explore how the public disappointment of the match funnels into his private rage, exposing the raw, bleak undercurrents of his life in the Meadows suburb. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Neither hide nor hair
prompt: Write a short story about Finn, a stubborn and opinionated boy who, after a bitter argument with his mother, runs away into the impenetrably deep woods. Describe his gradual transformation into a wilder, simpler being, losing his memories and even his name, until a chance rediscovery forces him to confront the life he left behind and decide if he truly belongs there or in the wilderness with his newfound companion, the dog. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Black Bear in the Snow
prompt: Write a short story following Randall, a father estranged from his son, Joey, as he takes the boy on a hunting trip to Alberta, hoping to forge a bond that has long been absent. Explore the quiet tension between them in the snow-covered wilderness as Randall tries to recreate a pivotal experience from his own youth with his father, armed with a rifle and a memory of a black bear that never appeared. Consider the weight of expectations and the impact of the past on their strained relationship, culminating in a striking moment in the hunting hide. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Possibility of Evil
prompt: Write a short story where Miss Adela Strangeworth, a revered pillar of her quiet town, meticulously maintains her perfect home and famous roses, believing herself the sole guardian against unseen wickedness. Show her daily routine of polite interactions and secret letter-writing, where she anonymously disseminates veiled accusations and cruel judgments to her neighbors on colored paper. Explore the chilling disconnect between her serene public facade and her private campaign to 'cleanse' the town, leading to the shattering revelation of her hidden malice and its devastating consequences for her carefully cultivated world and beloved roses. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: THE PACT
prompt: Write a short story where Catherine travels to meet Leon on a desolate English seaside pier, both nearing forty, to potentially fulfill a university pact they made years ago: to marry if neither was wed by that age. Explore the lingering feelings, the surprising physical chemistry that sparks between them after two decades of platonic friendship and separate lives, and the re-evaluation of a bond that began as a joke but reveals itself to be a profound connection, leading to a decision about their future. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Bogeyman of Boora Bog
prompt: Write a short story about the young Druid Eoghan Ó Cinnéide, sent to a village near Boora Bog to halt its unnatural expansion, where he must also investigate the unsettling disappearances of villagers and livestock attributed to a "bogeyman." Following a trail of human bones and strange footprints, Eoghan confronts another Druid, Dubhlainn Ó Meara, who justifies his monstrous acts by claiming they serve Gaia, forcing Eoghan to question the very foundations of Druidic law and the nature of justice against a powerful, morally ambiguous foe. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: The World's Biggest Rip-Off
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator whose family vacation has become a series of disappointments, from the Baseball Hall of Fame to Niagara Falls. After yet another failed stop at the Guinness World Records Museum, the narrator's attention is captured by a mysterious, expensive exhibit labeled "WORLD'S BIGGEST RIP-OFF" that promises no refunds. Despite his wife's strong objections and the considerable cost, the narrator insists on the family experiencing this final, perplexing attraction, hoping to find some unexpected value amidst the trip's many letdowns. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: Easy Pickings
prompt: Write a short story where Marvin, a small-time thief called Big Blade, believes the residents of rural Louisiana will be "easy pickings" and attempts to rob Mrs. Landreneaux, an eighty-five-year-old Acadian woman. Explore how Marvin's expectations are dramatically upended by Mrs. Landreneaux's surprising resilience, her incessant talking, and the unexpected, community-driven intervention from her card-playing neighbors like Mrs. Breaux and Deputy Sid, leading to a comically disastrous outcome for the so-called Big Blade amidst chicken stew and a rising plastic toast. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: THE WHITE CAT OF DRUMGUNNIOL
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Dan Donovan, an elder living at Drumgunniol, where a sinister white cat with gleaming green eyes appears as an inescapable omen of death for members of his family. The story explores the foreboding presence of this creature, linked to a past injustice involving Connor Donovan and Ellen Coleman, as Dan recounts the chilling encounters and the pervasive dread that has afflicted generations of his kin, building suspense around the cat's appearances. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Stella Infantes
prompt: Write a short story where Dr. Maureen Fitzberger, a genetic engineer aboard an interstellar scout-colony ship bound for Bonfils, discovers she is unexpectedly pregnant. Confronted with the harsh realities of raising a child in an alien environment, she proposes a radical plan to genetically adapt her daughter, Stella Dare, for life on the new planet, facing both scientific challenges and ethical questions from Captain Johnson and the crew about shaping the future of humanity. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Helen Keller and Anne Sullivan
prompt: Write a short story where Helen Keller exists in a silent, dark world, burdened by unexpressed thoughts and a deep, simmering frustration. Explore her experience of this pre-linguistic existence, marked by impulsive outbursts and a profound isolation, until Anne Mansfield Sullivan’s arrival introduces a persistent, often challenging effort to connect symbols with meaning. The narrative should build toward a pivotal, sensory moment at the well-house where the feeling of cool water over her hand, paired with the spelling of "water," sparks a sudden, revelatory understanding that transforms her inner landscape from one of darkness to boundless light and the vibrant realization that everything has a name. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: THE DEAD
prompt: Write a short story where Ilena, a university instructor, navigates a world increasingly distorted by a constant intake of yellow, pink, and green-and-aqua pills to manage her anxiety, insomnia, and the slow dissolution of her marriage to Bryan. Explore her fragmented perception as her career strangely flourishes with a scandalous novel, "Death Dance," even as her affairs with men like Gordon unravel, and the line between reality and hallucination blurs, leaving her questioning what it means to be "normal" or even truly alive when her own body feels like formless protoplasm. Your story must be approximately 13000 words long.

title: DRINKING GAMES
prompt: Write a short story where the amateur assassin Rikki, struggling to dispose of Elio Testrail's body through a faulty airlock on an interstellar cruise ship, is interrupted by the enigmatic Misha, who initiates an elaborate public charade to cover their tracks. Explore Rikki's mounting frustration and reluctant compliance as Misha's bizarre tactics escalate, revealing he knows her true identity and a shared, traumatic past, forcing her into a dangerous, unexpected alliance. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Manikins
prompt: Write a short story where Evelyn Winters, a student, interviews Barbara Endicott, diagnosed with paranoid schizophrenia, at the formidable Bedford Institution. As Barbara describes a world where "males" are in fact women infested by blind, immobile parasites, and true women reproduce painlessly via virgin birth, Evelyn's initial professional detachment erodes. Explore the unnerving process as Evelyn's own reality begins to unravel under the weight of Barbara's unwavering conviction, forcing her to confront a terrifying possibility: that everything she believes about her identity and the world might be a carefully constructed lie. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Tied and Twisted
prompt: Write a short story where Addie attends Kink Kamp with her Master, Mason, seeking the unique mental peace she calls "ropespace." Describe the intense physical and emotional journey as Mason uses intricate rope bondage, suspension, and prolonged orgasm denial to push Addie to her limits. Explore how Addie navigates the extreme sensations, the presence of others in the scene, and her profound trust in Mason to find a rare state of quiet in her usually chaotic mind, culminating in a powerful release and deeper connection. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Fifteen Painted Cards from a Vampire Tarot
prompt: Write a short story about the unromanticized existence of vampires, where eternal life manifests in mundane, unsettling, or even tragic forms, from the perspective of a character like the young man seeking immortality in the graveyard or an ancient vampire weary of the centuries. Explore how vampirism reflects human desires, fears, and societal absurdities, whether through a vampire queen on a daytime talk show, a genetically engineered space colonist, or a baby accused of monstrous acts. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Still, Cold Air
prompt: Write a short story where Russell takes possession of his deceased parents' dilapidated house on a brutally cold winter day, a place physically decaying with sagging roofs and drafty walls, where the extreme cold seems to carry the lingering essence of his estrangement and past neglect. Explore Russell's growing unease as he confronts the physical embodiment of his family's history, wondering if the house's collapse is inevitable or if something more chilling has been "let in" from the snow-covered world outside, carrying the weight of his guilt and his sisters' resentment. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Augustus
prompt: Write a short story where Augustus, granted universal adoration through a magical wish by Mr. Binsswanger, finds his life of effortless charm and luxury becomes hollow and devoid of true joy. Explore his cynical descent and the eventual profound suffering he endures after wishing for the power to love, which strips him of his superficial appeal but opens his heart to genuine human connection, culminating in a serene return to the simple magic of his childhood on Mostack Street. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: The Sleck
prompt: Write a short story about Rob, a grieving father, who, on the anniversary of his daughter Bethany's death, returns to the treacherous Sleck, a forbidden patch of wilderness. Drunk and despairing, he climbs through the broken chain-link fence to confront the black, oily, pond-lady that emerges from the stagnant water, embodying the ancient, hungry nature of the Sleck itself. The story should explore Rob's desperate, fumbling attempt to exact vengeance or find understanding, and the creature's chilling response to his accusations, as the Sleck prepares to face its own destruction by modern development. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Privy Councillor
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator recounts the fervent preparations and deep disillusionment surrounding the visit of their grand relative, Privy Councillor Ivan, to the provincial Kochuyevka estate. Following the overwhelming arrival of Ivan and his valet, the household of Klavdia Arkhipovna is consumed by efforts to impress, yet the urbane visitor, with his constant "upon my soul" pronouncements, is revealed as a self-absorbed and disruptive presence. Explore the comic and ultimately melancholic clash between provincial life and city affectation, culminating in a dramatic outburst involving the tutor Pobedimsky and the bailiff Fyodor concerning Tatyana Ivanovna, and Ivan's abrupt, costly departure. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: The Ghosts of Memory
prompt: Write a short story where Terrance Colby is haunted by the mysterious disappearance of his friends Paige, Darren, and Cynthia inside the abandoned house on Sutter Lane. Years after the incident, Terrance tries to understand why he was spared while his friends vanished in a strange "cold spot," continuing to research the unsettling history of the condemned property and its connection to other missing persons, even as the house itself is torn down. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: BUDS AND BIRD VOICES
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator in their old mansion, observing the arrival of a long-awaited spring after a harsh winter. The story should explore the narrator's contemplative thoughts on the contrasting beauty of new life—such as the verdant islands emerging from the swollen river and the melodies of songbirds—against the persistent signs of decay, like the moss-covered mansion and withered lilac shrubs. Question whether the human spirit can truly escape its "moral winter" and embrace renewal, or if the gray past inevitably clings like "withered leaves." Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Incompetent Magician
prompt: Write a short story where Lythande, the enigmatic Pilgrim Adept marked by a blue star, undertakes a mission in Old Gandrin to reclaim Rastafyre's stolen magic wand from the thief Roygan. Haunted by a strict vow to Law and the personal cost of immense power, Lythande encounters the enchanted lute that holds the spirit of Koira, a former love, forcing a profound choice between reclaiming a cherished past and upholding a solemn oath to justice, even if it means sacrificing personal desires. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: The Ghost of Dive Bomber Hill
prompt: Write a short story where Mick, a seasoned truck driver, navigates the treacherous two-lane Highway 25 past Dive Bomber Hill, a route haunted by the protective ghost of Bessie's husband. Explore the loyalties and dangers of old-school trucking life as a brewing feud between Bessie's family and local troublemakers escalates, forcing Mick and his fellow drivers to confront whether the supernatural presence on the road helps or hinders their fight for justice in the rugged Kentucky hills. Your story must be approximately 11000 words long.

title: Visitors
prompt: Write a short story where Jeanne makes the long, weekly drive from Grangeville to the Idaho State Correctional Institution in Kuna to visit her son, Rob, navigating the desolate landscapes and the sterile prison environment. The narrative should explore Jeanne's quiet determination and the emotional weight of her duty, even as she grapples with the uncommunicated truths and the chasm growing between them. The story will delve into Jeanne's internal world as she discovers the shoebox of letters Rob has been sending to Neil Leisure, the father of the boy he killed, revealing a hidden side of Rob's past tied to the wars and forcing Jeanne to confront what she truly knows about her son. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: MEMORY IN WHITE
prompt: Write a short story following Young Pancho Villa the Third, a former boxer whose punch-drunk mind clings to a singular vision of respectability as a boxing announcer. Pancho, in his immaculate white suit and Panama hat, proudly wields a megaphone in the Grand Street gymnasium, despite his inarticulate speech drawing only laughter. Explore how his desperate pursuit of this dream escalates into a fatal confrontation with Soldier Conlon, who relentlessly torments Pancho by defiling his pristine white outfit, leading to a tragic end under the arc lights of the boxing ring. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: On the First Day of Lent
prompt: Write a short story about the Warden of a desolate penitentiary, on the first day of Lent, who finds himself inexplicably compelled to grant prisoner Aristo a twenty-four-hour leave, even bestowing upon him his deceased father's exquisite suit. The narrative should follow Aristo as he exploits this unexpected freedom, using a decommissioned pistol and a stolen theatrical wedding dress to pursue a brazen plan for marriage, while back at the prison, the Warden grapples with the strange consequences of his decision and the unraveling of his bleak routine. Your story must be approximately 15000 words long.

title: FOOD FOR FRIENDSHIP
prompt: Write a short story about Robeson and Smyth, two stranded spacemen on the barren planet Mirab IV, who are starving amidst profuse but poisonous alien plant life. They refuse to sign a five-year contract with the cruel factor McKief for basic sustenance, instead devising a desperate plan for passage on a Rigelian ship where Smyth must pose as Robeson's "food supply" to escape. Explore the physical and psychological toll of this dehumanizing deception as the journey's duration is unexpectedly extended, forcing them to confront the true cost of their survival. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Inheritance
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator following the death of David, the daring test pilot. After David's final flight in the A.21, the narrator and Jimmy Langford visit David's family in the Conway Valley, trying to make sense of the loss and the pilot's unsettling belief in a shared premonition dream. Explore the quiet dread that settles as David's young son, also named David, seems to recognize Jimmy, hinting at a continuation of his father's peculiar destiny. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: DEVIL DOGS
prompt: Write a short story where Captain Halley leads a Colonial Marine squad aboard the derelict ArmoTech research station Trechman Two, tasked by corporate agent Kalien with retrieving a computer core and encountering a dangerous Yautja that has escaped containment. Explore Halley’s desperate fight for survival against the alien and the station’s collapsing integrity, all while battling her dependence on phrail painkillers and the chilling prophecy of her mother. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Fortune's Always Hiding
prompt: Write a short story where Dave, a London football hooligan, finds his brutal world shaken by his infatuation with Samantha, a woman seeking horrific revenge for the corporate negligence that left her without limbs. Explore the conflict between his ingrained violence and a burgeoning loyalty that pushes him towards acts far beyond his usual brawls, leading to a grim reckoning involving figures like Bruce Sturgess and the toxic legacy of Tenazadrine. Your story must be approximately 24000 words long.

title: The Selfish Giant
prompt: Write a short story about the Selfish Giant's garden, which remains shrouded in an eternal winter while the rest of the world experiences Spring, with the Snow, Frost, and North Wind as its only inhabitants. Explore the Giant's growing bewilderment and isolation as his magnificent peach trees never blossom and birds cease to sing, until a moment of profound empathy for a small, weeping child at a barren tree prompts a radical transformation of his heart and his walled domain. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: In the Late Cretaceous
prompt: Write a short story about Dr. Sarah Wright, a paleontologist who finds her department under siege by the jargon-spouting "educational consultant" Dr. Jerry King. As the university succumbs to budget cuts and relentless parking tickets, Sarah must decide whether to endure the absurd, bureaucratic "restructionary implementation," fight a futile battle, or "evolve" by pursuing a radical, personal escape from a world where her ancient expertise is deemed utterly irrelevant. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: CLOCKWORKS
prompt: Write a short story about Rosa Lind, a young woman whose life is dictated by the large, whirring cardiac regulator tethered to her side in a gaslit, machine-driven world. When the earnest clockmaker Mr. Greenberg expresses more interest in her medical device than in her, explore Rosa's journey from initial frustration to a surprising connection, as his scientific pursuit offers her a path to an unimaginable freedom. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: ALL TOMORROW'S PARTIES
prompt: Write a short story following the narrator, an ancient transcendent being, as she drifts through a simulated Earth populated by "puppets" and "partials," designed for her clade's century-long gathering. Despite the endless parties and recreated historical eras—from Jazz Age Paris with her partial lover to a dinosaur-filled Antarctica—she experiences a profound ennui, searching for meaning in a reality where nothing is truly new. Her journey leads to a confrontation with a mysterious clone from a "human" faction, who argues that her immortality is a danger to evolution, forcing her to re-evaluate the purpose of endless existence. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Theatre Macabre The Dark Exile
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Samuel Drest, a disgraced playwright chained in a dungeon cell, as he recounts to Constable Rantz and the enigmatic Zakarum Priest Malchus the twisted tale of how his bitter rivalry with Marlowe, fueled by artistic jealousy and an opium addiction, led to murder and a macabre encounter with a reanimated corpse, culminating in the creation of his supposedly demon-inspired play, "The Dark Exile," which Malchus reveals was designed to unleash cosmic horrors upon the world through the very act of its performance. Your story must be approximately 10000 words long.

title: Getting Dirty
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Cassie, a woman who nightly embraces the role of a street prostitute for her partner, Jake, navigating the grimy allure of San Francisco's Capp Street and the secluded heights of Twin Peaks. Detail the performance of her degradation, from negotiating her price down to twenty dollars amidst the threat of real street toughs, to her intense, intimate encounters with Jake in his car. Explore how this long-standing, transgressive fantasy allows Cassie to experience profound arousal and control, despite its superficial appearance of abandonment, blurring the lines between pleasure, power, and the deeply personal act of "getting dirty." Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: 'A Sad Tale's Best for Winter'
prompt: Write a short story where Selwyn Macgregor, a man living by a graveyard, maintains his unique, whisky-fueled routine despite the provisions of his Aunt Macgregor's will, which stipulates he must look after his health. Explore his "contemplation of corruption" and his charming defiance as he interacts with Mr. Brown, the trustee, who tries to persuade him to leave his unhealthy dwelling and peculiar occupation. Show how Selwyn's unconventional spirit eventually "corrupts" the well-meaning Mr. Brown, leaving a lasting impression even after the graveyard is leveled. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Cargo
prompt: Write a short story where Tech Sergeant Davis, a seasoned Loadmaster on a C-141 StarLifter, is tasked with transporting hundreds of coffins filled with the victims of Jonestown in November 1978. Following the unsettling pleas of the young airman Hernandez and the nurse Pembry, Davis must confront mysterious sounds of children playing emanating from the cargo hold. Explore the psychological toll this impossible task takes on Davis and his crew as they struggle to maintain their military professionalism against the backdrop of unimaginable horror and the chilling reality of what is inside the sealed aluminum boxes. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Wives, Submit Yourselves to Your Husbands
prompt: Write a short story about Madame la Maréchale de Grancey, a woman of sharp wit and unyielding independence, who, upon encountering a widely accepted text or dogma dictating female submission, finds her sense of justice deeply offended. The story follows her spirited and eloquent arguments with the diplomatic Abbé de Châteauneuf, as she meticulously dissects and rejects the idea of women's obedience, challenging traditional societal and religious assertions of male superiority and revealing the true nature of her freedom. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: Nashtaneer– The Broken Nest
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Charulata, a young wife isolated by her husband Bhupati's obsessive newspaper work, who finds an unexpected intellectual and emotional outlet through her cousin-in-law Amal. Her secret literary endeavors and growing intimacy with Amal eventually lead to a profound but unspoken love, which shatters when Amal leaves for England, forcing Charulata to navigate a landscape of quiet yearning and the painful truth of her broken domestic life. Your story must be approximately 18000 words long.

title: Fixing Hanover
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, a skilled mechanic living in the isolated village of Sandhaven, is tasked by the stern leader Blake with "fixing Hanover," a mysterious metal man salvaged from the sea. The narrator, who has hidden his true identity as a brilliant engineer from a powerful, conquering Empire, must confront whether his unique ability to repair will inevitably lead to revealing his past and bringing ruin to the community he has come to call home, especially as Hanover begins to stir and click with an ominous purpose. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: GREAT ALCOHOLIC-OWNED BED AND BREAKFASTS OF THE EASTERN SEABOARD
prompt: Write a short story where the unnamed narrator, a perpetually drunk widower, attempts to run a dilapidated bed and breakfast with the help of his mature stepson, the boy. A new guest, Ms. Brunell, arrives, sparking a series of bizarre and unsettling events that expose the narrator's chaotic life, from shooting a raccoon on the roof to observing a child abduction, all while he grapples with his own unreliable reality and the weight of unfulfilled promises. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Hello, America!
prompt: Write a short story where Henry Stevens, a young Englishman employed at old Herrmann's little white diner during the Great Depression, struggles between his desperate need for security and his burgeoning empathy for the transient men frequenting the station yard. Explore Henry's internal conflict as Herrmann's suspicious rules clash with Henry's desire for human connection and his secret acts of giving soup, forcing him to choose between a meager comfort and the ideals of a new, harsh America. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: TRANSIENTS IN ARCADIA
prompt: Write a short story where Madame Héloise D'Arcy Beaumont and Harold Farrington meet at the exclusive Hotel Lotus, a hidden oasis in July Manhattan, each believing the other to be a wealthy socialite escaping the heat. Explore their carefully constructed personas and the subtle courtship that blossoms amidst the hotel's artificial luxury, leading to a surprising mutual revelation of their true, ordinary identities and shared desire for a week of temporary "arcadia" before returning to their working lives. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: How Pearl Button was Kidnapped
prompt: Write a short story about Pearl Button following her journey with the two women in red and yellow and green. Explore her shifting perceptions as she leaves the House of Boxes, discovers the uninhibited joy of a community by the sea, delights in fruit, laughter, and the wildness of the ocean, and then experiences the sudden return of the little blue men who reclaim her for her previous life. Focus on her innocent sensory impressions and the contrast between her two vastly different worlds. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: A Reversal of Fortune
prompt: Write a short story where Nikki, a young woman struggling through a dismal summer in her trailer park, makes a desperate bargain with the Devil to save her beloved pit bull, Boo, after he is hit by a car. Follow Nikki as she confronts the enigmatic old man from the bus, agreeing to an eating contest for her soul, and discovers the extraordinary, and somewhat disgusting, lengths she must go to outwit him when the wager involves sour gummy frogs and a literal battle of appetites. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Getting Of the Cat
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator acquires a large, unpredictable cat named Hank, a decision made to cement a specific identity. Explore how Hank's sometimes "sociopathic," sometimes endearing, presence in the narrator's flat in the warehouse district begins to unravel her present isolation and illuminate complex memories of her 'catlike' mother. Follow the narrator as she navigates brief, awkward encounters with figures like Mrs. Kowalski and a new date, finding that the cat's demanding affection and baffling independence force her to confront her own patterns of emotional connection and detachment. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: My Mother's Lover
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, who after the death of her mother, Mrs Srivastava, discovers that the woman she knew as a simple housewife was a celebrated poet, publishing secretly under pseudonyms like Kutumb and Atithi. The narrator must then grapple with the profound shock of this hidden life, the revelation of a deep intellectual and emotional connection with a man named Abhimanyu Singh, and the challenge of piecing together the true identity of a mother she never fully knew. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: PAYING GUEST
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Mrs. Mehta, a woman in Delhi whose social standing is inextricably tied to her son Amrit's artistic reputation. Explore her increasing desperation and migraines as Amrit shows more interest in disco than painting, leading her to bring the charismatic but enigmatic artist Basu Lal into her home as a guru. Delve into the escalating social rivalry with Mrs. Mahajan, further complicated by the arrival of the beautiful American paying guest, Ana, whose presence exposes the superficiality and betrayals lurking beneath the veneer of artistic and social ambition. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Swanwatch
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Swan, an exile on the Fermata, a remote station where artists are tasked with creating a masterpiece to earn their freedom. Swan, a musician by name, must grapple with composing a symphony for the Swanships, vessels that ritually plunge into a black hole as a form of suicide art, and navigate the cynical wisdom of her fellow exiles, Dragon, Tiger, and Phoenix, while she discovers the true meaning of art and sacrifice in this strange prison. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Party
prompt: Write a short story where Ernesto attends a party at Máximo's restaurant, anxiously awaiting the arrival of Joaquin Rivera, a legendary figure returning from Cuba. Explore how the gathering of old Cuban exiles, each holding onto different versions of their shared past, forces Ernesto to confront long-buried memories of betrayal and the fluid nature of truth. The story should capture the humid, melancholic atmosphere of the celebration, where hushed conversations about past heroism and hidden secrets blend into the background hum, making Ernesto question the solidity of his own recollections and the identities of those around him. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Big Medicine
prompt: Write a short story about Old Billy Dunbar, an aging prospector hiding in a desert wash in Apache country, who must outwit a group of Apaches while protecting his valuable gold claim. Trapped in a hidden hollow with his burros, Jennie and Julie, Billy discovers a wolf's den and devises a cunning plan involving mud figures, wolf hair, and Apache superstitions to convince his pursuers he is a powerful "wolf-man" and secure his freedom and the gold needed for his family. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Missed
prompt: Write a short story where Uhura, Dr. McCoy, Mr. Spock, and Chief Engineer Scott each secretly discover and harbor a single tribble aboard the *Enterprise* following the great infestation. Depict their individual, clandestine efforts to keep the fuzzy creature hidden from Captain Kirk, navigating their personal ethics and surprising affection against Starfleet protocol, until a final confrontation in the briefing room reveals their shared, rule-bending attachments. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: THE DEBT PAID LATE
prompt: Write a short story where Margaret, a weary doctor's wife seeking solace at an isolated Tyrolean inn, recognizes Peter Sturz, a decrepit and drunken man from the village poorhouse, as the once-revered actor and idol of her youth. Explore Margaret's internal struggle with a long-suppressed memory—a crucial moment when Sturz, through an act of unexpected kindness, safeguarded her youthful innocence and future. The story should follow Margaret's decision to repay this profound, forgotten debt by publicly restoring Peter Sturz's dignity and conjuring a final, blissful illusion of his past glory amidst the skeptical villagers. Your story must be approximately 10000 words long.

title: Forests of the Night
prompt: Write a short story about Jack, a young man brought from Malaya to Captain Lyons' Yorkshire estate, where he serves as a valet while learning to hunt. As strange, brutal animal attacks escalate, Jack begins to suspect the Captain's unsettling connection to the beast, all while grappling with unsettling dreams and a growing sense of his own primal nature. Explore Jack's internal conflict as he uncovers the truth of his inherited identity and the predatory instincts lurking beneath the veneer of English civility, leading to a climactic choice when he confronts the Captain. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Merman
prompt: Write a short story where Vernon Brock, an aquarist at the New York City Aquarium, accidentally inhales an experimental gas designed to allow alligators to breathe underwater. Following this unforeseen transformation, Brock finds his lungs have converted to gills, trapping him as a "merman" in a shark tank. Explore his struggle to communicate, survive, and eventually how he, J. Roosevelt Whitney, and a former trapeze artist named Oscar Daly manage to capitalize on this bizarre physiological change, turning it into a lucrative and absurd entertainment spectacle. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: The Hairless Mexican
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, Ashenden, a British agent, is paired with the flamboyant and unsettling Hairless Mexican, Manuel Carmona, on a clandestine mission to intercept secret documents in wartime Italy. The story should explore the tension between Ashenden's detached observation and the General's brutal, theatrical methods, particularly as they journey by train towards Brindisi, carrying a significant sum in thousand-dollar notes and concealed weapons. The conflict arises from the morally ambiguous nature of their objective: preventing Constantine Andreadi from reaching Rome "at any cost," and how Ashenden navigates this partnership with a man who has "no respect for human life." Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: The Moon-Bog
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator visiting Denys Barry at Kilderry Castle, where Barry's determination to drain the ancient bog brings about chilling consequences. The narrative explores the growing dread as peasants flee Kilderry and strange, wild piping music begins to lure laborers into unsettling nocturnal revels. It should culminate in the horrific vanishing of Denys Barry and the revelation of an ancient, monstrous influence emanating from the moon-drenched ruin on the bog's islet, leaving a pervasive sense of inexplicable horror. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Brood
prompt: Write a short story where the veterinarian Blackband, observing the eccentric Lady of the Lamp from his flat overlooking Princes Avenue, grows increasingly disturbed by her habit of taking in stray animals to her dilapidated house. Explore Blackband’s mounting dread as he witnesses strange phenomena—the disappearance of local characters, unsettling sounds emanating from the house, and a creeping, shapeless stain—leading him to confront the unholy, nascent brood lurking in the cellar that consumes more than just abandoned pets. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: He
prompt: Write a short story about Mrs. Whipple, a proud woman living on a struggling farm, as she grapples with the increasing burden of caring for her simple-minded son, "He." Explore her complex feelings of love, resentment, and a desperate desire to maintain appearances amidst deepening rural poverty. Show the agonizing decisions she faces regarding "He"'s future, from her fierce protection against perceived judgment to the heartbreaking realization that she cannot provide for him alone, even as the farm and her family slowly fall apart. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Long Distance Call
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Miss Elva Keene, an elderly, crippled woman whose isolated routine is shattered by a series of unsettling telephone calls. At first silent, the calls escalate to a repeated, disembodied "Hello?" and eventually a chilling "Where are you? I want to talk to you," causing Miss Keene to question her sanity as the mundane telephone becomes a conduit for terror. Explore her escalating dread as the calls continue, even after the telephone company traces the disturbing connection to the cemetery. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Chapter Ends
prompt: Write a short story about Kormt of Huerdar, Speaker for Solis Township, as he becomes the last human on Earth after the Galactic evacuation. Explore his stubborn devotion to the land and his ancestral traditions, even as the world falls silent and dark around him, confronting the crushing solitude under the relentlessly bright stars that took his people. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: Incident on Lake Geneva
prompt: Write a short story where Boris, a simple Russian peasant soldier, is found adrift on Lake Geneva, having escaped the war with only an overwhelming desire to return home. Follow his bewildered attempts to navigate a world that has become incomprehensible, from the village officials to the empathetic hotel manager, as he confronts the crushing reality of borders and a changed Russia that isolates him entirely from his past and family. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Before You Say 'Hello'
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, a globetrotting business executive who finds true intimacy only through the precarious act of making long-distance telephone calls. Explore a moment where the narrator repeatedly attempts to dial a number in a specific European city, navigating the frustrating, busy, and silent lines of a global network, while reflecting on how this arduous process becomes the sole means of connection, transforming the very act of telephoning into a profound and almost mystical ritual despite the increasing difficulty of ever getting through. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: PULSATE
prompt: Write a short story about Peter, whose new tattoo begins to pulsate and painfully warp across his leg, manifesting a grotesque face and an impossibly growing heart. As the physical agony intensifies and reality blurs around him, Peter must confront the deep-seated, inherited trauma linked to his absent father and the unspoken loss of his sister, Delilah, finally seeking a drastic release from the overwhelming pain that is consuming him from within. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Santa Wears Spurs
prompt: Write a short story where Michael O'Callahan, an outlaw with a hidden past, rides across the dead winter Texas plains to return money stolen from an orphanage by his criminal brother, Pete. He unexpectedly finds Catherine O'Callahan, the wife he abandoned five years prior, running the very boardinghouse that houses the orphans. Explore the volatile reunion as Catherine confronts Michael, still hurt by his desertion, even as the dangerous legacy of Pete and the surprising revelation of a secret child threaten their fragile second chance. Your story must be approximately 17000 words long.

title: The Marriage Mender
prompt: Write a short story where Antonio cherishes his family's antique brass bed, carved with lions and gargoyles, seeing it as a living, singing heirloom that has witnessed generations of dreams. His wife, Maria, however, despises its "humps" and noise, longing for a modern, flat bed like Mrs. Brancozzi's, believing it will bring them happiness and children. Explore the shifting dynamics of their marriage and their differing perceptions of home and legacy as an unexpected event forces them to reconsider what truly makes a bed, and a life, complete. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: A Rare Breed
prompt: Write a short story where Sue Ferman, a no-nonsense Vietnam vet living in the storm-swept Pacific Northwest, grapples with the sudden proliferation of irate unicorns and the unexpected arrival of her dying, charismatic ex-lover, Jess Shaw. Explore how these fantastical creatures, believed by some to be the reincarnated souls of troubled war veterans, challenge Sue's practical worldview and ultimately offer an unlikely path to healing and resolution for Jess, especially through his music during a town crisis involving a blocked reservoir. title: COMPROMISED CIRCUMSTANCES
prompt: Write a short story about Denise Kelly, whose college years are forever altered after her roommate Janice Butler's sister, Hadley, is killed by the immune Carmen Torres. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: A Diagnosis of Death
prompt: Write a short story where Hawver, a man who claims not to be superstitious, recounts his unsettling experience after renting a reclusive Dr. Mannering's former dwelling in Meridian. Hawver describes seeing what appears to be Dr. Mannering's walking portrait, only to later encounter the man on Union Street. The narrative explores the chilling implications when Dr. Frayley reveals a deeper truth about Dr. Mannering's fate and his peculiar "diagnosis of death," leading Hawver to question his own perceptions and impending reality as an inescapable dread closes in. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: Craving
prompt: Write a short story where Denise and Steadman, a couple caught in a cycle of heavy drinking, attempt to find respite from their self-destructive path, moving from a bar like Gary's to a rented house near the coast. Explore Denise's increasingly fractured reality, as she grapples with broken hands, unsettling encounters with figures like the cleaning woman and her strange Lundehund, and the eerie sense that the external world is mirroring their internal chaos. The narrative should capture their desperate flight and the peculiar, almost absurd, events that unfold as they hurtle towards an ambiguous destination. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Monster of the Prophecy
prompt: Write a short story where Theophilus Alvor, a despondent poet, is offered an escape from his earthly despair by Vizaphmal, an alien scientist from Antares, who reveals a bizarre prophecy on Satabbor requiring Alvor to appear as a "monster" to secure Vizaphmal's kingship. Explore Alvor's bewildering journey through otherworldly landscapes and his struggle to reconcile his human identity with his new, monstrous role in a realm governed by alien logic and strange customs. Your story must be approximately 15000 words long.

title: Illusion
prompt: Write a short story where Deryl Stephens, a thirteen-year-old boy, is tormented by the constant influx of other people's thoughts and emotions at the George Weinmann School for Boys, struggling to maintain his own identity. Every morning, he fights the dizzying onslaught by reciting his mantra, but the "Master" in his dreams teaches him to channel pain, hinting at darker uses for his burgeoning telepathy. Explore Deryl's desperate attempts to distinguish his true self from the chaotic noise of others, and whether he can find any relief or control amidst the psychic white noise, or if he will succumb to the Master's influence and lose himself entirely. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Death Disk
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Abby, a bright and innocent child, who, unaware of the grim military court proceedings, is chosen by the stern Lord General to distribute three colored disks to her father, Colonel Mayfair, and two other condemned officers. Explore the unintended consequences of her innocent act, as she believes she is simply giving her papa "the prettiest one" and how her unburdened commands challenge the rigid justice of the Commonwealth. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: SUCH BRIGHT AND RISEN MADNESS IN OUR NAMES
prompt: Write a short story where the unnamed narrator, a partially transformed member of the Second Resistance, cultivates a dangerous jellyfish venom within the ruined Sons of Finland hall in Astoria, a final desperate weapon against the priests of the Old Ones. Explore the narrator's grim determination to fight this losing war as the world succumbs to fungal rot and permanent winter, wrestling with fading memories and the personal cost of resistance, even as a brief, fragile connection with the girl from Crescent City offers a fleeting flicker of humanity before a suicidal mission against a cyclopean Risen City. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: That Man from the Bitter Sands
prompt: Write a short story where Tom Speke, left for dead in the bitter sands by Floren and Ross after they stole his gold, survives the harsh desert using clever methods like a dew trap and charcoal-purified water. Following his recovery, Speke methodically hunts the two men, employing psychological tactics like leaving Indian tracks and lighting signal fires to break their spirits, all while seeking to reclaim his stolen fortune, leading to a methodical confrontation at the edge of a vast canyon. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Play
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the unnamed theatre critic, a man whose cynicism and declining influence are tested by Rachel's brutal new play and the Director's inexplicable decision to produce it. Explore the narrator’s mounting bitterness and his toxic relationship with Madeleine, his wife, as she accepts a degrading role in the play, leading to a tense domestic confrontation where a table's contents are violently swept away in the chaotic home they inhabit. Your story must be approximately 12000 words long.

title: Box, Set
prompt: Write a short story about Duke Box, an aging robot rock star from the 1950s, who performs his hit song "You Won't Break Me" and repeatedly recounts the official version of the infamous plane crash that killed Buddy Holly and other musicians. Explore how Duke navigates the burden of his internal, suppressed memories of the actual event, and the quiet guilt he carries as he continues to be the sole 'authentic' relic among tribute acts. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Triangle at Rhodes
prompt: Write a short story where the leisurely holiday of guests at a luxurious hotel in Rhodes is disrupted by a brewing "triangle" of romantic tension and jealousy. Explore how the flamboyant Valentine Chantry, her possessive husband Commander Tony Chantry, and the seemingly smitten Douglas Gold are drawn into a deadly web, revealing that the true nature of their relationships and the motive for a shocking murder are far more deceptive than they appear under the Mediterranean sun. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: WEREMAN
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, a wolf who experiences terrifying and painful transformations into a "wereman" when the moon is round. Describe his primal instincts clashing with the alien, monstrous world of humans—their "iron boxes," their strange "celebrations" in airless wooden rooms, and the overwhelming horror of the "BIG STAR" supermarket, where dead animals are unnaturally preserved. Explore the narrator's revulsion for his human form and his desperate, disoriented attempts to hunt for his starving pack in a world he perceives as utterly vile and unnatural, leading to a desperate, wild act of survival. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Confessions of a Polar Bear Impostor
prompt: Write a short story about the investigative reporter Tiger Mouse, who, after exposing the elaborate fraud of human polar bear impostors on Arctic cruises, finds himself entangled with the notorious Wu Chang and unexpectedly recruited into the very deception he sought to reveal. The story charts Tiger Mouse's ironic journey from cynic to participant, questioning the nature of truth when maintaining illusions supports an entire economy and gives pleasure to thousands of eager tourists. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: Fossil-Figures

Explore how Edgar's external successes and Edward's internal artistic world reflect their intertwined destinies, culminating in an inevitable, final embrace that petrifies their shared existence. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: ONE ORDINARY DAY, WITH PEANUTS
prompt: Write a short story where Mr. John Philip Johnson begins an ordinary day by dispensing peanuts and performing seemingly random acts of kindness, such as helping a mother manage a chaotic moving day or paying strangers to derail their work commutes. Explore the unfolding pattern of his calculated interventions throughout the bustling city, and the unsettling truth revealed upon his return home to Mrs. Johnson, as their shared, peculiar routine comes to light, blurring the lines between benevolent influence and hidden manipulation. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: BROKEN
prompt: Write a short story following Eugene, a sensitive volunteer at the York Square soup kitchen, as he navigates the unpredictable human interactions among staff and clients. Explore Eugene's quiet observations and how he grapples with moments of chaotic emotional outburst, the fragility of the people he encounters, and his own shifting understanding of suffering and connection, particularly after a client named Isabel collapses and reveals a deeper vulnerability. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: What Paul Bourget Thinks of Us
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, who systematically refutes M. Bourget's published analysis of America, particularly his methods of "psychologizing" and generalizing the national character. The story should follow the narrator’s witty and scathing debunking, revealing how Bourget’s sweeping deductions—like those concerning female purity or the American pursuit of sudden wealth—are based on superficial encounters, dubious anecdotes, or outright fabrications concocted by "practical jokers" encountered in places such as Newport, rather than genuine cultural absorption. title: I Get a Job
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, an unemployed man in the provincial town of Altholm, struggles to find a "clean" office job amidst widespread economic hardship, repeatedly facing the humiliation of rejection as a door-to-door newspaper subscription seller. Explore the deteriorating relationship with Willi, his breadwinning companion, and the narrator's internal battle to maintain dignity and hope while navigating a world that increasingly sees him as a nuisance, culminating in a bitter confrontation and a new, uncertain departure. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

Explore Pen's expectations of bestowing a blessing and her astonishment upon discovering that Chrissy possesses an unprecedented power, and that her daughter-in-law, Sophie, also wields a formidable and unexpected magic, forcing Pen to reassess her place in this new lineage of extraordinary beings. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Hunter of Stars
prompt: Write a short story about Neri, born the night of the Obscuration of the Minor Lights when all the stars winked out, who lives in a world where most people have forgotten the celestial wonders. Neri, turning ten, is obsessed with the lost stars, guided by Grandpa's stories and Sheli's shared curiosity. Explore how Neri, holding onto the ancient legends of Orion the Hunter, attempts to keep the memory of the stars alive and hopes for their return, even as the world around them relies on the Heavenly Body Substitute Searchlight and dismisses such wonder as childish. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Yes, We'll Gather at the River
prompt: Write a short story where Charlie Moore, owner of the tobacco shop in Oak Lane, watches the last night before the new superhighway bypasses his town, reflecting on the quiet death of the old road and the community it sustained. Explore the shared resignation and melancholy of the residents as they face an inevitable future, accepting that their way of life, symbolized by the constant flow of traffic, is moving on without them, leaving Oak Lane to become a silent, forgotten place. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: How to Get Back to the Forest
prompt: Write a short story where Tisha, years after attending a specialized camp designed to instill "Life Skills" and conformity, feels a growing internal sickness that she traces back to a night when her friend Cee urged fellow campers to physically "puke up" mysterious, emotion-controlling "bugs." Explore Tisha's fragmented memories of Cee's radical act of rebellion in the camp bathroom, her own failure to eject her "bug," and the enduring, insidious way the camp's pervasive influence continues to shape her ostensibly normal adult life, making her question what was truly lost. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: LAST RITES
prompt: Write a short story where Stephen's estranged mother, Geraldine O'Connor, appears on his Chelsea doorstep on Halloween night, not seeking reconciliation for their decades of silence, but requesting Stephen's assistance in her final act of defiance against a terminal illness. Explore Stephen's complex emotions as he confronts old wounds and surprising tenderness during their final conversation, navigating the bizarre request in the unsettling glow of the gas fireplace and a shared bottle of wine. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Last Ride of the Glory Girls
prompt: Write a short story where Adelaide Jones, the 'Watchmaker' and Pinkerton undercover agent, rides with the notorious Glory Girls, a gang of time-manipulating train robbers who use the Enigma Apparatus to freeze trains mid-journey. title: Eight Keys to Eden [Part 1]

Encountering colonist Jed Dawkins, Gray must reconcile this bizarre reality—where basic human functions like fire-making become impossible—with the rigorous, open-minded principles of an Extrapolator. Your story must be approximately 26000 words long.

title: The Woman with a Candle
prompt: Write a short story where an unnamed antiquities enthusiast staying in the isolated village of Knelby hears a chilling tale from William Harness, the sexton, about the desolate rectory. The sexton recounts his terrifying encounter with a ghastly woman who walks the house at night with a lighted candle, and who led him to the grim discovery of Miss Howard's skeleton in the slate-quarry, years after her mysterious disappearance. The story should explore the lingering horror and the unsettling question of how Dorothy Leslie Howard truly met her end, and what power the spectral woman holds. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: SENSIBLE CITY
prompt: Write a short story where Police Lieutenant W. R. Gropp, a pragmatic and brutal man, attempts to escape the consequences of his crimes by fleeing across the country with his dim-witted deputy, Mickey Rizzo. After taking a wrong turn, their journey descends into a chilling nightmare as they find themselves drawn into the inescapable, green-fog-shrouded town of Obedience, a grotesque place filled with slavering, misshapen beings. Explore Gropp's 'sensible' attempts to avoid the obvious horror clichés, only to discover a more profound and inevitable terror awaiting him and Mickey. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Lessons in Joy
prompt: Write a short story about Alice Waverly, a woman in her forties clerking and baking in Quincy, who receives a distant phone call from a former lover in Belize City and unsettling news from her son, Matt. Explore how Alice, amidst her lingering grief for her parents and a sense of time running out, finds herself drawn to Professor Felder, a retired academic who burns a Confederate flag windsock in his yard, takes her to dance at Buck's Lake, and encourages her to embrace a present-day connection, making Alice question what truly constitutes joy and home. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Strange Wine
prompt: Write a short story about Willis Kaw, a man who believes he has been condemned to Earth for an unknown crime, enduring constant pain and loss, including the death of his daughter, Debbie, and his son Gilvan's paralysis. The story should question the nature of suffering and what truly constitutes a "prison" or a "paradise." Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Someone to Talk To
prompt: Write a short story where Aaron Shapiro, a struggling pianist, travels to a Latin American country for a music festival, finding his anxiety about his faltering career and recent breakup with Caroline magnified by the city's stark contrasts of wealth and devastating poverty. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: The Diary for August
prompt: Write a short story where Li Dasheng, a teenage boy being interrogated for an incident at the city wall, is tasked with writing his daily diary entry. Explore the inspector's mounting unease as he reads Li Dasheng's version of events, realizing the depth of the boy's disconnect from reality and the societal implications of such widespread self-deception. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Honey in the Wall
prompt: Write a short story where Gervaise Harow navigates the decaying grandeur of the Abbey, a vast, labyrinthine home burdened by financial ruin, feeling as immured as the ancient honey found within its Norman wall. Explore Gervaise's desperate search for an outlet for her passionate nature amidst a superficial game of hide-and-seek, leading to a profound, terrifying confrontation with her innermost, unappeasable needs. prompt: Write a short story where a woman, lounging in a basket chair at her luxurious villa by the sea, receives an unexpected visit from a former lover. As their conversation delves into their shared youth and her present life, she reveals the true, materialistic desires that led her to marry her wealthy husband, shattering his idealistic view of her past choices. Explore the bittersweet nature of forgotten dreams and the lingering shadow of youthful love on lives shaped by practical realities. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: METAMORPHOSIS
prompt: Write a short story where Max Calof, a man transformed by an alien symbiote that granted him heightened abilities, relentlessly hunts his former best friend, Howard Zealley, through a sprawling city. title: The Black Abacus
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Edgar Kerzen where he is perpetually tasked with altering the course of a quantum war by eliminating key figures, including Rachel Kilterhawk, across countless probability-spaces. title: Ernest Meissonier, Cavalry in the Snow Moreau and Dessoles before Hohenlinden

Her family, including her husband Tom and daughter Alice, believes her artistic drive is a dangerous "addiction" and stages an intervention, pressuring her to enter a "treatment center for artists" called New Horizons. Explore the satirical implications of treating artistic expression as a disease, and whether Zoe can truly escape her creative impulse or if societal expectations will successfully extinguish it. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Man or Woman
prompt: Write a short story about King Bhangasvana, a virtuous ruler who, after performing a son-seeking sacrifice that angers Indra, is transformed into a woman by bathing in a magical lake, exploring the profound shift in his/her understanding of life and self. The story should delve into Bhangasvana's experiences of motherhood and pleasure as a woman, contrasting them with his/her former life, and culminate in a pivotal decision about gender identity when confronted by the god Indra, reflecting on the nature of desire and fulfillment. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: The Rest of Us
prompt: Write a short story following the narrator as they return to Whitehorse to join their family in vigil at the hospital bedside of their dying Gran, Florence Amelia Mary Lawless Daws. Explore the raw intimacy of shared grief and cherished memories as the family gathers around her final moments. Continue through the eulogy the narrator delivers at the large funeral service, and culminate in a poignant encounter with the Catholic bishop where the narrator subtly navigates a moment of misidentification, making a quiet choice that honors their Gran's memory and the family's shared experience of profound loss. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: Let There Be Light
prompt: Write a short story where the eccentric astronomer Edgar Burton devises a "perfect murder" using a powerful, visible light ray. Explore how Edgar's single-minded devotion to his observations, combined with his wife Mary's infidelity, leads him to meticulously plan a seemingly accidental death for her lover at a perilous hairpin bend on the Yorkshire moors, demonstrating a perverse scientific logic that elevates celestial patterns above human emotion, and leading to an ingenious, yet ironic, crime. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Valentine Free Zone
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, a beauty therapist whose Valentine’s Day date with Michael at an art gallery is filled with his cynical rants about commercial holidays, leading her to question the authenticity of their connection. When her son Riley's elaborate dinner for his girlfriend banishes her from her own home, the narrator navigates a "Valentine Free Zone" pub, only to discover a surprising truth about Michael and consider a new path, embracing her own desires rather than being a 'work in progress'. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: Jesus Wrestles the Mob to Feed the Homeless
prompt: Write a short story about the narrator, a refined and reluctant Ganucci family member, where his reanimated grandfather, Don Vincenzo Ganucci—a former mob boss with computer chips firing beneath a transparent skull—develops a telepathic connection and an obsessive need to paint, challenging the narrator's loyalty and his engagement to Carla Rossi. Explore the escalating chaos as high-tech Tybok assassins, sent by the Vatican, target the family amidst explosions and the Ganooch's increasingly profound, enigmatic art. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: A Dog Named Trilby
prompt: Write a short story where an old, mean black dog named Trilby, known for her snarling and sideways walk, unexpectedly develops a deep attachment to Mrs. Jenkins' house after Mrs. Jenkins' own dog dies. Explore the growing conflict between Trilby's white owner, who desperately tries to lure the dog home with treats like fresh calf's liver, and Mrs. Jenkins, as Trilby abandons her original home and owner, ultimately choosing to reside on the rug where her deceased dog-friend once lay, leading to a poignant reflection on loyalty and loss. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: The Last Incantation
prompt: Write a short story about Malygris, an ancient and powerful sorcerer in his tower above Susran, who, despite his immense magical dominion, is consumed by a profound ennui. Seeking to escape his weariness and recapture a vanished past, he undertakes a forbidden incantation to summon the spectral form of Nylissa, a woman he loved in his youth before his descent into necromancy. Explore whether even the most potent magic can truly restore what time and personal change have erased, or if the perceived flaws lie not in the summoned phantom but in the magician's own aged heart and jaded vision. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Adventure of the Blue Carbuncle
prompt: Write a short story where Sherlock Holmes and the narrator examine a seemingly ordinary, battered felt hat and a Christmas goose, initially considering them the spoils of a minor street scuffle. The true mystery unfolds when a dazzling blue carbuncle is found within the goose, revealing its connection to a recent jewel robbery at the Hotel Cosmopolitan and an innocent man, John Horner, wrongly accused. Explore the convoluted chain of events that links a valuable gem to an unlikely animal, and the complex deductions needed to uncover the real culprit. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: BOMB SCARE
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Prince Lal e'Dorvik, a ruthless reptilian leader, following his decision to annihilate an inhabited planet to subdue the Mush-faces. When an alien craft intent on destroying the sun itself appears, Lal and Grand General Harl e'Kraft are forced to abandon their imperial ambitions and desperate local conflicts to confront a cosmic horror far beyond their understanding, realizing the fragile position of the Dorvik in a universe ruled by vastly superior, incomprehensible powers. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Words
prompt: Write a short story where the writer's spoken words manifest into vibrant, living entities, from small pink dragons to bustling, miniature villages complete with tiny people and their carts. Explore the escalating conflict as this wondrous, unruly magic in her home clashes with the rigid disapproval of her neighbors and figures like Mrs. Finnerty, the Neighborhood Watch chairman, culminating in a powerful, desperate act of escape into a world conjured entirely from language. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: nadia
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, one of the close-knit friends of Joel, where the group eagerly dissects his new mail-order bride, Nadia. Explore how the friends' collective observations, intrusive questions, and ultimately destructive attempts to "help" Nadia navigate her new life, from her initial arrival in a melting quilted coat to their misguided "cures," reveal the hidden jealousies and control within their seemingly benevolent friendships, leading to an unexpected and dark turning point by a cold river, and leaving the characters to grapple with its shocking aftermath. title: The Woman in the Room
prompt: Write a short story where Johnny visits his dying mother in Room 312 of the Central Maine Hospital, contemplating whether to administer the DARVON COMPLEX pills he has brought from home. Explore Johnny's profound moral conflict as he grapples with her unbearable suffering, the dehumanizing effects of her illness and a failed "cortotomy" operation, and the grim question of whether he can commit matricide to grant her a merciful release from her living death. title: Brother Rabbit Lays in His Beef Supply
prompt: Write a short story where Uncle Remus recounts the tale of how Brother Rabbit cunningly outwitted Brother Fox and Brother Buzzard to claim an entire butchered beef supply for himself. Detail Brother Rabbit's series of escalating deceptions, from feigning distress to blinding Brother Buzzard with sand, as his relentless trickery demonstrates the triumph of wit over strength in the familiar setting of Uncle Remus's storytelling sessions with the little boy. title: New Mom
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator in "New Mom," following a childhood marked by the absence of their schizophrenic mother who returned to Nigeria. Explore the narrator's bewildered experience as their father attempts to manage the family's fracturing life, presenting a "new mother" and sending the children to unexpected foster care with Missy and Mr. Devlin. The story should capture the emotional whiplash of fragile stability and repeated displacement, seen through the eyes of a child grappling with adult deceptions and the enduring longing for a true home. title: VOODOO VINCENT AND THE ASTROSTORIOGRAMS
prompt: Write a short story where Voodoo Vincent, a street hustler in South Side Chicago, develops his astrostoriograms, collages that miraculously predict the future and transform him into a wealthy entrepreneur. As Vincent moves from pushing a shopping cart to living in a luxury flat, a mysterious figure named LegBaby demands he share his newfound wealth with the city's homeless. Explore the escalating conflict between Vincent’s ambition and LegBaby’s divine insistence, revealing the ultimate cost of power when one forgets their roots. title: A TALE OF A GAS-LIT GHOST

title: A Fault on the Line

title: Double Vision

title: Reason Seven

title: TIME WANTS A SKELETON
prompt: Write a short story where Lieutenant Tony Crow is stranded on Asteroid No. 1007 after a shipwreck, needing to capture outlaws Johnny Braker and Harry Yates.
