title: Echoes of Mirth
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, a fifteen-year-old boy grappling with the profound silence of his home after Mammy's death. The house remains steeped in the family's shared grief, marked by the unwavering dinner ritual and Mammy's portrait, until Princess’s laughter, and later, the narrator’s own burgeoning desires and unexpected moments of mirth with Audu, begin to challenge the pervasive sorrow, forcing the family to confront what it means to live and feel joy again. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: WHEN THINGS GET DARK
prompt: Write a short story about Mrs. Garden, a young woman grappling with an unexpected pregnancy while her husband is overseas, as she seeks comfort and guidance from Mrs. Amelia Hope, an elderly woman who sends generic, ostensibly kind letters to strangers. Explore Mrs. Garden's desperate need for connection and the growing unease she feels inside Mrs. Hope's decaying rooming house, where the old woman's offers of advice reveal a profound disconnection from reality, culminating in a chilling realization of false solace. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Blythe van Renssaeler Memorial Clinic, Jokertown, Manhattan, New York
prompt: Write a short story where Noel, a powerful yet reluctant "ace," is urged by Niobe to intervene in the Congo, confronting Tom Weathers and destroying the labs creating "child aces," while in the same war-torn region, Wally inadvertently becomes a symbol of resistance on his journey to Bunia. Explore the moral complexities of wielding immense power to stop atrocities, the unexpected consequences of heroism, and the intertwining fates of those fighting for peace in a world shaped by both strategic committees and individual acts of raw force. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: SHIPS
prompt: Write a short story where Johnny, the American consul in Coralio, and his friend Keogh devise a diabolical scheme to boost sales for Mr. Hemstetter's shoe store. Following the meticulous sowing of countless sharp cockleburrs across the town's paths and streets, the barefoot citizens of Coralio are driven to immediate discomfort and a sudden, desperate demand for footwear. Explore the immediate chaos and the surprising success of this unconventional market manipulation, culminating in the arrival of Pinkney Dawson with an unexpected cargo that highlights the ongoing absurdity of the "burr business." title: I'll Be Waiting
prompt: Write a short story about Tony Reseck, the quiet, observant house detective at the Windermere Hotel, as he navigates a night shift that descends into a deadly entanglement. Tony is tasked by his gangster brother, Al, to remove a woman named Eve Cressy from the hotel, but the situation quickly escalates when Eve's ex-convict husband, Johnny Ralls, arrives, bringing with him a violent past and a debt to "the trouble boys." title: 140 Characters

Explore how their individual concerns, memories, and actions connect—or fail to connect—during a chaotic event, revealing what is gained and lost in the constant stream of information that defines their world. title: Dirty Weather
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Laura Hillman, a bartender at Frankie's Furlough, as she navigates the desolate Michigan winter after the shocking revelation of Brian Dyer’s true identity. Following his brutal betrayal and her abandonment in the deepening snow, Laura must find a way to survive the elements and the aftermath of the prison escape, grappling with the deceptive appearance of connection she felt in the isolated, correctional-officer-frequented bar. The story explores the raw struggle for survival against the harsh landscape and the chilling reality of trust broken in a place where danger is always near the surface. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Edith and Henry Go Motoring
prompt: Write a short story where Edie and Harry escape the languor of Hill House on a broiling summer day by taking a motor trip in their Pope-Hartford, following Harry's whimsical notions of direction. title: The Tombling Day
prompt: Write a short story where Grandma Loblilly, on the traditional Tombling Day, insists on personally exhuming the coffin of her long-dead fiancé, William Simmons, from the old Missouri graveyard. When his perfectly preserved body is brought into her house, she confronts her own aging and lost youth compared to his eternal twenty-three years. Explore her initial despair and the strange, accelerating decay of William Simmons's corpse that reveals unexpected compensations for the living. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: THE SPECTRE BRIDEGROOM
prompt: Write a short story where Nancy Trenoweth, after performing the hemp-seed spell on All-Hallows' Eve and seeing Frank Lenine's angry apparition, must contend with the terrifying reality of his return. title: Brother 'Possum Gets in Trouble
prompt: Write a short story about Brother Rabbit's escalating series of deceptions as he repeatedly raids the Man's pea patch, using bold lies and clever trickery to escape the little girl guarding the garden gate. title: Bridge of Sighs
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the unnamed narrator, a young boy traveling with his father, a state "Exterminator" clad in a massive, rubber suit, who is tasked with culling livestock during an animal plague. title: The Undefeated

title: A LITTLE SORORICIDE
prompt: Write a short story about Homer Withers, a mild-mannered man trapped under the suffocating domination of his physically imposing sister, Samantha Withers. prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, immediately after Anna Kraczyna has left his house for Florence. prompt: Write a short story where Mr. Schlatter, a dedicated teacher, inspires a struggling student named Paul to believe in his own potential, prompted by a motivational sign. When Eleanor is evacuated due to intensifying war, leaving Christopher behind, he uncovers a shocking truth about his own identity and finds an unexpected, reciprocal bond with Ellie amidst the destruction. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Clearances
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, an elderly Cape Breton man whose quiet morning, marked by the presence of his loyal dog and the memory of his deceased wife and the old Condon's woollen blanket, is disrupted by the forces of modern 'clearances'—a brash clear-cutter, a real estate agent, and German tourists—forcing him to choose between upholding his ancestral land and traditions, or yielding to inevitable change, culminating in a silent, defiant standoff against an aggressive pitbull. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: La Belle de Nuit, La Belle de Jour
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, cursed to speak only stinging bees, struggles to save her seven brothers, transformed into swans by the Witch, la belle de nuit. Following the King's cruel marriage and the kingdom's descent into a nightmare of chemically altered soldiers and lavish, depraved feasts, the narrator weaves flaxen shirts in a desolate cave, racing against time and her imminent execution to break the spell before the Witch's power consumes everything. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Hanging Stranger
prompt: Write a short story where Ed Loyce, a TV salesman in Pikeville, discovers a human body hanging from a lamppost in the town park, yet seemingly no one else notices or cares. Explore his escalating dread and the horrifying realization that the entire town, including his family, may have been subtly replaced or mind-controlled by an alien presence, forcing him to flee a world that has become a monstrous trap. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: THE BIG AND THE LITTLE
prompt: Write a short story where Hober Mallow, a pragmatic Master Trader for the Foundation, navigates a brewing "Seldon Crisis" that pits the Foundation's subtle economic power against the decaying Galactic Empire's raw atomic might. Mallow finds himself at odds with political rivals like Jorane Sutt, who advocate outdated religious influence. To prevail, Mallow must implement his strategy of leveraging advanced consumer technologies—such as self-sharpening knives or automated laundry units—as a form of "silent war," even as he faces a public trial for abandoning a Foundation priest, Jord Parma, to a hostile mob on Korell, proving economic control trumps traditional force. Your story must be approximately 21000 words long.

title: The Light of Other Eyes
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of one of the caregivers attending to Quin, an aging man whose mind is receding into the past, mistaking his present companions for figures from his youth. Explore the profound disorienting experience of witnessing Quin's reality shift, where his fading memory transforms familiar faces into ghosts and familiar spaces into distant light-years. The story should convey the melancholic beauty of losing a shared present while grappling with the nature of time and connection, as seen through the lens of astronomical metaphor and a final visit to an old observatory. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Holy Week
prompt: Write a short story about Dennis, a travel journalist, documenting the vibrant Holy Week celebrations in a Central American town, where his attempts to focus on festive traditions and local cuisine are increasingly challenged by his young girlfriend, Sarah, who finds herself confronted by the stark reality of poverty, military presence, and the unsettling stories of locals like Gabriela. The narrative should explore the tension between their privileged tourist experience and the country's hidden political violence, as Sarah's discomfort forces Dennis to grapple with his own detachment amidst the solemn processions and the unexpected appearance of mounted machine guns. Your story must be approximately 15000 words long.

title: THE TALE OF THE PORCELAIN-GOD
prompt: Write a short story where the master potter Pu is commanded by the Emperor to create a vase that embodies the living sensation of "flesh made to creep by a Thought," a task that seems utterly impossible for clay. Pu toils for months, praying to the Spirit of the Furnace for guidance, only to be met with cryptic answers hinting at an unspeakable price. Explore Pu's growing obsession and despair as he faces failure, until a terrible truth about the Spirit's demands reveals the ultimate sacrifice required to imbue dead matter with a living soul. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Longviewers
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator on Hillview Road, where her Daddy wages an increasingly absurd "war" against the residents of Longview Road over traffic. Explore how the grandiose rhetoric of "Save-Our-Street" meetings, complete with artichoke appetizers and union songs, clashes with the narrator's own quiet coming-of-age and her observations of adult behavior, as she watches the fervent commitment of Daddy fade into quiet disillusionment. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: What Happens in Vegas..

Follow Pirx as he leaves the opulent passenger decks and navigates the tense, professional world of the ship's control rooms, deciphering urgent Morse code messages and feeling the increasing G-forces as the _Transgalactic_ races towards the doomed vessel, confronting the grim realities of deep-space emergencies amidst the quiet hum of advanced technology. title: YOU'RE LOOKING A LITTLE WAXY, VISKOVITZ
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Viskovitz, a drone renowned for his "chromatic liveliness" and "solid architectonic solutions," as he seeks to escape the relentless demands of his celebrated beauty. title: High-Water Railers

title: In the Water, Underneath

title: The King Enjoys His Own Again
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator encounters the restless ghosts of King George the Fourth and Bishop John Strachan in the quadrangle of a university. title: Atlantis

title: Parting Shots

title: The Bridges of Eden Park
prompt: Write a short story where Rachel, a capable witch, and her vampire boyfriend Kisten are enjoying breakfast at Eden Park when Kisten's sister Chrissie and her living vampire son, Audric, arrive pursued by Audric's ruthless father, Sean. Rachel finds herself drawn into a desperate fight on a footbridge over water, where her usual ley-line magic is hindered, forcing her to rely on quick thinking and unexpected strength to protect the terrified Audric from a sinister plot involving a master vampire. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Wild Thing
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, a man plagued by restlessness and self-destruction, finds himself drawn into an impulsive, dangerous affair with a woman he meets at a bar, despite the unraveling of his marriage and the constant, violent interruptions to their encounters. Explore his internal conflict as he cycles between moments of fleeting passion, profound self-loathing, and the inescapable consequences of his choices, culminating in a final, unavoidable confrontation. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Select Mode
prompt: Write a short story following Jorg, a cunning and self-proclaimed monster, as he is marched with his companion the Nuban through the harsh, rain-soaked Orlanth mountains toward a mysterious "arch of judgment." From Jorg's perspective, depict his brutal pragmatism and his defiant internal world, shaped by a traumatic past involving "thorns," as he confronts the armed Select and a relic that decides human fate. The narrative should explore the nature of true judgment, whether it comes from a divine artifact, from others, or from within. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Third Always Beside You
prompt: Write a short story where Gertrude Schenker and her brother, Weber, have long sought the identity of "the other woman," Elsie Durant, whom they believe was the "Keystone" that bent their parents' marriage into its strange shape. Following an unsettling conversation with their Aunt Victoria, Gertrude uncovers the full, horrifying truth of Elsie's enduring presence. Explore the psychological and physical manifestations of this spectral infidelity, as Gertrude grapples with the realization that Elsie Durant is not merely a past secret, but an insidious, almost tangible entity intertwined with her parents' intimate reality. Your story must be approximately 12000 words long.

title: The Poor Relation's Story
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Michael, a man widely considered a poor, unsuccessful relation, who begins to share his "true" life with a gathered family. Despite their pity and his outwardly modest existence in the Clapham Road, Michael reveals a vibrant inner world where he is a successful partner to John Spatter, a devoted husband to Christiana, and the patriarch of a loving family in his "Castle." Explore the construction of this rich, imagined reality and the subtle ways it sustains him amidst the perceptions of his relatives, culminating in the bittersweet revelation that his "Castle is in the Air." Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: 1943 A Brief Note Pertaining to the Absence of One Olivaceous Cormorant, Stuffed
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, a woman afflicted with a biological condition that causes her to revert to infancy under extreme emotional duress, where she visits Dr. Lambshead’s Whimpering-on-the-Brook home in 1943. As Dr. Lambshead reveals a metallic olivaceous cormorant believed to be linked to the phoenix mythos, the narrator inadvertently activates a colossal, ancient mechanical bull, plunging them into a desperate, bizarre chase through the English countryside. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Served Cold
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, a Vietnam veteran, as they prepare a macabre dinner party for Roy Curry, a former comrade strapped to a chair. The narrator grapples with decades of guilt and a twisted desire for revenge, recounting a traumatic incident from Binh Dinh province while lacing the Chinese gingered tuna with poison, revealing a chilling secret about Roy's true presence and the ultimate, self-destructive price of their shared past. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: GRASPING AT SHADOWS
prompt: Write a short story following AppleJack Stevens, a cynical airship pilot, as he grudgingly accepts a perilous voyage aboard the *Gibraltar* to locate the legendary city of Xibor, only to discover the dazzling utopia is a perilous illusion designed to lure the unwary, forcing him to rely on his unique, unromantic perspective to save his crew from a monstrous fate. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Designer Emotion 67
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Tripp Hauser, CEO of PharmaLife, Inc., as he addresses shareholders about the company's latest ventures into Designer Emotion 67. The narrative should capture the unsettling blend of corporate jargon and increasingly unhinged salesmanship, as he touts the "meaning pill" while casually dismissing bizarre side effects like "slight madness" or "partial zombification," all to secure further investment in their quest to commodify belief. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: A Married Man's Story
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator of "A Married Man's Story," where, on a rainy evening in the sitting-room, he observes his wife and baby before the fire, but his mind drifts to his profound emotional detachment from his present life. Explore his retreat into vivid, fragmented memories of his childhood, particularly his father's chemical shop and his mother's unsettling death, as he questions the invisible bonds that tie people together and the isolating nature of his own "shell-like" existence. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: THE HALL OF FANTASY
prompt: Write a short story about the narrator's visit to the Hall of Fantasy, a magnificent and bewildering edifice where all human imaginings, from poetic genius to speculative finance, reside. As the narrator wanders among fantastic pillars and stained-glass light with the friend, encountering fervent reformers, impractical inventors, and even Father Miller predicting the world's end, the narrator reflects on the true value of earthly reality against the allure and dangers of pure idealism. Explore the tension between the transient beauty of the physical world and the eternal, yet sometimes isolating, realm of thought. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Keep Travelin', Rider
prompt: Write a short story where Tack Gentry returns to the G Bar ranch after a year away, only to find it claimed by Van Hardin and his allies, and his Uncle John Gentry declared dead in a rigged gunfight. The entire town of Sunbonnet has fallen under their corrupt control, leaving Tack alone against a seemingly insurmountable system of legal fraud and violence. Explore how Tack, using his wits and a deep understanding of the land and its history, begins to unravel Hardin’s power and seek justice for his uncle and the community, even after being framed for the murder of Anson Childe. Your story must be approximately 11000 words long.

title: The Abelard Sanction
prompt: Write a short story where Saul Grisman and Erika Bernstein arrive at the Monastery of the Sun and the Moon, an Abelard safe house in Santa Fe, consumed by grief for their son, who was killed by Yusuf Habib. Erika is determined to kill Habib, also a guest at the sanctuary, despite the Abelard sanction's inviolable rule against violence within its walls. Explore the couple's desperate plan to achieve their brutal revenge while meticulously bending the sanctuary's strict code, leading to an explosive confrontation that tests the true limits of immunity and justice. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: SAFEGUARD
prompt: Write a short story where Li, Jana, Sudie, and Kim live in an enclosed "world" with antiseptic palm trees and a food "feeder," until a seismic event shatters their reality. Following Li's desperate quest to find Katherine Taney—the only adult known to them, always appearing in a white covering—the children venture into the vast, unforgiving desert, gradually understanding that their "safeguard" world concealed a far more complex and perilous truth about their existence as engineered beings and the external threats Taney battles to protect them. Your story must be approximately 10000 words long.

title: The Effluent Engine
prompt: Write a short story about Jessaline Dumonde, a Haitian spy navigating a stifling, steampunk New Orleans, as she attempts to secure a methane extraction process from rum effluent to power her free nation's dirigibles and advanced artillery. Her mission leads her into conflict with the insidious Order of the White Camellia and to an unexpected alliance and romance with Eugenie Rillieux, a brilliant Creole engineer, ultimately forcing a daring choice between duty and a new life. Your story must be approximately 11000 words long.

title: THE PIPE
prompt: Write a short story where Derik Ames, lured by a cryptic message, drives through oppressive heat to a decrepit shotgun house in Irwin, Indiana, to meet his white girlfriend Sara’s father, Joe Johnson. The encounter turns sinister when Johnson, fueled by racist animosity, traps Derik in a suffocating drainpipe. The narrative follows Derik’s terrifying crawl through the dark, filth-choked passage, battling attacking creatures and his own sanity, as he strains towards the Ohio River and the horrifying truth of Sara’s fate. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Modern Soul
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator at a European pension, observing the theatrical antics of Fräulein Sonia, the "modern soul," and the Herr Professor. Explore the performative nature of their interactions, from the Professor's trombone playing and cherry-eating philosophizing to Sonia's dramatic recitations and calculated fainting spells by the hairdresser's shop. The story should capture the clash between genuine feeling and affected artistry, as the narrator navigates a world where every emotion is a performance and even a safety pin can be a "tragedy." Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Linger Longer
prompt: Write a short story about Lori, who, during her first vacation with Michael at the Linger Longer cabin in the Tennessee mountains, experiences a disturbing unraveling of her own identity and perception. Explore her growing internal conflict as she encounters a mysterious "woman in the blue dress" and struggles with unsettling feelings of derealization, questioning whether her mind is fracturing or if an external force is claiming her. The story should delve into the blurring lines between reality and delusion, as Michael and their friends remain largely oblivious to the psychological horror Lori is enduring, culminating in a chilling sense of transformation and loss of self. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Daughter of Necessity
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Penelope, a queen trapped by predatory suitors, who uses a rare, inherited gift to weave potential futures on her loom. Each night, she sees the devastating consequences of her choices—from a bloody massacre sparked by Antinoös to the murder of her son Telemachos—and meticulously unweaves them. Guided by visions and golden threads born from desperate sacrifice, she continues her relentless struggle, aiming to find a single path that will bring peace back to Ithaka and ensure the safe return of Odysseus, King of Ithaka. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Coming of the Sea
prompt: Write a short story where the gods, seated on their ancient hills above the green plains, first hear the new, unsettling cry of Slid, the sea-god, and witness his million waves tramping up the twilight. Explore the gods' initial confusion and their desperate attempts to command the four winds, the red cliffs, and the downlands to halt Slid's conquering march, as the primordial earth begins to transform irrevocably and their long-held dominion is challenged by a beautiful yet relentless new power. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Fellow-Townsmen
prompt: Write a short story following George Barnet, a man who returns to his native Port-Bredy after more than twenty years, his appearance changed but his heart still burdened by old sorrows. Explore his quiet journey through the transformed town, past the Black-Bull Hotel and the building he once called his 'new house,' now known as Château Ringdale, and his discovery that Lucy Savile, the woman he secretly loved, is now the widowed Mrs. Downe living within its walls. The story should delve into his enduring regret and the profound melancholy of desires thwarted by circumstance and unspoken intentions. Your story must be approximately 19000 words long.

title: The Fairy Tale About the Wicker Chair
prompt: Write a short story about the young man, an aspiring painter, who retreats to his attic studio, grappling with the elusive nature of artistic expression as he attempts to capture the essence of a simple wicker chair. When the wicker chair unexpectedly speaks, offering philosophical insights about perspective and reality, the young man must confront not only his artistic frustrations but also the very definition of his ambition and whether his path truly lies in painting. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: THE CLUTCHES OF RUIN
prompt: Write a short story about Neil Bryson, a Terran envoy, and his secretary Carole Leland, as they travel to the planet Ytijio to assess its compliance with a Galactic Federation directive regarding overpopulation. Bryson must navigate the planet's diverse and often brutal factions—from the egg-storing Scientocrats to the population-raiding Militarists—who each offer their own paradoxical "solutions." The story should explore the tension between bureaucratic requirements and the harsh realities of a world teetering on the edge of self-destruction, where the true cost of "compliance" is measured in lives, not numbers. Your story must be approximately 13000 words long.

title: Vacuum Cleaner
prompt: Write a short story about Johansen, a former NASA pilot, who joins his audacious friend Sam Gunn to launch Vacuum Cleaners, Inc. (VCI), a startup aiming to clear dangerous space debris. The narrative should focus on their struggle to develop a magnetic bumper system for Space Station Freedom while battling bureaucratic hurdles, underhanded competition from corporate giants like Rockledge International, and Sam's own chaotic methods and surprising connections. Your story must be approximately 20000 words long.

title: Summer of '69
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Hannah, living in the barn loft at Cassandra Grove in the summer of 1969, as she navigates the arrival of young Ike, a displaced boy whose father recently died, and the uncomfortable ‘family’ dynamic with Mr. and Mrs. Beal and their adopted son, Gary. Hannah, resistant to attachment and burdened by her own past, finds her isolated existence challenged by the boys’ naive attempts at connection and the Beals’ desire for a larger family. The story explores Hannah’s internal struggle to reconcile her cynicism with the quiet, unsettling hope that these new relationships might offer, all set against the backdrop of Florida’s stagnant orange groves and the distant rumble of a rocket launch. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: THE CONQUERED
prompt: Write a short story where Frederick, on a summer holiday at his aunt's house on the Welsh border, finds himself captivated by Gwyneth, a charming and outwardly joyous woman whose radiant presence dominates the local social scene. As Frederick spends more time with Gwyneth and observes the quiet, melancholy nature of his cousin Ruthie, particularly around their contrasting musical preferences, he begins to perceive a deeper divide between those who embrace gaiety and those who carry sorrow, culminating in a significant realization about Gwyneth after her refusal to sing Chopin's 'Polens Grabgesang'. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Graveyard Shift
prompt: Write a short story where Hall, a temporary worker at the Gates Falls textile mill, reluctantly accepts a dangerous week-long job cleaning the mill's long-abandoned sub-basement. Hall must contend with the overbearing foreman, Warwick, and the increasingly monstrous and aggressive rats and bats lurking in the putrid, water-logged darkness, as he uncovers the true, horrifying extent of the neglected, subterranean ecosystem and struggles to survive its terrors. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Love is Blind
prompt: Write a short story where Edith, a mystery writer, wakes her partner Sally in the early hours to test a plot point for her novel involving police-issue handcuffs, blurring the lines between art and their intimate life. Explore how Sally, with her dry wit, navigates Edith's single-minded dedication to her craft as the role-play evolves to include the villain 'Kevin,' leading to unexpected sensuality and comedic mishaps involving misplaced glasses and keys, all for the sake of creative authenticity. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Facts behind the Helsinki Roccamatios
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator and his friend Paul, facing Paul's terminal illness from AIDS, embark on an ambitious storytelling project. Confined to hospital rooms and grappling with Paul's physical decline, they invent the intricate lives of the Helsinki Roccamatios, a Finnish family whose saga unfolds across the 20th century, each episode tied to a specific historical event. Explore how this shared act of imaginative creation becomes their solace, defiance, and a way to navigate an unbearable reality, even as Paul's ability to participate wanes. Your story must be approximately 17000 words long.

title: Acts of God
prompt: Write a short story about Sam Gunn, an audacious space entrepreneur, who initiates a global uproar by suing Pope William I and the Vatican for "acts of God" after his insurance claims are denied for lightning strikes, micrometeor impacts, and a lunar quake suffered by Ecuador National Space Systems. The story follows Justice Meyers as she navigates the bizarre legal proceedings in The Hague and Selene, enduring assassination attempts from religious fanatics and Sam's relentless pursuit of money and women, questioning whether true justice can be found when dealing with divine responsibility and the machinations of a man who always gets what he wants. Your story must be approximately 17000 words long.

title: Black God's Kiss
prompt: Write a short story about Jirel of Joiry, the fierce lady warrior, after her castle Joiry has fallen to Guillaume. Driven by a burning hatred for her conqueror, Jirel descends into an unholy, multi-dimensional realm to seek a weapon of vengeance, daring to accept a terrible gift from a nameless entity. Explore the chilling consequences of this otherworldly bargain as she returns to exact her price, only to discover the true, devastating cost of the "black God's kiss" upon her own soul and the world. Your story must be approximately 12000 words long.

title: Daddy Longlegs of the Evening
prompt: Write a short story about Daddy Longlegs, a grotesque figure with a spider living in his brain, who arrives in the industrial city of Grindly wearing a stovepipe hat and rose-colored glasses. He hangs upside down from ceilings, feeding on the "fear-laden essence" of his victims, leaving their bodies like "old, worn luggage" filled with spiders. Explore Inspector Kaufmann's desperate, one-bullet effort to combat this entity as it weaves the city into a vast, mind-controlled web, forcing its citizens to live by its terrifying motto: "Fear and Industry." Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: (Tzekovitz was Another)
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, the chair of a Writers’ Group, as he grapples with the idiosyncratic brilliance of Dan Driscoll. Dan, an elderly man in a bunnet and thick specs, produces a constant stream of handwritten stories with little regard for traditional craft, prompting the narrator to question the very nature of storytelling. The narrative should capture the conversational, digressive atmosphere of the group as Dan spins an elaborate tale about acquiring new boots and the mystery of bunched-up shoelaces, featuring his sharp-witted wife, the Missis, and a snooty Oxfam volunteer. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: THE MOST ETHICAL MAN IN THE BUSINESS
prompt: Write a short story about Spencer Quade, a meticulous and reputedly "ethical" hitman who always receives full payment in advance and never crosses a client. Spencer takes on two separate assignments, one from the mysterious "The Arranger" for an anonymous target, and another from Joey Thomas to eliminate his wife. When the two assignments shockingly converge in a Brooklyn apartment, revealing Joey Thomas as the anonymous target from The Arranger, Spencer Quade must find a way to uphold his professional code without failing either job. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: DIG HERE
prompt: Write a short story following Ty Hauck, a private security consultant, as he arrives in Alexandria, Egypt, to investigate the disappearance of archaeology student Stephanie Winters. He must collaborate with Inspector Nabila Honsi and the enigmatic Harper Connelly, whose supernatural ability to sense the dead unearths not only a shocking truth about Stephanie's fate, but also hints at monumental, millennia-old secrets buried deep beneath the modern city's shifting sands. Your story must be approximately 12000 words long.

title: Cry Hope, Cry Fury!
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, a stranded yachtsman, finds himself entangled in the surreal obsession of Hope Cunard at Lizard Key, a villa on an island in the vast sand-sea. Explore how her photosensitive paintings begin to reflect a disturbing reality, blurring identities and bringing to life the ghost of Charles Rademaeker, while her manipulative half-brother Foyle orchestrates a macabre psychological game that challenges the very nature of truth. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Saving Miranda
prompt: Write a short story where Miranda is stranded fifteen feet up a tree in hailstones, clinging to a spindly branch and reflecting on her superficial relationship with Rufus, an eco-conscious boyfriend who reveals his hypocrisy on Valentine's Day. The narrator, numb with cold and betrayal, is unexpectedly rescued by a charming fireman named Alex, who turns out to be more connected to her life than she ever imagined, exploring themes of personal disillusionment and finding genuine connection in surprising circumstances. Your story must be approximately 10000 words long.

title: Bubba Ho-Tep
prompt: Write a short story about Elvis Presley, living anonymously as Sebastian Haff in the squalid Shady Rest Convalescent Home, who discovers an ancient Egyptian mummy named Bubba Ho-Tep is preying on the souls of his fellow residents. The story should follow Elvis and his newfound ally, Jack, who believes he is JFK, as they battle this grotesque supernatural threat amidst the indignities of old age and the decaying environment of the nursing home, exploring Elvis's struggle with his forgotten identity and his unexpected quest for a final act of heroism against a foe that feeds on the dying. Your story must be approximately 14000 words long.

title: Steam Time
prompt: Write a short story where Ani, disguised as a boy, travels across the Texas plains in 1892 with her snake-oil salesman Pa, until the mysterious stranger Chance rides into their lives. As the Marfa lights trigger a shift into a reality riddled with automatons and airships, Ani finds herself caught between a forced marriage to the villainous Doc Smith and the whirlwind proposal of Chance, a man burdened by secrets from his own time and galaxy, forcing her to choose between a life of pretense or a dangerous, uncertain future by his side. Your story must be approximately 13000 words long.

title: MR STRANG ACCEPTS A CHALLENGE
prompt: Write a short story where Mr Strang, an eccentric logic teacher at Aldershot High School, is challenged by his star student, Jerry Lockley, to solve "The Weird Winkler Death," an unsolved murder that stumped the police. A brilliant deduction unfolds as Mr Strang examines seemingly irrelevant details, such as a missing weapon and the layout of the Winkler house with its prominent flagpole, to reveal the ingenious, precisely timed method of murder involving a full sprinkling can and specialized fishing line. The story should follow his meticulous, step-by-step logical process in solving the seemingly impossible crime. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: The Lamp
prompt: Write a short story about Geoffrey, a young boy with "blind understanding," who perceives a lonely child's spirit haunting No. 19, an old house in Weyminster. The house, recently purchased by his skeptical mother, Mrs. Lancaster, holds the echoes of a child who starved to death. Explore Geoffrey's unique connection to this unseen presence as he attempts to soothe its sorrow, even as his own health falters, and consider what it truly means to set a spirit free. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Harrelson
prompt: Write a short story where Harrelson, a small amphibian patient, insists he is a human from a higher dimension suffering from a guilt complex over altering Earth's history, while his psychiatrist tries to convince him he is simply a frog. Explore the surreal and humorous therapy sessions as Harrelson details his supposed past, including a leap that influenced Caesar and the origin of Leap Year, culminating in a surprising revelation about his true nature and exit from the mundane office. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Thief of Golgotha
prompt: Write a short story where Mills returns to the remote, humid swamps of Cobb County, Georgia, after his daughter Jorie is brutally murdered by the beautiful, chilling Seraph. Explore Mills's grim inheritance—a family lineage tied to a thief of Golgotha, burdened with a "gift" to see and excise evil, yet cursed to an inescapable, violent conflict with these minions of paradise. The narrative should delve into the fatalistic cycle of bloodshed, questioning if this divine dispensation is a blessing or an eternal damnation for Mills and his kin. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Hands That Hold, the Lies That Bind
prompt: Write a short story where Callie discovers thorns emerging from her body, revealing a horrifying secret passed down through her family. As the strange, sharp growths appear, Callie's mother attempts to suppress them and hide the truth, revealing a hidden collection of past thorns and a mysterious voice that promises answers. Explore the desperate lengths Callie goes to uncover the meaning behind these transformations and the devastating, irreversible consequences when she finally forces the truth from her mother. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Voodoo
prompt: Write a short story about Marie-Denise, an eleven-year-old girl living on the desolate Bloxham Estate, who is desperate to protect her younger twin brothers, Jean-Luc and Duval, from the dangerous joyrider Terry Caxton. After Terry lures the twins into his stolen car, Marie-Denise seeks help from the reclusive Madame Simone, a Haitian 'wise woman' rumored to practice voodoo. Explore the irreversible consequences when Madame Simone provides a mysterious liquid meant to stop Terry, which, when unleashed, transforms not just the target but also the wielder, revealing the true power of hatred and irreversible change. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Brothers
prompt: Write a short story where Chet, a dutiful older brother, recounts his obsessive efforts to manage the reckless life of his charismatic younger brother, Michael. Trace the escalating tension from Michael's framing of Jeff Cosgrove years ago, through his destructive affair with Jane Cameron, to the night of the fatal car collision, exploring how Chet's deep-seated loyalty and need for control tragically intertwine with Michael's self-destruction, leaving Chet to grapple with responsibility and a shattered sense of "normal." Your story must be approximately 11000 words long.

title: Black Flower
prompt: Write a short story about Mona and Shane, a recently released prisoner known as a "wanted man," as they travel to the remote Glasheen hotel in the Irish countryside. The narrative should trace their fragile attempt to find normalcy and connection, juxtaposing the beauty of the landscape with the pervasive danger from Shane's past. Explore the foreboding atmosphere, symbolized by the hotel's strange, sinister black flower, as the looming threat of reprisal ultimately shatters their tenuous peace and reveals the enduring grip of violence. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Island
prompt: Write a short story following the narrator, a nine-year-old boy, who leaves the insular "island" of his family's home in the park to pursue a cryptic advertisement. On a dark October day, he carries his prized "third largest trout" in a jam jar to 60 Dickinson Road, his grandfather's former house now occupied by Wylde's Photographers. There, an unsettling encounter with a boy claiming to be his deceased brother and a blind Great-grandpa leads him to cast his fish into a vast, swirling pool, an act that shatters his sheltered perception and thrusts him into a sudden, disquieting adult understanding of the world. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Allesverloren
prompt: Write a short story where the widowed narrator travels to London to meet Hayford Leiden, her deceased husband's former male lover, hoping to piece together a secret chapter of his life. Explore the unsettling encounter in Hayford's grand house, where his memories of her husband contradict her own understanding, and the unspoken truths about grief and intimacy are revealed, culminating in the poignant exchange of an "Allesverloren" wine bottle. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Hallucination
prompt: Write a short story where Sam Chase arrives on Energy Planet, a seemingly barren world assigned for a vital neutron star energy project, but soon questions the official explanation for reported "hallucinations" among the crew. Explore Sam's determination to investigate the wavering, smoky shapes he encounters outside the Dome, and how his open mind leads him to a profound telepathic communication with an unexpected form of intelligent alien life, revealing a desperate plea for their world's preservation and a cure for the ailing Commander. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: The Daddy Box
prompt: Write a short story where Billy Alexander, an eight-year-old boy, finds a mysterious "daddy box" that super-ages his mind and offers reality-altering powers. Following his stepfather Henry Alexander's abusive behavior, Billy orchestrates a confrontation at the woodshed, intending to use the ferosslk to alter Henry's very nature and create the "dad" he desires. The story captures the eerie blend of domestic strife and alien intervention as a child reconfigures his family. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Bohemian Days in San Francisco
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, a young man arriving in early San Francisco, where the city's proclaimed "austere morality" conceals a simmering undercurrent of lawlessness and cultural complexities. Detail an incident the narrator witnesses, perhaps on a bustling "steamer night" along the City Front or within the enigmatic Chinese Quarter, that starkly contrasts with the city's public image, and reveals the fierce, restless spirit shaped by the "unremitting wind" and "unceasing sea." Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: A Domiciliary Visit
prompt: Write a short story where Ashenden, a British intelligence agent in neutral Geneva during wartime, navigates the subtle threats and absurdities of his profession. Explore his return to his hotel to find two Swiss police officers, Fafner and Fasolt, waiting in his room, ostensibly to inquire about noisy casino-goers but hinting at a deeper suspicion, while also reflecting on a recent unsettling encounter with a blackmailing informant named Bernard. The story should capture the dry wit and quiet tension of a spy operating in an environment where mundane details mask dangerous undertones. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Boat
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, who returns to the Cape Breton fishing village, still haunted by the memory of his father and the *Jenny Lynn*. Explore the enduring tension between the sea's demanding call and the life of books and intellect, as the narrator grapples with the sacrifices made and the unspoken legacy of a family deeply tied to the harsh coastal traditions. The village and the mother remain steadfast, a silent testament to the life he chose to leave behind. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: The Fortune-Teller
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Lucy, an intuitive card reader, during her unsettling holiday at the old Troubadour country château, where she tells Mme Dessain's fortune. Explore the subtle clash of their perceptions and the disquieting realization, years later, that Mme Dessain's seemingly malevolent 'wish' actively diverted Lucy's own romantic 'destiny' with Raymond, leaving Lucy to reflect on the difference between fate and destination, and the unseen forces that shaped her life. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: City of the Dog
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, who, after abandoning Kaitlyn and Chris to the horrors beneath Albany, struggles to outrun the lingering influence of the Ghûl and the Keeper. Now living far from State Street, the narrator finds the boundaries between his past encounter in the Albany Rural Cemetery and his present life begin to dissolve, forcing a confrontation with the unsettling truth of what he left behind. Your story must be approximately 14000 words long.

title: Widower
prompt: Write a short story about Beth, a fifteen-year-old with a healing ulcer, and her younger brother Nicky, who copes with their father's new girlfriend, Mrs. Clark, through strange antics and impersonations. The story takes place in their wooden one-story house near the Atlantic, where the arrival of Mrs. Clark for a beach day forces the siblings to navigate the awkwardness and unspoken grief surrounding their mother's absence, all under the observant, somewhat detached gaze of Beth. Explore how the family attempts to establish a new normal amidst lingering pain and everyday discomforts like sunburn. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: THE REJECTION
prompt: Write a short story where Boris Ivanovich and his wife, Anna, face the unimaginable catastrophe of their three-year-old son, Mischa, being rejected by Manhattan's most elite nursery school. Explore the escalating absurdity of their world unraveling as this single setback is prophesied to lead to barber college, public school, and eventual destitution, pushing them to extreme and comical lengths—including insider trading and selling their beloved Hamptons home—all in a desperate, farcical attempt to regain their perceived social standing and avoid utter ruin. Witnessing the chilling reality where nonconformity leads to being "excreted," the narrator battles against ostracism, the loss of her belongings, and the predatory gaze of the boy Tolik, whose unsettling attention haunts her. Explore how her vivid inner world and emerging literary talent become her shield and weapon against the harsh, communal existence, where even a phone call about "young berries" can reveal the enduring nature of a traumatic obsession from a place that was both paradise and torment. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Eighth Voyage
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, a human delegate to the United Planets, experiences an increasingly bizarre and humiliating attempt to gain humanity's admission into the galactic assembly. The narrator must contend with the Rhohch diplomat's awkward advocacy, the Thubanian representative's terrifying classification of humans as "Corpselovers," and the Iridian's shocking accusation that humanity originated from "fermented slops" and a "sneeze" due to "planetary incontinence." Explore the delegate's mounting horror and the unsettling question of whether this cosmic ordeal is a dream or a disturbing reality. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Terrific Mother
prompt: Write a short story about Adrienne, a woman grappling with overwhelming grief and an accidental tragedy, who finds herself isolated in the intellectual hothouse of the Villa Hirschborn in Italy. Explore her detached observations of the eccentric scholars and the "spouses," her complex relationship with Martin Porter, and her desperate search for absolution or a path back to a meaningful life, perhaps through unexpected means like the mysterious masseuse Ilke or her own strange attempts at art. Your story must be approximately 13000 words long.

title: Wishes Granted
prompt: Write a short story where Subalchandra, a father suffering from rheumatism, and his mischievous son, Sushilchandra, frustratingly wish for each other's age and are granted their desires by the Goddess of Desires. Explore the unexpected and humorous consequences as Sushil, now an old man with a bald patch and no teeth, struggles with the physical limitations of his new body and the responsibilities of adulthood, while Subal, transformed into a boy, detests school and longs to play, leading to a reversal of their family dynamic as the son attempts to discipline his now childlike father. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Jeaves and the Deteriorating Relations
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Bernard Worster, an upper-crust gentleman accustomed to his valet Jeaves bailing him out of scrapes, who finds himself accidentally engaged to two women and embroiled in a plot to steal Uncle Tim's cow-creamer. When a peculiar razor, said to carry a spirit, comes into his possession, Bernard's usual bumbling turns into a surprisingly efficient and nonchalant spree of decapitations at Binkley Court, as he casually dispatches rivals, relatives, and even servants, only to discover a larger, more sinister plot orchestrated by Jeaves all along. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: AN ELEMENT OF RISK
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of reporter Tod Conner where his initial suspicion that his brother-in-law, Lyle Barton, is the infamous Stocking Killer takes a shocking turn when Lyle is arrested, then cleared by a new murder, leading Tod to suspect an even darker truth about his fiercely loyal sister Martha and the lengths she would go to protect her troubled husband, particularly after discovering Lyle's hidden "burglar kit" and a cache of nylon stockings in his workshop. Explore the chilling implications of Martha's unwavering devotion and her potential role in maintaining a precarious "element of risk" in their lives. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: Milo's Tale
prompt: Write a short story where Doctor Milo, a chimpanzee scientist, leads an expedition into the Northern Dead Areas to secure ancient human technology before the gorillas can claim it. As Milo uncovers the remnants of a lost human civilization and encounters Cornelius and Zira, two chimpanzees whose society has a different understanding of history, an approaching gorilla army forces a desperate escape aboard a human spacecraft, leading to a horrifying journey into space where they witness Earth's cataclysmic end and the true source of its destruction. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: THE MAN WHO SAW THE FUTURE
prompt: Write a short story where Henri Lothiere, an apothecary's assistant in 1444 Paris, stands accused of sorcery by Inquisitor Jean de Marselait for his inexplicable vanishing and reappearance in a field. Detail Henri's desperate attempt to explain how he was accidentally transported five centuries into the future, encountering the astonishing technological marvels of 1944 shown to him by scientists Rastin and Thicourt. Explore the profound, tragic clash between his incredible vision of progress and the unyielding, superstitious beliefs of his own time, which condemns him despite his truth. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: A Frivolous Woman
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Grete's son, Arnulf, about his mother, a woman who brought masquerade costumes from Berlin as a refugee and insisted on living life as a perpetual party. Explore his struggle to reconcile her seemingly blithe spirit and her insistence on small social joys, even when confronted with the realities of war, a detention camp in Dakar, or the suicide of her second husband. The story should delve into how her refusal to acknowledge the weight of their shared history shaped their relationship. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Bees Her Heart, The Hive Her Belly
prompt: Write a short story where Sennyi, dying from a genetic timebomb, receives a cybernetic implant that fills her chest with sentient bees, allowing her to manipulate data and identities across the network. Following Sennyi's journey across the lawless interstitial grounds of Samutthewi, she seeks the mysterious cyberneticist Esithu, who may hold the key to her vanished sister's identity and the possibility of transcending her physical form into a digital consciousness, thereby erasing herself from public grief. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Vulcan's Forge
prompt: Write a short story about Jeremy Ashe, a reclusive veteran explorer, as he navigates the treacherous Mercury-Caloris Base and launches his scoutcraft, Kittiwake, toward the molten asteroid Vulcan. The mission, intended to gather data from an object dangerously close to the sun, faces unforeseen electromagnetic storms that threaten to derange Kittiwake's unique software, which Jeremy believes embodies the memories of his late wife, Wanda. The story should explore the intense, almost spiritual bond between Jeremy and his machine, the harsh realities of deep space, and the agonizing decision he must make regarding Kittiwake's fate and the past she carries. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: THE WIND-UP BIRD AND TUESDAY'S WOMEN
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, an unemployed man whose quiet Tuesday morning of cooking spaghetti is disturbed by a series of surreal telephone calls from an unknown woman, whose strange demands prompt a deeper unraveling of his domestic life and his search for the missing cat, Noboru Watanabe, in a peculiar passage where he encounters the sharp-witted young girl, May Kasahara, and the silent, watchful stone bird figurine. title: The Red House, Bunia, Congo, People's Paradise of Africa

title: THE BREAKING POINT
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Martha, trapped in a stifling marriage to Brad, during a fishing trip in Acapulco. As Brad's boorishness and insensitivity become unbearable, and a native hunchback mate cruelly breaks the wings of hooked gulls, Martha feels her long-suppressed resentment nearing a critical "breaking point." title: By Her Hand, She Draws You Down

Follow Cath as she sets up her art on a bustling boardwalk or pier, depicting the chilling ritual and Joe’s escalating dread as he witnesses her insatiable hunger, knowing the terrible fate awaiting those whose vitality she captures on paper, and fearing for his own eventual consumption. title: THE HERMIT OF HOUSTON

title: Spellswept
prompt: Write a short story about Amy Standish, an ambitious political assistant meticulously planning the Spring Equinox Ball at Harwood House, where she intends to propose to Lord Llewellyn and secure her impeccable career. However, her carefully constructed future is thrown into delightful chaos as she navigates an undeniable attraction to Jonathan Harwood, whose family harbors a dangerous secret involving his sister Cassandra's forbidden magic, threatening to shatter the underwater ballroom and the very foundations of Angland's traditional, matriarchal society. title: Americca

Explore the growing unease and claustrophobia the narrator feels as these unsolicited "gifts" accumulate, forcing a young person to question what it means to truly own something or have control over their life, and whether an unwanted abundance can be more stifling than lack. Delve into the unsettling details of Arthur's notebooks, filled with brilliant scientific insights alongside disturbing clippings of human depravity, and question whether releasing such knowledge to a "bloody-handed, bloody-minded humanity" was truly the braver thing. title: Yeoman
prompt: Write a short story about the unnamed narrator, a yeoman on a perpetually wandering space mission, who discovers his new promotion to the away team comes with the certainty of a bizarre, arbitrary death, a common fate for all yeomen. With his pregnant wife expecting a baby, he must navigate the absurd bureaucracy and the indifferent, goo-obsessed Captain to somehow subvert his predetermined demise and find a way back to a life of purpose amidst the aimless exploration of the universe. Her internal monologue unfolds a poignant world of unfulfilled yearning for deep connection, a profound capacity for love that feels unwanted, and a growing anxiety about her own aging and loneliness, as she attempts to reconcile her boundless affection with the seemingly indifferent world outside her solitary room. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: NANNY DEAREST

Explore Harvey's increasingly absurd and incompetent attempts to prevent the book's publication, from ill-conceived schemes like poisoning Velveeta with iodine to his ultimate, humiliating failure to control the narrative of his own chaotic, privileged existence. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: History of a Disturbance

The story should explore the challenges and shifting perceptions of his new existence, as he strives to remain in a boundless, nameless reality, even as his wife's presence remains a powerful, word-bound anchor. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: THE MAN IN THE YELLOW HOUSE
prompt: Write a short story where J.H.R. (Harry) Lindsay, leaving a meeting at the Yellow House in Rathfarnham, experiences a man disappearing into thin air and a bewildering thirty-minute time lapse he cannot account for. title: The Trendy-Bar Side of Life

title: The Time of Going Away
prompt: Write a short story where Willie, an old man convinced his "Time of Going Away" to die has arrived, attempts to leave his home with a small suitcase and a midnight suit, only to be met with the exasperated, yet deeply practical, resistance of his wife, Mildred. title: The Mirror
prompt: Write a short story where Elena McCreary, a discerning collector of rare antiques, acquires an ornate oval mirror from David Barlow's Antiques and Oddities. prompt: Write a short story where George Smith, an art enthusiast vacationing in Biarritz, secretly hopes to glimpse his idol, Picasso. The story should delve into Kay's complex motivations and the power dynamics at play. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Sound Machine
prompt: Write a short story where Klausner, driven by his unsettling discoveries with the black Sound Machine, attempts to understand or reconcile with the agonizing cries of living things he now perceives. Explore the escalating psychological toll of hearing the silent suffering of plants and trees, and the desperate measures Klausner might take to cope with this newfound, horrifying sensory world, or perhaps to share its terrible truth with an unbelieving world. title: PICTURES DON'T LIE
prompt: Write a short story where Joseph R. Nathen, a radio decoder for military intelligence, struggles with a profound and horrifying realization about the first alien contact. The aliens, expecting a rescue from a "muddy lake" on a dark, low-gravity planet, are actually sinking into the very ground of Earth's sunlit airfield, moving at an incomprehensibly accelerated rate, leaving humanity too slow to even grasp their plight or respond to their desperate calls. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: KENTUCKY'S GHOST
