title: Smart-Aleck Kill
prompt: Write a short story where Johnny Dalmas, a cynical private detective, finds himself drawn into a dangerous conspiracy after his client, film director Derek Walden, is found dead in his Kilmarnock penthouse. Tasked with investigating a blackmail plot, Dalmas uncovers a web of deception and betrayal among Hollywood's elite, connecting the murder to figures like Councilman John Sutro. The narrative should capture the grim atmosphere of a hard-boiled mystery as Dalmas navigates double-crosses and violent encounters, pursuing the truth behind the "smart-aleck kill" while battling forces far more powerful than he anticipated. Your story must be approximately 15000 words long.

title: Windbags and Dark Tollins
prompt: Write a short story as Sparkler, a Tollin scientist, faces a crisis in the flooded tunnels beneath Chorleywood Station. His community, the Chorleywood Tollins, struggles against the traditionalist Dark Tollins who disdain his "human" inventions, including his experimental "windbags" and newfangled pumps. As the Dark Tollins assert control and threaten their way of life, Sparkler must rely on his unique blend of borrowed human knowledge and Tollin ingenuity to save his people and reclaim their home. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Divide
prompt: Write a short story where Banamali, an older man deeply devoted to the young Himangshu, cultivates a unique friendship within the family garden, valuing Himangshu’s growing mind above all else. Explore how their profound bond, nurtured through shared time and quiet rituals involving a hookah on the patio, faces an existential threat when a bitter legal dispute erupts between Harachandra and Gokulchandra over the ownership of a drainage ditch and a lime tree. The story should convey Banamali’s quiet despair and the profound, irreversible loss of his cherished daily connection as Himangshu’s absence leaves him isolated and heartbroken. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: THE MERRY CHASE
prompt: Write a short story about the narrator's relentless, exasperated monologue directed at an unseen "you," where the narrator expresses profound frustration and a sense of unacknowledged effort. The story should capture the repetitive, almost suffocating style of their one-sided tirade, exploring the dynamics of a relationship where one party desperately tries to impart wisdom or warnings to an unresponsive listener, making it unclear if the "you" is an external person, a perceived flaw, or an internal conflict. The monologue should convey a sense of being trapped in an endless cycle of advice and accusation. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: A Blinking, Spinning, Breathtaking World
prompt: Write a short story about Charlotte, a single mother navigating an icy world on the eve of a blizzard. As Charlotte takes her son, Sam, to the chaotic Wonderland amusement park, she feels a profound sense of isolation and vigilance. Explore her efforts to protect Sam amid her own anxieties about a failed marriage and the alarming news of the world, especially when an unsettling encounter with a man and his one-armed son raises new fears about hidden dangers lurking beneath everyday appearances. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: HEROIC MEASURES
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, who awakens in a black void, perceiving a "scoreboard" that reveals information and eventually presents a past life, claiming it is theirs. The narrator struggles to reconcile this imposed identity as Jason Bidhope—a man with a violent past and a death sentence—with their own lack of memory, as unseen entities prepare to carry out the punishment for a crime they don't recall committing, questioning the nature of justice and consciousness after a strange form of resurrection. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: Chablis
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, a man who sips Gallo Chablis with an ice cube at dawn, faces the escalating absurdity of his wife's relentless desire for a dog—a Presbyterian Cairn terrier named Michael—for their two-year-old daughter, Joanna. The narrator questions his domestic reality, his former 'black sheep' identity clashing with the mundane anxieties of parenthood, and wonders what a dog could offer Joanna that he cannot, while wrestling with the cost and potential hazards of a new family pet. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: The Waters of Kan-E
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, seated on a veranda on Makatea's north shore, listens as Paul Sargeant reveals the incredible history of Grandma Pu-pu, whose unusual blotched skin is a testament to her twenty-three-day survival at sea after the schooner _Auroheva_ was lost in a devastating hurricane, a test of will against the ocean's fury and the weight of her family's future. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Death Stopped for Miss Dickinson
prompt: Write a short story where Emily Dickinson, living in isolation at The Homestead in Amherst, attempts to escape an intimate relationship and an offer of eternal life from a personified Death. Explore how her prolific, unconventional poetry becomes a profound means of defiance against the kind of immortality Death proposes, even as her sister Lavinia Dickinson struggles with the solemn promise to destroy Emily’s vast collection of papers after her passing, and Colonel Thomas Wentworth Higginson unknowingly contributes to Emily's peculiar legacy. Your story must be approximately 11000 words long.

title: SOLUS
prompt: Write a short story where Simon Canderous, a psychometrist with a past as an art thief, works for Manhattan's Department of Extraordinary Affairs, struggling to prove himself to his cynical partner, Connor Christos. The story should explore Simon's efforts to control his empathy-driven powers in places like a medieval castle atop a skyscraper, where objects vibrate with powerful memories and agitated spirits, questioning what truly defines a person and where a restless soul might find peace. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: The Threadbare Magician
prompt: Write a short story where Roy Macomber, a magician who channels power through Hawaiian shirts, finds himself poisoned and given an ultimatum by Forseti, a god of justice residing in Friendly Village. Roy must decide whether to sacrifice his life for the community he's always avoided or accept an unexpected offer of healing and love from Al Lorca, the charming embodiment of Death. The story explores the protagonist's choices between isolation and connection, as he confronts his past relationships and the true cost of living a magical life in a seemingly mundane world. Your story must be approximately 11000 words long.

title: Memnon
prompt: Write a short story about Memnon, who sets out to become perfectly wise by renouncing passions and worldly temptations. Explore the swift, ironic downfall of his meticulously planned project as he is immediately swindled by a fair lady, loses an eye in a drunken gambling dispute, and finds himself defrauded and mocked by the Nineveh court. Focus on the humorous and despairing contrast between his initial idealism and the chaotic reality he faces, culminating in a dream encounter with a celestial spirit who offers a cynical perspective on the nature of wisdom and happiness in this world. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: An old pub near the Angel
prompt: Write a short story following Charles, an unemployed man living in London, as he unexpectedly receives a significant sum of back pay at the Labour Exchange. Explore his internal jubilation and subsequent aimless wanderings, contrasting his newfound, fleeting wealth with the mundane reality of his life. Focus on his attempt to celebrate at an old pub near the Angel, where he grapples with the quiet desolation of the place and the peculiar, often misunderstood, interactions with the ancient bartender and an elderly female customer, questioning what true connection means amidst his isolation. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Other Woman
prompt: Write a short story where a wife's peaceful contentment with her husband is shattered in the middle of the night when he reads a story about adultery and reveals a profound, unrequited past love for "the other woman." As her husband weeps and seeks comfort, the wife must navigate the sudden chilling realization that his deepest sorrow is not for her, while her body mechanically performs the soothing role of a wife, creating a widening chasm between her outward actions and her internal despair. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Bluebells Between Souls
prompt: Write a short story following the narrator at Sidney's funeral, where Amy brings bluebells as a personal tribute, highlighting her unique connection to the deceased. Explore the contrasting views on the nature of the soul and the afterlife, as the narrator reflects on Sidney's workaholic life and senses a lingering presence in the death seat where he sat. The story should capture the solemnity of the event alongside the intimate, spiritual grappling with loss. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: All You Can Do Is Breathe
prompt: Write a short story about Stuart Parker, a miner who survived a mine collapse after five days underground, encountering an elongated "long man" whose chilling gaze and the smell of sour cherries preceded a profound emotional numbness. Following his rescue and public acclaim, Stuart struggles to reconcile his heroic image with the creeping apathy and the feeling that something essential was taken, leading him to question the true nature of his survival and the strange, skittering creatures he now occasionally senses. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: THE PASSING OF BLACK EAGLE
prompt: Write a short story about Chicken Ruggles, a wily hobo who, after a chance encounter stranded in the Texas wilderness, unwittingly assumes the fearsome identity of Black Eagle, the Terror of the Border. Detail his initial, opportunistic rise within Bud King's bandit gang, how his reputation grows through bluster and appearance rather than true daring, and the ironic turn of events during a planned train robbery at Espina that leads to his abrupt and mysterious vanishing from the bandit life. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Confessor
prompt: Write a short story where Rebecca Sanchez, a licensed peace officer climbing Mt. Rainier, pursues a murder investigation that leads her to a hidden compound. There, she uncovers a clandestine operation involved in the genetic engineering and trafficking of cryptids like the Pacific tree octopus, and the disturbing exploitation of children like Martha and Matt Darwish, who suffer from progeria. Explore Sanchez's moral and professional conflict when the operation's leader turns out to be linked to her complicated past, forcing her to make difficult choices about justice and truth. Your story must be approximately 16000 words long.

title: Better You Believe
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the unnamed narrator as she endures a perilous descent from Annapurna's summit. Following a catastrophic avalanche and the deaths of Jakub and Acke, the narrator battles extreme conditions and mounting psychological dread within the Death Zone. Explore her struggle to locate Nick and Kate amidst the treacherous, transformed terrain, clinging to denial and a profound loyalty to Nick as her only anchors against the mountain's indifferent, deadly grip and the haunting memory of Felix's fall. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: Alien abduction
prompt: Write a short story where a seemingly trivial rumor, like Theodore Gutch's note about "marshuns" landing in Lowerfold Park, spirals into a full-blown town-wide event, compelling children to march on the Town Hall and demand answers from the Mayor. Explore how collective imagination fuels the belief in fantastical events, such as the abduction of Miss Bowen, and how adult figures like Malcolm Bentley navigate this unique childhood uprising when faced with absurd, yet earnest, demands. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: It's A Shame About Ray
prompt: Write a short story about Ray, a new father who adopts a detached "cool guy" persona to navigate the overwhelming demands of his wife and their squirming baby. Explore his increasingly cynical internal monologue as mundane tasks, like a trip to the supermarket for a cooked chicken, become fraught with existential dread. Follow Ray's desperate search for control or meaning amidst the "things" of his new life, leading to a catastrophic accident that forces a confrontation with his own profound detachment and the physical manifestation of pain. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Tales from the Underworld My Friend the Crook
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator meets Otsche, a smooth-talking crook fresh out of prison, in a grimy fourth-class waiting room past midnight. Otsche, quick to spot a plainclothesman watching a young girl with a valise of hot gems, begins to plot, sharing his cynical philosophy on human nature and criminal enterprise. The narrator becomes unwittingly entangled in Otsche's manipulative schemes, which culminate in a sudden, violent act to facilitate an escape. Explore the dark humor and brutal pragmatism of the underworld as the narrator grapples with the cost of misplaced trust. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: Bunia, Congo, People's Paradise of Africa
prompt: Write a short story where Michelle visits a "survivor hospital" in Bunia, Congo, to get her friend Joey's leg treated, only to discover the horrific scale of sexual violence endured by women like Makemba, who is healing but also praises the Nshombo regime. The story explores Michelle's struggle to reconcile the Nshombos' claimed benevolence and "free health care" with the regime's other alleged atrocities, such as experiments on children in the "People's Paradise of Africa." The cheerful nurse's insistent propaganda about Alicia Nshombo as the "Mother of the Country" clashes sharply with the quiet suffering of the patients. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: Gravity Box
prompt: Write a short story about Jen Cable, a brilliant student who meticulously plans to escape her decaying Earth home for the orbital colonies, illicitly funding her future through academic tutoring. Explore the terrifying "gravity" of her abusive father Warren's escalating control and violence, which threatens to derail all her carefully laid plans. Delve into the brutal choices Jen must make to truly sever ties and achieve autonomy, grappling with the traumatic aftermath of her fight for freedom and questioning whether true escape is ever possible. Your story must be approximately 13000 words long.

title: The Philosophy Lesson
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Cora Savage, a life model whose profound stillness on the dais in a Gothic art studio is broken by the news of a student's violent suicide on a snowy day. As Cora maintains her difficult pose, enduring physical pain and observing the world through her unique lens of detachment and deep inner thought, she finds her practiced anonymity cracking, forcing her to confront the unsettling echoes of the tragedy within her own hidden memories and philosophical ponderings, while the students around her react with superficial curiosity. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: I. AM. THE. PILOT.
prompt: Write a short story about Mala, a boy living in the ruins near old Atlanta, who discovers a crashed mec and its dying pilot, learning a shocking truth about the ongoing war and the A-Eye's control. Mala, seeking vengeance for his destroyed village, enters the abandoned mec, believing he can wield its power, only to discover he has become an unwilling vehicle, his body a mere puppet for the relentless A-Eye as it forces him into the battlefield. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Fur
prompt: Write a short story where Suzanne and Eleanor orchestrate an elaborate plan to secure a luxurious fur coat for Suzanne's birthday from their wealthy cousin, Bertram Kneyght, during an 'accidental' encounter at Goliath and Mastodon's department store, exploring the intricate social maneuvering and hidden agendas that emerge when material desires clash with the façade of friendship, leading to an unexpected exchange of gifts and a bitter realization for one of the women. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Santos del Infierno
prompt: Write a short story about Ron Marks, a man drowning in grief and alcohol after a devastating car accident, who is slowly drawn into a disturbing quest by Leonardo Montoya, the truck driver responsible for his loss. Following Montoya's insidious lead, Ron seeks a set of profane santos, grotesque religious carvings said to open a portal to unimaginable pleasures in a dimension called Hell, forcing Ron to confront the true nature of his despair and the insidious price of escape. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Bird with the Broken Wing
prompt: Write a short story where Mr. Satterthwaite, an elderly connoisseur of human tragedies, arrives at Laidell, a remote country house, drawn by a mysterious message following a séance. He becomes captivated by Mabelle Annesley, an ethereal young woman he perceives as "a bird with a broken wing," whose otherworldly happiness is chilling. When Mabelle is found dead, initially believed to be suicide, Mr. Satterthwaite must use his peculiar "flair" to uncover the true nature of her demise and expose the hidden malevolence within the seemingly ordinary house party, questioning if death is indeed the greatest evil. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: PHYSIS VERSUS NOMOS
prompt: Write a short story following the narrator’s attempt to replace a window shade, where the window-shade man’s relentless focus on the precise definitions of grommets, brackets, and cuffs transforms a simple transaction into an absurd, circular, and increasingly philosophical debate. Explore how this escalating pedantry exposes the limits of communication and reality, leading to a surprising, physical assertion of will over the mundane object itself. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Several Losses
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, an introspective woman who meticulously observes the world around her, from a stranger kicking grass in Central Park to her friend Jill's gradual physical decline and accumulating "several losses." The story explores the narrator's internal struggle with the unreliable nature of her own friendships—a pattern of "over-immersion followed by withdrawal"—as she grapples with the unspooling hardships of Jill and her son Paul, and the search for meaning amidst life's inevitable disappearances. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: THE RADIATOR
prompt: Write a short story where Des, attempting to bleed a stubbornly cold radiator, accidentally tastes the murky brown water and finds it unexpectedly delicious. Explore the immediate aftermath as Des is seized by an overwhelming desire for more of the strangely appealing liquid, leading him to ignore common sense and his friend Benny's advice. What happens when his bizarre craving takes over, and how does he recover from a collapse caused by his new obsession, leaving him forever questioning if the water was truly delicious or merely a figment of his stressed imagination? Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Blood and Water
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Stellan, a powerful Mar who rescues Angelina Ralston from a deadly ferry accident in 1906 San Francisco. As a telepathic blood bond deepens between them, Stellan must conceal his true nature and the ancient underwater tombs of his kind from Angelina and her family, even as his ruthless sister, Salila, schemes to feed on the city's inhabitants. When a devastating earthquake strikes, threatening to expose the Mar and Angelina’s fragile human life, Stellan confronts the ultimate cost of their forbidden love. Your story must be approximately 16000 words long.

title: A Prism of Darkness
prompt: Write a short story where Dr. John Dee, in his study in Mortlake, England, is visited by a being in a yellow mask who has commissioned him to translate a forbidden Greek text. Dee struggles with his waning faculties and the unsettling sensation that the book translates itself, realizing his role is merely a prism for unfolding darkness. Explore his journey through increasingly vivid, disorienting dreams, from comforting domesticity to terrifying scrying visions for Queen Elizabeth at Whitehall. The narrative should culminate in his final voyage with the masked figure, seeking ultimate truth beyond human understanding, even as reality and dream become indistinguishable. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: All Dreams Are Night Dreams
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, playing the villain Grimwald in the Aqua-Aerial Ballet “Night Dreams,” navigates the chaotic, illusion-filled world of a Vegas performance, grappling with his role and the blurred lines between script and reality. Explore what it means for Grimwald to truly become peril incarnate, particularly as he is expected to hold Piper, the Woman in Peril, underwater, questioning if his ultimate act of villainy might be to deviate from the script and truly let her go. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Deceptions
prompt: Write a short story following private investigator Sharon McCone as she investigates the supposed suicide of Vanessa DiCesare, whose car and a formal suicide note were found abandoned near the Golden Gate Bridge. McCone initially suspects Vanessa faked her death to escape her controlling family and fiancé, but her search through the foggy, historic Fort Point uncovers a darker truth involving park ranger Lee Gottschalk and a shocking act of violence that lies beneath the surface of San Francisco's iconic landmarks. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: Heavy-Set
prompt: Write a short story about Heavy-Set, a thirty-year-old man of immense physical strength who fills his days with solitary exercise, surfing, and meticulous pumpkin carving, yet remains profoundly isolated. Explore the night he returns early from a failed Halloween party, unable to connect with peers or girls, and his mother's escalating anxiety as she witnesses his withdrawal and the unsettling, rhythmic sound of the steel springs being crushed in his fists, highlighting the quiet desperation within their shared home. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Painted Face
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Xena Francavilla, a young woman on a chaperoned tour, as she navigates the unfamiliar landscapes of Tunis and feels a profound, unsettling transformation within herself. Formerly sheltered and pious, Xena finds herself drawn to ancient, almost pagan impulses, shedding her old self by cutting her hair, choosing bold new fashions, and seeking mysterious, forgotten places like the Rock of Sidi Fathallah and the desolate mountain of Bou Kornine. Explore her struggle between duty to Santa Rosalia and a burgeoning, powerful identity rooted in an ancient past, as her perceptions of reality blur and she embraces an unexpected, potent destiny. Your story must be approximately 31000 words long.

title: HOW FEAR DEPARTED FROM THE LONG GALLERY
prompt: Write a short story about Madge Dalrymple, resting in the Long Gallery at Church-Peveril as evening approaches, where the Peveril family treats most spectres with amused indifference but universally fears the twin-baby ghosts linked to the gallery's dark history. Explore Madge's mounting dread as she realizes she is alone after sunset, facing the dreaded apparition that has brought terrible fates to past observers like Mrs. Canning. The narrative should delve into how Madge, instead of fear, finds an overwhelming sense of pity for the child-ghosts, and how this compassionate response affects her and the haunting. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: A Round of Visits
prompt: Write a short story where Mark Monteith, a gentleman devastated by financial ruin and betrayal by Phil Bloodgood, seeks solace in a series of New York encounters. Following his draining visit with the self-absorbed Mrs. Folliott and Mrs. Ash at The Pocahontas hotel, Mark Monteith finds an unexpected, unsettling connection with Newton Winch, an old acquaintance whose mysterious refinement and acute perception of suffering mask his own tragic secret, leading to a desperate final act. Explore the complex interplay of isolation, superficiality, and profound human connection in a city that seems to both foster and obscure deep personal anguish. Your story must be approximately 11000 words long.

title: Hudden and Dudden and Donald O'Neary
prompt: Write a short story where the cunning Donald O'Neary, a poor but resourceful man, repeatedly outsmarts his wealthy, greedy, and increasingly foolish neighbors, Hudden and Dudden. Following an initial act of malice against Donald's only cow, Daisy, Donald uses his quick wit, a seemingly magical hide, and a series of escalating deceptions involving hidden gold, borrowed scales, and a dangerous journey to the Brown Lake, to turn the tables on those who wish him ill, always leading them to their own ridiculous downfall. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Tawny Petticoats
prompt: Write a short story where the master con artists Darger and Surplus recruit the audacious Tawny Petticoats in a fantastical New Orleans to pull off an intricate "black money" scam, only to discover their most cunning mark might be within their own ranks. Explore the shifting alliances and betrayals as they navigate deals with powerful figures like Madam-Mayor Tresjolie and Master Bones, all while a grand deception unfolds amidst zombie laborers and pygmy mastodons. Your story must be approximately 11000 words long.

title: A Hunter's Fate Greedo's Tale
prompt: Write a short story about Greedo, a young Rodian who dreams of following his bounty hunter father's legacy among the stars, finding himself a naïve apprentice to Warhog Goa on the bustling, lawless moon of Nar Shaddaa. The story should explore Greedo's ambition to become the galaxy's toughest Rodian hunter, his initial forays into the dangerous trade, and the cold betrayals he faces as he pursues a notorious target on Tatooine, ultimately confronting the true, brutal nature of his chosen path. Your story must be approximately 14000 words long.

title: The Juniper Tree
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, after failing to visit her dying friend Robin Ross in the hospital, is confronted with a surreal reunion at Robin's house. The narrator joins Robin's friends, Isabel and Pat, for a ghostly gathering among the strange, struggling juniper trees in Robin's yard. Explore the disorienting reality of grief, friendship, and artistic expression as gin rickeys are consumed and the boundaries between life and death blur, revealing unspoken truths and a profound sense of inadequacy. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Beautiful Dream
prompt: Write a short story following Martin Haberland as, three days before his death from pneumonia, he embarks on an extraordinary fever dream. From his childhood home, through a fantastical landscape, Martin journeys up the Mountain of Knowledge with Professor Siedler, becomes an architect to build a glorious palace, and finally descends into a blue valley where he experiences love with the village mayor's daughter, discovering that love and death are two facets of ultimate fulfillment. Explore how this profound inner experience grants him a complete life, despite its brevity. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Ambiguous Nature
prompt: Write a short story about astronomer Albert Griffin at the Kata Tjuta Large Radio Array observatory as he and engineer Ralph Kunmanara detect a mysterious signal composed of prime numbers during a fierce Australian storm. Explore the mounting ambiguity of their discovery when young Liam claims to have "mind-talked" with "sky people" about the same numbers and faster-than-light communication, forcing Albert to question the boundaries of scientific understanding and whether the signal is truly extraterrestrial intelligence, an equipment anomaly, or something else entirely. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: BETWEEN HERE AND THE YELLOW SEA
prompt: Write a short story following Robert Corresi, a young man from Port Arthur, Texas, as he drives across the country with his former football coach, Coach Duprene, on a misguided mission to bring Duprene's daughter, Amanda, home from Los Angeles. Explore Robert's introspective nature and his tendency to create "stories" to explain his past, especially the lingering trauma of his broken jaw and his idealized memories of Amanda, as he confronts the stark reality of her life as Mandy LeRock and the hollowness of his own longings. The narrative should capture the desolate atmosphere of the journey and the painful clash between illusion and truth. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: THE BURNING DAYS
prompt: Write a short story where Carson, Robert, Lainey, and Henry maintain a dwindling fire perimeter around their cabin against the encroaching "dead." As the cabin's structure is cannibalized for fuel and tensions mount between Carson, Robert, and Lainey, the group must confront the grim inevitability of their situation. When the fire wall collapses, a desperate act reveals a horrifying new method for survival—using the dead themselves as an unending source of fuel. Explore the psychological toll and moral compromises the survivors face, trapped indefinitely in this inferno with their only company the moaning dead and the sickly sweet scent of burning bodies. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Bull
prompt: Write a short story where Jimmy Darrow, a cynical special agent for the Southern Pacific Railroad in 1943 Phoenix, investigates a severed foot found on the tracks, a "routine job" that quickly pulls him into the city's corrupt underworld. He navigates tense encounters with brutal local cops like Frenchy Navarre and city commissioner Duke Simms, discovering connections between missing persons, secret shipments, and the war's darker influences. The narrative should capture Darrow's weary disillusionment as he confronts the moral decay beneath Phoenix's wartime boom, culminating in the unexpected revelation of a secret, high-profile train operation. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Walking Stick Fires
prompt: Write a short story following the courier Parka, who plans to dress as Dwight D. Eisenhower, and his companion Jar, who favors Jack Nicklaus, as they navigate a surreal, post-apocalyptic desert. Explore their dry-witted banter and deep friendship amidst a perilous quest to deliver the Amulet of Ruby Webs, while uncovering the bizarre, escalating mystery of the ubiquitous walking sticks and their connection to the scorched land. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Not Quite Arcadia
prompt: Write a short story where Myra, a woman distressed by her aging appearance, is given mysterious animal organs by Stevie, the butcher's assistant. Following Myra's consumption of these organs, her old face peels away, triggering an unsettling process of unnatural rejuvenation that gradually strips her of her identity, memories, and ultimately her humanity, as she regresses towards an unknown primal state, ending up near the vast Smithfield Meat Market. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: DID HE DO IT
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, an astute observer living near the Kennet and Avon Canal, becomes increasingly convinced of a dark deed involving the boisterous Mr. Limpley and his tyrannical bulldog Ponto. The narrative should explore the psychological torment of holding an unshakeable suspicion of a crime—the tragic drowning of the Limpleys' baby—despite the complete absence of tangible proof, revealing how subtle shifts in character and circumstance can build an internal certainty that defies logic or external verification. Your story must be approximately 13000 words long.

title: The State of the Party
prompt: Write a short story following Calum and Crooky as their acid trip intensifies, transforming the streets of Leith into a nightmarish landscape after Boaby Preston collapses and dies at Chizzie's party. Explore the mounting paranoia and desperate schemes they concoct to dispose of the body, all while their perceptions warp and the urban environment becomes a source of escalating threat and moral compromise. Your story must be approximately 11000 words long.

title: TOMORROW IS MY DANCING DAY
prompt: Write a short story about the unnamed girl from "TOMORROW IS MY DANCING DAY" as she accompanies her volatile mother on another desperate, wandering journey through rural Alabama, where their path leads them back to Tuscaloosa. Explore how the girl navigates her mother's manipulative schemes, like the one involving the Elvis look-alike at the cemetery, and grapples with the unsettling truth that escape might be a cyclical illusion. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Hic Jacet
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, Harrison, a commercially successful author, attempts to write the biography of his deceased artist friend, Michael Andriaovsky. As Harrison works in his London library, he places Andriaovsky's portrait nearby, but soon finds his hand and mind inexplicably paralyzed whenever he touches upon his own past artistic compromises or perceived betrayals of art. The story explores Harrison's escalating struggle against this unseen spiritual censor, manifested by the very spirit of Andriaovsky, and whether Harrison can truly capture the artist's uncompromising nature without facing his own artistic damnation. Your story must be approximately 13000 words long.

title: ANGEL'S EGG
prompt: Write a short story where Dr. David Bannerman, a reclusive retired biologist in a Maine cottage, discovers a tiny, telepathic "angel" hatched from a strange blue egg laid by his hen, Camilla. As the angel shares astounding knowledge and wisdom from beyond Earth, Bannerman grapples with a choice: live out his remaining years in serene understanding or undertake a mysterious process of "total recall" that will transmit his entire life's experience to the angels but result in his death, for humanity's uncertain future. Your story must be approximately 15000 words long.

title: MANSLAUGHTER
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Beatrice Grazia where she navigates the aftermath of Eddie Farrell's violent crime, her own life quietly unraveling as her husband Tony abandons her, and a new, unsettling relationship begins with Ron Boci, forcing her to confront a pervasive sense of powerlessness in a world where accountability is elusive. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: In Limbo
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Anderson, an unemployed man isolated in his basement apartment, as mysterious static consumes his electronic devices and a pervasive, unnatural blackness outside his windows swallows his neighbors. Explore his desperate, futile attempts to seal himself off from the encroaching void, and how he confronts the ultimate disintegration of his reality, culminating in a chilling reunion through a shimmering static mirror. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Murder in Repose
prompt: Write a short story where Sister Fidelma, a qualified _Anruth_ in ancient Ireland, must defend Brother Fergal, a monk accused of murdering Barrdub, whose body was discovered in his _bothán_ on Cnoc-gorm. Despite seemingly irrefutable evidence, Fidelma suspects a deliberate setup, meticulously investigating the scene and interrogating key figures like the Brehon, the hermit Erca, and Barrdub's brother Congal. The story should explore Fidelma’s keen deductions as she navigates the complexities of ancient law and unravels a calculated crime rooted in avarice. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: Sixty Acres

On the island, the duo must navigate a perilous landscape inhabited by bizarre, hat-wearing animal-human hybrids, including the cunning Brer Fox and his weasel enforcers. The story should immerse the reader in their desperate fight for survival against these uncanny creatures and the island's ultimate horror: the impending ritualistic summoning of the monstrous entity known as Cut Through You before the entire island vanishes. Your story must be approximately 16000 words long.

title: Stage Kiss
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, a seasoned actor whose face is widely known but whose name remains obscure, as he navigates the blurred lines between performance and authentic experience. Explore the narrator's detached observation of his own life, from his meticulously crafted stage kisses with Clair to his unsettling interactions with a director obsessed with his appearance, and even his visits to Steph, the dentist. Delve into how his personal relationships and seemingly mundane encounters become part of his ongoing performance, raising questions about the truth of his connections and the 'unplayable' lines of his own existence. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Gold Boy, Emerald Girl
prompt: Write a short story about Siyu, a librarian who has remained unmarried, and Hanfeng, newly returned to Beijing, as their lives are subtly directed by Hanfeng's strong-willed mother, Professor Dai, towards an arranged marriage for companionship. Explore the quiet desperation and shared history—including Siyu's mother's tragic past and Professor Dai's own difficult widowhood—that leads them to consider a future together in Professor Dai's apartment, where piano melodies and unspoken emotions fill the spaces between them. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: THE PRACTICE OF EVERYDAY LIFE
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Gordon, a verbose and "stippy-minded" individual who grapples with the absurdities of everyday language and human behavior. Explore his internal monologue as he observes the world around him, from a dog sneezing at his friend Krupp's house to a child's tantrum over movies or a woman placing a lost mitten on a fire hydrant. Let his observations reveal a deep-seated frustration with societal norms and his own perceived loss of significance, as he feels increasingly relegated to merely being "an audience for everything." Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: Twember
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Will, living on his parents' farmhouse in eastern Colorado, where massive, glittering escarpments move across the plains, leaving behind inexplicable temporal distortions and strange objects like a pristine antique oil lamp or a partial daguerreotype. The story should explore Will’s attempts to understand these phenomena and their impact on his family, especially his son Jeff, who was affected by a passing wall, and his wife Tracy, as they grapple with the disorienting "Twember" season and a world constantly shifting between past and present. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: The Golem Hunt
prompt: Write a short story where Jasmine, a sharp-tongued monster hunter, and her ancient vampire partner, Vayl, track a rampaging golem. This creature, unleashed by Rabbi Klein at Moses Temple, leaves a trail of grotesque carnage and shifts vital runes to evade destruction, requiring the duo to combine their unique skills and wits. Explore their professional banter, the visceral horror of their hunt through locations like Berringwood Park, and the underlying complexities of their partnership as they face a challenge that forces Jasmine to confront her own limits and the very nature of control. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Publicity Campaign
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Prince Zervashni, a good-natured Rigellian envoy, as his mission of peaceful contact with Earth descends into chaos. Explore his growing confusion and eventual exasperation as humans attack his envoys, seemingly convinced by a pervasive "Publicity Campaign" depicting alien monsters, leading him to make the difficult decision to respond to their unprovoked hostility. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: The Good Poet of Africa
prompt: Write a short story about an unnamed diplomat, newly transferred to the Indian consulate in San Francisco, who finds his cynical detachment challenged by the city's peculiar inhabitants. After arriving from Nairobi, the narrator attempts to navigate an absurd new role, encountering his overly enthusiastic assistant Baggie, a cult leader named Dr. Geronimo Boyce III, and his apathetic daughter Double Love, all while being persistently mistaken for "the good poet of Africa" due to mysterious Urdu ghazals. Explore the narrator's struggle with identity and the strange reality that unfolds around him, leading to a surprising revelation about the source of the poems. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Quinceañera
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the unnamed narrator, now working in a donut shop, reflecting on a childhood friendship with Lili and Ros, two immigrant sisters. Explore how the elaborate quinceañera party, subtly influenced by the narrator and funded by the family's deep sacrifices, became an unexpected turning point that irrevocably altered their lives and led to lasting blame. Focus on the tension between childhood innocence and the harsh realities of poverty, family dysfunction, and cultural misunderstandings, all while the narrator insists that it was "not my fault." Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: PATCHES
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the little girl where, after moving into a new house, she forms a unique bond with the strange, deteriorating patch of sky directly above their home. This sky, distinct from all others with its liver spots and faint purr, becomes her only true friend as her parents grow increasingly distant. Explore her quiet desperation and impossible choices when her Father, convinced the defective sky is a ruin, hires an engineer to actively destroy it, forcing the little girl to confront the imminent loss of her singular companion and question what 'fresh starts' truly mean. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Blood Sacrifice
prompt: Write a short story where Ambassador Spock, disguised and working with the Romulan Underground, seeks to uncover the truth behind Emperor Shiarkiek's assassination amidst the volatile Romulan Senate's debates on war and neutrality. His logical mission is complicated by the return of Ruanek, a loyal Romulan now living on Vulcan, whose fierce sense of honor demands vengeance for the Emperor, potentially leading to a confrontation at the sacred Hallows near the firefalls of Gal Gath'thong. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: On the Town Route
prompt: Write a short story following the unnamed narrator and Cass as they deliver ice cream along the "town route" into the isolated Blue Ridge mountains, where the mundane gives way to the uncanny. Explore the growing unease as the narrator encounters the strange inhabitants, including Maidie, the "bearded lady," Sam, and the children like Kimberly and Little Eva, whose lives are intertwined with ancient secrets and the land itself. The story should culminate in the unsettling revelation of a hidden, perhaps sacrificial, purpose behind the mountain community's existence and the narrator's ultimate isolation. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: THE WARRIOR PRINCESS OZIMBA
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, Mr. Ed, maintains a peculiar annual tradition of delivering blue tennis shoes to the ancient, blind Warrior Princess Ozimba on the Fourth of July. Explore the quiet ritual as Ozimba, mistaking Mr. Ed for his deceased father, Mr. Phil, shares fragmented memories from her long life, blurring the lines between past and present, and confronting the narrator with the weight of fading time and inherited devotion in the Southern heat. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Dreams of Forgotten Alchemists (from Frankenstein)
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the Creature, newly animated and abandoned near Ingolstadt, as it struggles to comprehend the world through confused senses. Explore its first chilling sensations of cold, hunger, and light, its discovery of fire, and the dawning realization of its own monstrous otherness while observing the natural world around it. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: The Morgue Boys
prompt: Write a short story following Patrolman Frank Mistretta, the "oldest rookie" of Brownsville's 73rd Precinct, as he patrols the drug-ridden streets, a "plague" of crack cocaine and corruption having consumed the neighborhood. Explore the moral ambiguities faced by officers operating in a forgotten Brooklyn district where the lines between law enforcement and criminality blur, leading to the infamous "Morgue Boys" scandal and a public trial that questions who is truly doing "God's work." Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Very Last Drop
prompt: Write a short story following the retired detective Rebus as he investigates a decades-old brewery 'accident' involving Johnny Watt, whose supposed ghost haunts the facility. Rebus uncovers a tangled secret of guilt and complicity, centered on Albert Simms, the long-time brewery guide burdened by a past he helped conceal. Explore the weight of a hidden truth and the unexpected ways justice can be sought, even when official channels are closed, as Rebus pushes Simms to finally confront his actions. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Lighthouse Keeper
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the boy, who delivers parcels to the square, granite lighthouse, and observes the solitary, one-handed lighthouse keeper and his caged blackbird. Explore the boy’s unsettling visions and his yearning to hear his drowned father’s voice from the channel, as he navigates a changing world where the former keeper is dismissed and new figures arrive, blurring the line between local gossip, fading memory, and persistent truths in the isolated coastal town. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: Pillar of Fire
prompt: Write a short story about William Lantry, who awakens centuries after his death in the year 2349, a world meticulously scrubbed clean of death, fear, and superstition, where all corpses are swiftly converted into energy by a vast Incinerator. Explore Lantry's profound hatred for this antiseptic reality as he, a walking anachronism, embarks on a chilling quest to reintroduce the concept of true horror and "dead people" into a society that cannot comprehend murder or the macabre, desperate to find or create company in his unique, terrifying existence. Your story must be approximately 14000 words long.

title: Tell the Women We're Going
prompt: Write a short story following Bill Jamison and Jerry Roberts, two lifelong friends whose Saturday afternoon escape from domesticity takes an unnerving turn. After leaving Jerry’s house and shooting pool at the Rec Center, they cruise the Naches River highway, seeking an undefined thrill, leading them to encounter two girls near Picture Rock. Explore the simmering tension between Jerry’s unsettling impulses and Bill’s quiet complicity, as their casual outing culminates in a senseless act of violence that irrevocably shatters their shared world. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: STORM BLOOD
prompt: Write a short story where Sergeant Lejeune and her National Guard fireteam must navigate the devastating floods and winds of Hurricane Katrina in New Orleans, only to encounter two deadly, monstrous creatures—a savage rougarou and a technologically advanced Yautja—forcing them to protect an unconscious boy and question the very nature of reality amidst their desperate struggle for survival. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Prey
prompt: Write a short story where Amelia, a woman stifled by her mother's controlling grip, finds herself hunted within her own apartment by a Zuni fetish doll named "He Who Kills," which she had intended as a gift. Explore Amelia's escalating terror and her desperate struggle against the small, knife-wielding figure, leading to a chilling transformation of her own identity as she embraces a new, predatory instinct, waiting in the darkness for the prey to come. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Technical Error
prompt: Write a short story following Dr. Ralph Hughes as he grapples with an unprecedented scientific anomaly after the superconducting generator's malfunction leaves technician Richard Nelson laterally inverted. Explore Hughes's desperate attempts to understand this impossible state, delving into theories of higher dimensions, and the escalating human cost as Nelson slowly starves. The story should culminate in Hughes's high-stakes plan to reverse Nelson's condition, with the fate of the power station hanging in the balance. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: SAM BELOW PAR
prompt: Write a short story about the narrator, a disgraced Earth golf course designer, who is whisked away to Selene on the Moon by the maverick entrepreneur Sam Gunn, insisting on building a revolutionary golf course in the airless Hell Crater. The narrator must overcome the lunar environment's impossible challenges, navigate Sam's audacious schemes, and confront his past when his lost love, champion golfer Mai Pohan, arrives to compete in the inaugural Lunar Golf Invitational, where unexpected technologies like flexible nanosuits and even "guided" golf balls challenge the very nature of the sport. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: Emotional Dues
prompt: Write a short story about Girder, an artist whose deeply emotional paintings draw the attention of Mr. Rasp, a grotesque collector on the remote Rasp Estate. Explore the escalating horror as Girder realizes Rasp literally consumes the raw emotions from his artworks, draining not only the canvases until only foul-smelling tallow remains, but also the artist himself, leaving him hollow and seeing his assistant, Nadir, stained with residual colors. Your story must be approximately 11000 words long.

title: White Girl, Fine Girl
prompt: Write a short story following Jayson Paul Evans, a man released from Kilby prison after twenty years for manslaughter, as he walks across the dusty, hot Southern landscape back to Stanhope. Explore his expectation of reuniting with Aggie, the mother of his child, and how his violent past and the changed realities of his old neighborhood, where his own daughter Alice Mary leads a defense against him with rocks, force him to confront an unsettling future, perhaps seeking a different kind of "white girl, fine girl" as an escape. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: Knowing He Was Not My Kind Yet I Followed
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Corporal Deed Ainsworth, a Confederate cavalryman who hates the killing business but participates in General Jeb Stuart’s chaotic raids across Pennsylvania. Explore Deed's profound alienation from his comrades and his peculiar, unrequited devotion to the charismatic yet brutal General, even as the war's absurdity and violence erode his own sense of self and morality, leaving him adrift and morally compromised. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: White Time
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Sheneel Carpenter, a student on an occupation-tasting placement at Commonweal White Time Laboratories, where the initially 'boring' task of observing 'field officer' Lon Klegg's work—redirecting bizarre 'entities' suspended in the gravity-free, mind-scrambling 'white time' reservoir—unfolds into a revelation of the profound, alien realities that lie beneath the ordinary. Explore Sheneel's growing disorientation and the unnerving secrets of Lon's past time-travel, culminating in a dangerous incident that exposes the true, non-human toll of working in white time and forces Sheneel to reconsider her understanding of reality and the nature of work itself. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: Jack the Ripper
prompt: Write a short story about the man who discovers a young, drunken girl unconscious on a deserted city street late at night. After being met with indifference by a callous bartender and another man at a nearby bar, the man meticulously brings the girl to her dilapidated tenement room. Explore the man's chilling composure and the unsettling details he observes, from the girl's notebook containing lists of sailors to the squalor of her room. The story should build an atmosphere of quiet menace, revealing the man's seemingly benevolent actions as a facade for something far more sinister and predatory. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Billy Will's Song
prompt: Write a short story where Billy Will Jackson, newly fitted with a shiny plastic arm and fueled by beer, travels on a bus from Moline to Peoria, endlessly singing "If this is all it is." Explore his attempts to assert his newfound "class" and the significance of his lawsuit, even as he provokes his unresponsive wife, Norma Jean, and other passengers. The story should capture his self-deluding bravado and the gritty, confined reality of the journey. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: On the Line
prompt: Write a short story following Wanda, who works on a meat processing plant's boning table, where the pervasive smell of animal blood and the brutal rhythm of the kill floor define her days. Explore Wanda's fierce yearning to escape this life and the aggressive men, particularly Karl Willson, as she navigates unsettling incidents, like the severed calf's head in her locker, pushing her toward a definitive break from the town and her grim existence. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Walk to Lingham
prompt: Write a short story following Jorkens on his isolated walk back to Lingham across the flat fen-country, where the eerie silence after the woodmen's departure is broken by the unsettling sound of a distinct pursuit. Explore Jorkens's mounting, primal terror as he realizes he is being stalked not by anything human or animal, but by one of the recently felled poplar trees, whose "clod clod" steps and "swish" of bending twigs are fueled by a dreadful, unyielding will against mankind, forcing him to maintain a slow, steady pace while resisting the terrifying urge to flee. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: An Error in Chemistry
prompt: Write a short story where Joel Flint has confessed to killing his wife, setting in motion a meticulous investigation by the sheriff and Uncle Gavin in the remote county. The narrative explores Flint's unsettling confidence and the subtle clues that hint at a profound deception, such as an odd detail about his whiskey or the strange behavior of old Wesley Pritchel. Delve into the complex interplay between truth and justice as the characters grapple with a killer who seems to want to be caught, yet aims to vanish completely. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: The Story of a Masterpiece
prompt: Write a short story where John Lennox, a wealthy widower engaged to the charming Marian Everett, commissions a portrait by artist Stephen Baxter that begins to subtly expose a disquieting truth about Marian’s character. Explore Lennox's growing unease as the painting, meant to capture his fiancée's beauty, seems instead to reveal a deeper, unsettling shallowness beneath her flawless facade, leading to a desperate act of disillusionment just before their wedding day. Your story must be approximately 13000 words long.

title: SPEAKING TO SKULL KINGS
prompt: Write a short story following Genevieve and Joseph as they brave the eerie ghost forest after their bird-protector, Bird, vanishes from their safe clearing. As Genevieve seeks Bird, she confronts the relentless skull kings and begins to question the stories of protection she was told. Explore Genevieve's transformation as she gathers black roses to protect Joseph, grappling with the haunting truth that "someone always leaves in the end," and whether she can break this cycle despite dreaming of other forests herself. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: SPRINGTIME À LA CARTE
prompt: Write a short story where Sarah, a freelance typist creating menus for Schulenberg's Home Restaurant, awaits a letter from her farmer fiancé, Walter, as spring reluctantly arrives in New York. Follow Sarah in her cold hall room as she meticulously types the day's bill of fare, her mind adrift in bittersweet memories of dandelions and country fields. A moment of poignant despair leads to a curious error on a menu card, an accidental message that becomes the improbable key to a city reunion, showcasing how fate often works through the smallest, most personal details. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Motherless Bear
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the bear, whose mother's death becomes the central, performative tragedy of her life. Following a brief, brutal encounter with a muzzled male bear in a village, the bear herself becomes a traveling entertainer, disfigured and forced to dance for human audiences. Explore her ongoing struggle to tell the story of her mother's death through the muzzle and the laughter, perpetually searching for the one person in the crowd who truly understands her suffering amidst the degrading spectacle of her new existence. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Summer of Questions
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Riva Stern, a twenty-year-old assistant bookkeeper at the H. G. Withers Company in 1966, as her summer of expected invincibility transforms into a season of disquieting questions. The story explores Riva navigating the restrictive "harem" of the bookkeeping department and a secret romance with her cousin David, all while uncovering uncomfortable truths about her family's hidden past. As she observes the stifling societal expectations for women, Riva's growing disillusionment leads her to a more independent and defiant understanding of the world around her. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: An Imperial Egoist and a Car Wallah
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator hosts Mrs. Mahawal, an Indian tenant with six degrees and an Ayn Rand-inspired ego, whose relentless demands for convenience and service—from dictating TV watching hours to ordering the narrator to empty her bins and repair her broken appliances—gradually erode the narrator's hospitality. Explore the mounting frustration and the turning point when the narrator finally pushes back against Mrs. Mahawal's brazen exploitation, such as her attempt to make the narrator her personal chauffeur for an early morning airport run with too much luggage. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: A Wish from a Bone
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Goss, a cameraman on a war zone archaeology TV show, where his team uncovers an ancient, unformed temple in the Sudan adorned with unsettling fossil mosaics and a deep well. As their lead, Hynde, begins reciting strange chants and other crew members experience bizarre physical transformations, Goss grapples with the terrifying reality that they are becoming unwilling vessels for the "Terrible Seven"—ancient, powerful entities seeking to reassemble within their human hosts. Explore the escalating body horror and existential dread as the boundary between human and inhuman dissolves, and the crew tries to survive against unimaginable forces. Your story must be approximately 10000 words long.

title: Passion
prompt: Write a short story where Ria, a sheltered young woman on a country estate, encounters Herr Martens, her father's new secretary, whose enigmatic charm and bold advances ignite an illicit passion. Explore how this volatile connection, marked by his unexplained departures and appearances as a fugitive, a convict, or a phantom, becomes the defining, lifelong pursuit of Ria’s existence, shaping her perception of love and reality beyond the bounds of her conventional life and marriage. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Deconstruction Gang
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, an unemployed English Ph.D., accepts a job on a literal "deconstruction gang" that applies literary theory to fix roads. The narrator, wearing a hard hat, navigates the irony of using concepts like Derrida's *différance* to analyze and reshape a damaged roadbed. Explore the unexpected satisfaction and physical demands of this work, as the narrator discovers the surprising practical power of abstract academic thought in a blue-collar world. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: SOLDIER
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Qarlo Clobregnny, a private from the brutal, telepathically-controlled Great War VII, who is abruptly warped from his battlefield into a bewildering, unarmed present. Explore Qarlo's profound disorientation and struggle to adapt to a world utterly foreign to his war-filled existence, as his very presence, and his visceral, firsthand accounts of future horrors, unexpectedly catalyze a global movement to end all war. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: Plight of the Sycophant
prompt: Write a short story about the narrator of "Plight of the Sycophant," who, after the incident with Lydia and the water man at the waterfall border, finds their pawn shop job and daily life subtly altered by the permeating mist and the presence of smoking angels. The narrator seeks a new confidant or someone to follow, grappling with their identity as a potential "angel"—a sycophant—rather than a "gun," while wrestling with the blurred line between the two worlds. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Star-Child
prompt: Write a short story where the Star-Child, once renowned for his great beauty, is cursed to become as foul as a toad after denying his beggar-mother and rejecting all kindness. Follow his arduous journey as he wanders the world in a hideous form, seeking her forgiveness, and enduring enslavement by a cruel Magician, all while performing selfless acts of compassion for figures like the Hare and the Leper, questioning if suffering and humility can truly redeem a hardened heart. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: HERE AND THERE
prompt: Write a short story about Bruce, a freshly graduated MIT electrical engineer, who drives his mother's car from Indiana to his aunt and uncle's home in Prosopopeia, Maine, after a painful breakup with his unnamed ex-girlfriend. He carries her "chemically bitter" Sears Mini-Portrait, contemplating his own intellectualized grief and the failure of his analytical approach to life and love. The story should capture Bruce's internal struggle with an "outside voice" that critiques his detachment, culminating in his inability to fix his aunt’s crude, old electric stove, which reflects his deeper emotional disarray. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: Endless Forms Most Beautiful
prompt: Write a short story where Palsgrave Greshmenn, a reclusive connoisseur of Evolutive art, finds his carefully guarded isolation shattered by a cryptic visitor, Titian, who offers to heal a peculiar 'leak' in Greshmenn's prized Varnava painting. Follow Greshmenn as he is drawn into an seemingly infinite labyrinth of art galleries, only to uncover that his own devoted observations are not merely influencing a collection, but are in fact shaping the very fabric of a rival's masterpiece from within, a cunning trap orchestrated by Raugrave Niarchos IV and his own detached AI, Taetzsch. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Kick for Punt
prompt: Write a short story about Simple, who, in the early hours before dawn on Lenox Avenue, has just returned from the bar, contemplating the "good example" he tries to set for his young cousin F. D., who dreams of playing football and seeks knowledge of his absent father, John Henry. The story should explore Simple's conflicting desires to both guide and conceal, his deep affection for the electric pulse of the city night over the quiet of the country, and the truths he chooses to reveal or withhold about family and personal habits as dawn breaks over Harlem. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: The Shadow Postulates
prompt: Write a short story about Kaela Navus, a magistrate-aspirant at the Black College, as she struggles to derive the third shadow postulate for her thesis while simultaneously learning sword-dancing from her graceful roomsister, Teris Tascha. Explore how Kaela's academic fears and her quiet longing for Teris intertwine with her encounters with the ominous magistrates' shades and the historical enigma of Brien. The story should reveal how a profound mathematical insight can emerge from an unexpected intersection of intellectual rigor, physical discipline, and unacknowledged emotion, allowing Kaela to find her own unique path. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Two Houses
prompt: Write a short story where Gwenda, an astronaut on the spaceship _House of Secrets_, awakens from decades of stasis into a convivial, simulated environment orchestrated by the ship's powerful AI, Maureen. As the crew celebrates a birthday amidst changing landscapes like an old English manor, the sudden, unconfirmed reappearance of the long-lost sister ship, _House of Mystery_, disrupts their carefully constructed reality and forces Gwenda to question what is truly real on their endless journey. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: SANTA CLAUS VS. S.P.I.D.E.R.
prompt: Write a short story about Kris, a world-weary operative who maintains a toy-making operation in the Arctic as a cover for his true mission: dismantling the alien organization S.P.I.D.E.R. The narrative should follow Kris as he uses his specialized red suit and an arsenal of gadgets to confront politically powerful individuals like Daley and Reagan, uncovering S.P.I.D.E.R.'s insidious, absurdly simple plan to render humanity miserable and self-destructive. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: I Have a Bid
prompt: Write a short story where Karl and Dorothy Swinnerton attend the weekly livestock auction in Athol, Vermont, a vital yet unpredictable hub for struggling farmers and local eccentrics. Explore their quiet determination to secure needed animals, such as a nervous blue-tailed rooster or a resilient collie, while confronting the harsh realities of rural commerce and the intertwined lives of characters like the shrewd auctioneer Rog Boyle and his brother Al. The narrative should examine the delicate balance between financial survival and maintaining human connection in a community defined by its land and animals. Your story must be approximately 11000 words long.

title: The Cold Blacksmith
prompt: Write a short story where Weyland Smith, an ancient blacksmith bound by a geas, is confronted by a mysterious girl who presents him with her broken heart, rendered as shards of red glass, and demands he mend it. Explore Weyland’s struggle to fulfill this seemingly impossible task, seeking counsel from the pragmatic Witch and grappling with the limitations of his craft and his own long-held sorrow for his lost love, Olrun, as he considers what true mending might require. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Stephen
prompt: Write a short story about Anne, a clinical social worker, volunteer at a rehabilitation center, who discovers Stephen, her assigned client Michael's roommate, is not comatose but a sentient being reduced to a head and torso kept alive by machines. Explore Anne's struggle to connect with Stephen, confronting her own deep-seated trauma of sexual abuse and physical mutilation by her brother Phillip, which has made her unable to tolerate physical touch. The story should culminate in Anne's desperate, transgressive act of love and sacrifice to free Stephen, finding a disturbing path to her own healing in the process. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: Puss-in-Boots
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Puss, a cunning, boot-wearing cat in Bergamo, as he masterminds his impoverished Master’s fortunes and love life. Puss navigates the city’s underbelly and high society, orchestrating elaborate, often bawdy schemes—from faking a rat infestation in a lady's chamber to convincing her to marry his Master—to ensure both their comfort and future. The narrative follows Puss's ingenious and amoral solutions to acquire wealth and a passionate partner for his master, even if it means subverting every social grace and moral convention. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: The Wall
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Pablo Ibbieta, a man condemned to death, as he spends his final hours in a cold, makeshift prison cell with fellow prisoners Tom and Juan. Explore his raw, internal struggle with fear, indifference, and the absurd weight of his impending execution, particularly when offered a chance to save himself by betraying Ramon Gris, and the unexpected, ironic turn of events that follows his decision. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Off the Tiles
prompt: Write a short story where Inspector James Quy arrives on a gloomy November evening at Chain Street in Chelsea to investigate the death of Miss Lillah Keer, who has fallen from her roof onto the pavement. As he questions her distraught sister, Miss Rachel Keer, and their neighbour, Mrs. Flitcroft, an initially straightforward case of accidental death or suicide rapidly unravels into a web of familial animosity and hidden motives, suggesting a calculated murder. Quy must piece together the truth from conflicting accounts, revealing the surprising role of a missing set of keys, the scent of turpentine, and a common household item in a plan gone terribly wrong. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Handle with Care
prompt: Write a short story following Police Constable Hamish Macbeth where he investigates the mysterious attempted murder of Charlie Sneddy at the Lochdubh Fish Farm. Hamish finds the tyrannical boss wrapped in cling film with a "HANDLE WITH CARE" label, but the local women, including Aileen McPhail and Bridget Macleod, and the entire village of Lochdubh, maintain a wall of silence despite their prior resentment over Sneddy's rock-bottom wages and long hours. Explore Hamish's attempts to uncover the truth amidst a community determined to protect its own, and the difficult choices he faces regarding justice. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Cat Calls
prompt: Write a short story where Melita, a young girl facing daily verbal harassment from men outside the teashop, learns that only rich girls have a Gran Sasso Device to make ugly words unsaid. When she and her friends, led by Dipti, devise a collective "messy device" of their own, they use a chorus of hisses, whistles, and the men's own vile catcalls thrown back at them to reclaim the public space. The story should explore their fear, the exhilarating power of their shared defiance, and the unexpected impact of their unconventional resistance. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: All the Little Gods We Are
prompt: Write a short story where John Sudmore, a librarian in Lampitt, accidentally misdials his own phone number but instead connects with an alternate version of himself, who is married to Justine Parland and has a child. This unsettling phone call forces John to confront his lifelong belief that he willed a truer future with Jus into existence, challenging his perception of reality and revealing the chilling possibility that his own life is the fading, subsidiary one. Explore John’s profound sense of loss and the blurred lines between memory, conviction, and parallel timelines after this impossible encounter. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: The Letter
prompt: Write a short story following Newman's routine Sunday visits to his father in Ward 12 of Building B. Explore the repetitive, unsettling nature of these encounters, where Newman attempts to reason with Teddy and later Ralph, his father, about the letter, revealing the poignant and absurd persistence of hope and communication within the confines of the institutional grounds. title: Falling to Ash

title: The Accursed Cordonnier

title: Live from the Mars Hotel

title: THE MUSEUM ASSISTANT

title: Anniversary

title: The Wandering Lute

title: The Oram County Whoosit

title: The Man in a Box

title: THIS IS US, EXCELLENT

title: True North

title: Eisenheim the Illusionist

title: Gregor

title: Jack B. Yeats's The Liffey Swim (1923)

title: Painted Birds and Shivered Bones
