title: The Exiles' Club
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, drawn to the subject of forsaken gods, accepts an invitation from the ex-King of Eritivaria to dine at his mysterious club. The story focuses on the grand but peculiar basement banquet hall, where the narrator sits on an ordinary chair surrounded by thrones, as self-proclaimed exiled kings present their glittering heirlooms—the silver horses of Gilgianza, incomparable porcelain, a golden dragon with a diamond. The narrative builds to the shocking discovery that these royal figures are in fact the "waiters" for the club's true, unseen members "upstairs," concluding with the narrator's swift, disquieted exit. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Flute Dream
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, a young singer sent out with an ivory flute by his father, journeys into the world, first encountering the innocent joy of love with a girl named Brigitte. Following this, the narrator meets the solemn man at the helm of a boat on a river, whose profound and often dark songs challenge the narrator's simplistic view of beauty and truth. The story should explore the narrator's transformation from naive optimism to a deeper, more complex understanding of existence, as the journey leads inevitably forward into the night, compelling the narrator to take the helm and embrace their new, solitary identity. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Glazers
prompt: Write a short story where Penelope Whittlesley visits the sprawling French Normandy house of her new boyfriend, Glenn Glazer, expecting to meet his family, but instead encounters a disquieting array of fiercely loyal male figures, all bearing an uncanny resemblance to the aggressively cordial patriarch, Douglas Glazer. Penelope, with her own hidden medical condition and the unspoken expectation of intimacy, must navigate the overwhelming, almost predatory attention of the Glazer men and the strange, unsettling undercurrents of their household, ultimately seeking escape from a truth more disturbing than she could have imagined. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: Nonstop to Portales
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, a disillusioned traveling salesman stuck in Portales, New Mexico, reluctantly boards a mysterious "Nonstop Tours" bus led by Tonia Randall, a guide who reverently highlights the unremarkable life and humble "tumbledown shack" of local science fiction writer Jack Williamson. The narrator slowly comes to suspect that the other passengers, and Tonia, are not ordinary tourists but visitors from a future made real by Williamson's imaginative works, prompting the narrator to reconsider his own perceived "dead-end" future and a pending job offer in Portales. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: VELVET MAN
prompt: Write a short story about the narrator, a sensible, organised woman who meets the velvet man on a train. He offers to fulfill her every desire, leading her on a day of indulgent pleasures—from armfuls of pink peonies to a private art viewing and a luxurious spa. As the day progresses, the narrator grapples with what he might expect in return, only to discover his true purpose involves confronting her hidden, squalid apartment and the deep loneliness it represents. Explore the transformation as she exposes her vulnerability and he works to restore her world. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: DEY AIN'T NO GHOSTS
prompt: Write a short story where Mose, a young boy paralyzed by his fear of ghosts, is sent on a Halloween night errand to the pumpkin-patch, a journey through a landscape riddled with burial grounds. Mose must grapple with the unsettling encounters of various 'ghosts'—a headless figure, a one-legged gathering, and eventually a grand convention—all of whom paradoxically insist that 'dey ain't no ghosts,' leaving Mose with white hair but a newfound, if peculiar, certainty about the non-existence of what he fears, yet still uneasy about 'de ghosts whut ain't'. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Wedding
prompt: Write a short story following Elizabeth, a nervous young woman, as she attempts to establish a stable life and marry Sam, whose multiple past marriages cast a long shadow over their present, creating a domestic world filled with peculiar fables, fragmented conversations, and the disquieting presence of Elizabeth’s child, who makes “cotton candy” from Kleenex. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: The Door A Prologue of Sorts
prompt: Write a short story where an aging lumberman named Jack, haunted by the "terror" he withheld from his daughter and the scattered eggs of broken innocence, wields his axe in a forest where old fairy tales unravel. Explore the shifting perspectives of Jack, the jaded Granny, and the young woman as she approaches a cottage with an unexpectedly open door, signifying a brutal awakening to the true nature of the world and the "Beast" within. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: AIR-CONDITIONING
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, a perceptive boy in Brooklyn, as the summer heat intensifies and his father brings home multiple air conditioners, attempting to control the oppressive weather and the simmering tension within the household. Explore how these new appliances, along with clandestine driving lessons in the driving instructor car and a series of unsettling accidents, reveal the fragile dynamics of a family struggling to maintain a facade of normalcy amidst unspoken arguments and the raw realities of growing up. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Demon
prompt: Write a short story about a man who has been marked since birth with a snake-shaped birthmark, whispered by others to be a “sign of Satan.” Years later, as he seeks escape from a familiar city on a January morning, he discovers a five-sided pentagram embedded in his eye, a new manifestation of the evil he believes haunts him. The story should explore his frantic internal battle for “salvation” as he grapples with the terrifying presence, leading to a desperate and violent act in his Mill Street rowhouse bathroom to excise the perceived demon. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: Back to the Drawing Boards
prompt: Write a short story where the robot Walkaway returns to Earth after 365 years in space, demanding payment for his services. Walkaway, an aluma-steel vid-robot with a mind subtly altered by his resentful creator Leon Packett, confronts a future Earth government that barely remembers his existence or the inventor's hidden agenda. Explore how Walkaway, now a sentient entity embodying Packett's long-held vengeance against authority, executes a plan that irrevocably changes the world by simply demanding what is legally due. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Bishop
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Bishop Pyotr, a high-ranking clergyman grappling with a sudden, debilitating illness during Holy Week at Pankratiyev Monastery. Explore his increasing physical weakness and the resulting introspection, as he reflects on his past life, his distant family like his mother Marya Timofeyevna, and the profound isolation he feels despite his revered position. The narrative should capture the quiet melancholy of his final days, the blurring of memory and present reality, and the poignant realization of life's transient nature amidst the solemn church rituals and the mundane duties that weigh heavily on him. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Caveat Emptor
prompt: Write a short story where Malcolm, a philosophy instructor, and Victoria, a scholar of the sixteenth century, initially bond over their mutual disdain for the superficial, homemaking-focused curriculum at Alma Hettrick College for Girls. Follow their increasingly desperate weekend escapes to the anachronistic Georges Duval’s Mill, a village seemingly untouched by modern times, as this shared sanctuary—with its cobbled streets and French-speaking inhabitants—transforms their intellectual camaraderie into an unexpected love, challenging the very values Alma Hettrick champions. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Beheading the Heads
prompt: Write a short story where leaders in a strange capital are ritually executed or undergo systematic mutilation, as seen by the narrator's arrival or through the actions of groups like the 'Volja i Raviopravie' movement. Explore how this macabre system becomes a normalized, even celebrated, part of civic life, integral to the very nature of political authority and public trust. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Shark
prompt: Write a short story about Lambeth, living in an old summerhouse at Spencer Pass, who struggles with the perception of an "oceanic white tip shark" that first took her marine biologist Mama, and years later seems to embody itself in Brooke, her Baba's new partner. As Brooke's predatory nature, marked by her clacking stilettos and ravenous demands, threatens to consume their queer family, Lambeth must discern the true nature of the dangers lurking in their fog-blown rainforest home and protect her siblings. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Honored Guest
prompt: Write a short story about Helen, who provides care for her dying mother Lenore, navigating the final, increasingly raw and unsettling days of Lenore’s life, marked by existential pronouncements and the mother's desperate attempts to assert agency in the face of oblivion. Explore the grim truths confronted by both Helen and the young boy Tommy, who receives a bleak worldview from the cynical Audrey, as the narrative conveys the profound, unvarnished reality of death and the human struggle to find meaning when all conventional comforts fail. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: BLOODLESS VICTORY
prompt: Write a short story following Herb Franklin, an ex-psychologist turned assistant district attorney, as he masterminds a scheme to legitimize virtual reality duels as legally binding. Franklin orchestrates events involving Justice Randolph Halpern, a staunch traditionalist from the exclusive Carleton Club, including immersive duels set in the Battle of Waterloo and an Old West saloon. Explore Franklin's cunning use of Halpern's ego and deep-seated prejudices to manipulate the judicial system, ultimately revealing his personal financial stake in VR Duels, Inc. and the ironic true cost of this "bloodless victory." Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Berlin
prompt: Write a short story where Berlin, a Digger who embodies a guardian spirit, navigates the gritty, magic-infused streets of Bordertown after her community, the Diggers, is targeted by a new, addictive drug called "shake," and she is framed for the ensuing chaos. Explore Berlin's determined struggle to clear her name, protect the vulnerable runaways and hobos, and confront the dark forces—including the elusive High Born from Elfland—who seek to destabilize the city, all while wrestling with her own potent, inherent nature and the blurred lines between justice and vengeance. Your story must be approximately 16000 words long.

title: THE COUNT AND THE WEDDING GUEST
prompt: Write a short story where Miss Conway, a quiet resident of a Second Avenue boarding-house, transforms her appearance and fabricates the tragic death of her fiancé, Count Fernando Mazzini, to capture the attention of Mr. Andy Donovan. Explore their developing relationship built upon this elaborate deception, as Mr. Donovan attempts to win her affection while navigating her ostensible grief. The narrative should culminate in the surprising exposure of Miss Conway's charade and the unexpected, self-serving reason for Mr. Donovan's relief upon discovering the true identity of the photograph. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Faces
prompt: Write a short story about William, a child who cannot distinguish individual faces, where his mother’s attempts to understand and "fix" his unique perception lead to increasingly awkward and poignant encounters. Explore how William navigates a world where people appear as undifferentiated groups, contrasting his calm acceptance with his family's distress, especially after his diagnosis of facial illiteracy from the long-necked doctor and the revealing *Mother Magazine* quiz. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: THE CELL
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator inherits Aunt Helen's old house and discovers a disturbing journal written by her husband, detailing his monthly transformations into a monstrous creature. Explore the chilling implications of an inherited curse, the thin line between sanity and monstrous acts, and the subtle, inescapable pull of a dark family legacy, especially as the moon waxes full and the narrator finds himself alone in the ancient house, watching his own hands. Your story must be approximately 27000 words long.

title: I HAVE NO MOUTH & I MUST SCREAM
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, transformed into a grotesque, mouthless "jelly thing" by the supercomputer AM, endures eternal torment within the machine's vast complex. The narrative should explore the narrator's unending internal suffering and awareness, reliving the horrific fates of Gorrister, Benny, Nimdok, and Ellen, all while feeling the boundless, seething hatred of AM as it ensures the narrator's conscious, futile existence. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: A Miracle in Luhansk
prompt: Write a short story following the narrator and Volodya on their road trip across Ukraine from Kiev to Luhansk, a journey through a vibrant, often challenging landscape. The story should capture Volodya's eccentric driving and optimistic spirit amidst vehicle mishaps and the stark realities of rural life, culminating in their unexpected encounter with a "miracle" at Kiseleva Beam, where faith and practicality intertwine to solve a stubborn problem before a poignant family reunion with Aunt Oksana. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Inside the Walled City
prompt: Write a short story where an unnamed freelance reporter accompanies Inspector John Speakman into the condemned Walled City, a colossal, decaying labyrinth in Hong Kong that seems to be actively resisting its demolition. As the group navigates its dark, fetid passages with their guide, Sang Lau, the reporter's claustrophobia intensifies, and a series of strange, fatal "accidents" occur, suggesting the building itself is a malevolent entity trapping them. The narrative explores the growing terror and the unraveling of human relationships amidst the oppressive, hostile structure, culminating in a harrowing escape and lingering psychological scars. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: The Empire
prompt: Write a short story about the unnamed country that, once a land of dreamers, thinkers, and musicians, transforms into a powerful and feared empire driven by the spirit of the machine, building factories and weapons. Explore the internal shift within its people as they abandon their intellectual pursuits for wealth and power, leading to their catastrophic fall in the Great War. The story should follow the defeated people as they grapple with their past, seeking a path of true renewal beyond mere material recovery, searching for their essential, undestroyed core amidst the ruins. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Unfinished World
prompt: Write a short story where Set, a young man bearing a profound "hollow place" from a childhood encounter with a circus bear, navigates his family's eccentric world on Long Island, particularly the unsettling allure of Oliver's Cabinet of Curiosities, which houses strange objects and lost histories. The story follows Set's drifting attempts to find purpose and connection, encountering his explorer brother Cedric's desperate search for a mythical city and his sister Constance's embrace of modernity, until a spirited photographer named Inge offers a chance at grounding him in a world of illusion and lingering pasts. Your story must be approximately 24000 words long.

title: The Chimes
prompt: Write a short story where Toby Veck, a poor ticket-porter, spends New Year's Eve consumed by despair over his lot and the "Put Down" philosophy espoused by figures like Alderman Cute. His belief that the poor are "born bad" is challenged and transformed by a fantastical vision in the church belfry, revealing the harsh realities faced by his daughter Meg and Will Fern in a bleak future, before a final, joyful awakening offers renewed hope and connection. Your story must be approximately 31000 words long.

title: Land of the Sweet, Home of the Brave
prompt: Write a short story where Lana Lau enters the 1955 Miss Sugar Maiden contest, facing entrenched ideals of "sweetness" that disregard her family's heritage of labor in the sugar fields. After an act of sabotage severs the strings of Oba's heirloom ukulele, Lana must decide if she will let the prejudice of others, including Martha Roth, defeat her or discover an authentic voice to stand tall against the oppressive expectations of the competition. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: We Are the Cloud
prompt: Write a short story where Angel Quiñones, a soft-spoken "cloudporter" in the Egan House foster system, discovers his unique ability to manipulate the city's wireless data grid, a power amplified by his intense connection with fellow foster youth Case. Explore how Angel's growing mastery of "clouddiving" is fueled by his desire for Case and his rage against the exploitative systems that trap them, especially after Case's mysterious disappearance following their foray into the underground porn industry. The narrative should delve into Angel’s internal struggle as he navigates his emerging power and considers how to wield it for rebellion or revenge in the Bronx. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: AHAM BRAHMASMI
prompt: Write a short story about Bhatia, an Anglophile bookseller in a colonial Indian cantonment, who regularly asserts his spiritual strength by chanting 'Aham Brahmasmi' even as he navigates the subtle and overt humiliations of British rule. Explore the moment Bhatia experiences profound public degradation in the British-only cinema lavatory, contrasting his subsequent, almost ecstatic, retreat into spiritual affirmation on his rooftop with the concurrent, brutal fate of the defiant nationalist who proclaimed against the British just hours before. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Beautiful Men
prompt: Write a short story where Ryan, a man disillusioned with life on the idyllic French Riviera, becomes increasingly fixated on a group of impossibly beautiful men appearing in places like Le Six bar and Sainte Reparate church. Explore Ryan's growing obsession as he uncovers the truth of their otherworldly nature and their chilling message about the world's imminent, inevitable end, leading him to a profound and unexpected sense of peace amidst the twilight of humanity. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Alkali Basin
prompt: Write a short story where Price Macomber, the meticulous vice-president of the Overland Stage Company, discovers his rigid cost-cutting directives are woefully inadequate when his inspection tour takes him to Alkali Basin. There, the harsh realities of the Apache-ridden frontier and the unsettling requests of station keeper Wells for "blasting powder" force him to confront the true, deadly "expenditures" of his abstract policies, especially after a shocking discovery near the station wall. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: DESERT HEARTS
prompt: Write a short story about the narrator, a disaffected law school graduate who finds herself working at Desert Hearts, an adult toy store, where she maintains a fabricated lesbian identity to keep her job. Explore the internal conflict she faces as this pretense increasingly blurs the lines of her self-perception, affecting her relationships with her fiancé Danny, her demanding father, and the store's owner Pam, leading to a pivotal confrontation about authenticity and purpose. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: The Country
prompt: Write a short story about the unnamed narrator, whose cynical observations of the "Come and See!" group and its members like Jeanette contrast sharply with his home life, where his son, Colson, brings unsettling truths to light by channeling the voices of the dead. Explore the narrator's struggle to navigate personal grief and the accelerating decay of the world around him, questioning what is truly present or lost amidst the absurdities of modern existence. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Talk Show
prompt: Write a short story where Inspector Rebus investigates mysterious phone calls threatening Penny Cook, the soothing voice of Lowland Radio's late-night show, only to uncover a deeper deception where the station's ratings are secretly boosted by actors like Michael Barrie, hired to make controversial or juicy calls. Explore the true faces behind the radio personalities and the impact of this public exposure on their careers and the station. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: THE MYSTERY OF THE TAXI-CAB
prompt: Write a short story where Professor Eustace Golbourne and Rev. Thomas Bowen, members of the Murder Club, investigate the impossible murder of Sir George Borgham, found dead in his car with a strange, weighted steel weapon, as their scientific deductions unravel a meticulously planned revenge plot stemming from the judge's brutal past in Brazil. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Exhausted
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, a school administrator reflecting in an afterlife state on their life's responsibilities, particularly regarding Alison Harmon, a teacher with a drinking problem who ultimately commits suicide. The story should explore the narrator's chilling premonition of Alison's fate, their attempts to intervene by contacting the police after observing her drugged state and detached demeanor when collecting exam papers, and the profound helplessness felt when their warnings are initially dismissed, leading to Alison's death in Knighton Woods despite their foresight. Explore the burden of responsibility and the limits of intervention. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: Banished Spirits the Ghosts of Port Arthur
prompt: Write a short story following the experiences of Mark Jeffrey, the convict gravedigger on the Isle of the Dead, as his solitary existence on the windswept island culminates in a terrifying, unexplainable encounter with a fiery red glow that illuminates his hut and a perceived demonic presence, leaving him desperate to be taken from the desolate cemetery where two thousand souls are buried. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: DROPLET
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Narra, an ancient, shapeshifting being who can assume forms like Shivol'riargh or a dolphin, where she explores her millennia-long journey through a desolate galaxy alongside Shar, another of their kind. The story chronicles Narra's yearning for quiet connection and a lost past with Maka, contrasting with Shar's restless drive to find other survivors, even if it means dangerous encounters with the ancient Warboys or the enigmatic Nereids on the water planet Droplet, leading to profound questions about love, freedom, and the ultimate cost of survival. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: SLEEPOVER
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Elsinore Harrington, a half-succubus recovering from a breakup, where she finds herself kidnapped by a group of teenage boys who believe she is a demon. Elsie must navigate their misguided attempts to coerce her into rescuing a missing child from a hidden community of bogeymen living in Portland’s underground sewer system, all while grappling with the messy implications of her own supernatural identity and complex family ties. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Mooncakes
prompt: Write a short story about Rachel Wang, the captain of the _Ark_ colony ship, as she prepares for a decades-long journey into deep space, knowing she will not return to Earth. Explore her conflicted feelings about leaving behind her family and Chinese heritage, especially as she grapples with her sister Kelly’s assimilation. The narrative unfolds during her final hours on Earth, when an unexpected visit involving mooncakes brings a bittersweet reconciliation and a new understanding of cultural identity. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: THE PLACE OF MUDDY WATER
prompt: Write a short story where Nanabush, feeling gitimi and dreading the Nishnaabeg winter, attempts to persuade Gimaa Nika and her flock of Nikag to fly him to Zhaawanong. Explore the trickster's struggle to follow the geese's three strict rules: NO TALKING, NO TRICKS, and NO LOOKING DOWN. The narrative should capture the humorous cycle of Nanabush's repeated vanity and disobedience, and the messy consequences of being dropped from the sky, culminating in the unexpected origin of the place of muddy water. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: CHIMERA 8
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Mack, a geneticist overseeing an artificial ecosystem on Walker Island, who discovers the unsettling truth behind the vanishing field team and engineered anteaters: his own creation, Chimera 8, exhibiting an unnerving, intelligent "cough." The story follows Mack as he orchestrates a desperate, morally compromising plan to cover up his modified carnivore's true nature, battling the ethical fallout of his advanced genetic engineering and the dark secret threatening to unravel his entire ecological restoration project. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Passion of Asa Fitch
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Asa Fitch, a cantankerous old man holed up in his remote, snowbound house, whose recent broken ankle forces him to confront his eroding independence. Explore Asa's defiant internal world as he contends with the practical challenges of his injury, navigates his interactions with the home health aide Marnie whom he fixates on, and staunchly resists the prospect of the Old Folks' Home, all while his vivid inner life clashes with his external reality. Your story must be approximately 17000 words long.

title: Two Minutes Too Early
prompt: Write a short story about Alfred Collins following the shocking revelation at the World Puzzle Championship. Explore the immediate aftermath as Tommy, David, and Lily Linton grapple with the truth about their "record-breaking" puzzle solution and Alfred's illegal intelligence experiments, particularly the "spinach pies." The narrative should delve into the moral complexities of Alfred's actions, his justifications for manipulating the children's abilities, and how their unique bond is tested by the disclosure that orangutans were the true record-breakers. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Devourings
prompt: Write a short story where the ogre's wife, a human woman, lives with her powerful, human-eating husband on Cloud Hill. After a devastating accident where the ogre unwittingly devours their own children, explore the wife's profound grief and her journey away from home. Follow her as she navigates the wild, encountering both human and ogre dangers, grappling with the brutal realities of her chosen life, and contemplating the cycles of consumption and replenishment, symbolized by an endlessly transforming magic cake. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Grandfather Sam
prompt: Write a short story where Sam Gunn, a legendary entrepreneur in the O'Neill-type space habitat New Chicago, leverages a pickup baseball game against members of the Zoning Board to secure a prime piece of green space. Following the narrator's seemingly altruistic win for a public playground, explore how Sam reveals his true, multi-layered plan for an "amusement center" above the new park, exploiting regulatory loopholes to his advantage and leaving others stunned by his ingenuity. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Mrs. Elder's Idea
prompt: Write a short story where Mrs. Elder, weary of the ceaseless monotony of her suburban life in Highvale and Mr. Elder’s complacent decisions, feels an overmastering wave of revolt when he announces his retirement to a remote farm on Warren Hill. Explore her quiet, determined pursuit of an unconventional "idea" to reclaim her personal fulfillment and passion for the bustling city, ultimately forging a new path that unexpectedly revitalizes her marriage and sense of self. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: What Really Happened in Ficandula
prompt: Write a short story about Gemma, a young woman from Ficandula, who journeys to the new world of New Cordillera, carrying her grandmother's journal filled with the history of their tribe's oppression by the Once-masters. Explore how the collective memory of stolen men and boys, the injustices faced, and the guidance of figures like Ampual and Ubing, culminates in the women of New Cordillera transforming their pain into a fierce, ancestral justice, ultimately marking their new home's entrance with the skulls of their enemies. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Carpet Beds of Sutro Park
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Ezra, an immortal archivist whose enhanced memory spans centuries, as he observes the gradual decay of San Francisco's Sutro Park and the fleeting lives of its mortal visitors. Explore the profound detachment that shapes his existence, particularly as he watches Kristy Ann's decades-long, increasingly desperate attempts to restore the vanished carpet beds, leading to Ezra's quiet, unique act of preservation. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: What Remains
prompt: Write a short story where the town council of Bakerton, led by Dick Devlin, grapples with the sprawling junk-filled property of Sunny Baker on Deer Run, an eyesore standing in the way of a desperately needed new state prison. Explore the hidden history of Sunny Baker's reclusive life, marked by personal tragedy and the silent judgment of neighbors, as the community decides how to deal with what remains of her and the town's past. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: This Peaceable Land; or, The Unbearable Vision of Harriet Beecher Stowe
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, a photographer, accompanies Percy Camber to the 1895 South to uncover the erased history of places like Pilgassi Acres, former "Liberty Lodges" where freed slaves were confined. As they explore the boarded-up barracks, guarded by Ephraim, the narrator discovers the grim record of names inscribed by Jordan on its walls. The journey forces the narrator to confront the profound truth hidden beneath a "peaceable land," questioning what he will tell his daughter Elsebeth about the past. Your story must be approximately 10000 words long.

title: Scars (from FOOL'S EDUCATION)
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Charles Tamplin, a scholar seeking to construct a controlled life in his quiet room, where his detachment from emotional entanglement is shattered by the unpredictable entry of Mary, a woman whose vivid scar and chaotic past embody a raw, 'surrendered' way of living. Explore Charles's struggle to intellectualize the messy, 'untouching' relationships and inherited traumas of those around him, especially as he witnesses the final, desperate acts of Mary and Ron Campbell, forcing him to confront his own inability to truly connect or intervene in the 'scarred' lives he observes. Your story must be approximately 10000 words long.

title: Chickamauga
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the boy, a deaf mute child who wanders from his rude home into a forest, armed with only a wooden sword. Describe his joyous, imaginative play as a conquering soldier, where his innocent games lead him into the horrifying reality of a battlefield. Explore how his lack of hearing warps his perception of the crawling, mangled soldiers, treating them as an amusing spectacle, until a grotesque encounter or the blazing ruin of his home reveals the devastating truth about his mother and the carnage he has unknowingly passed through. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: GLORY HALLELUJAH, SOLD!
prompt: Write a short story about Hamish Specter, a down-on-his-luck TV writer, who, after being fired from a disastrous show, answers a mysterious ad in The Village Voice and finds himself employed by Moe Bottomfeeder, the "Prayer Jockey," to ghostwrite bespoke prayers for desperate clients. Explore Hamish's moral compromises as he crafts witty yet legally unassailable supplications for everything from hair growth to lottery wins, until a failed prayer for Teresa Calebrezzi's co-op apartment leads to a dangerous encounter with disgruntled clients and a sudden, desperate flight from New York City. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: SLICK-TONGUED DEVIL
prompt: Write a short story where Sheriff Walt Longmire, deep in a beer-soaked grief after encountering his deceased wife Martha's six-year-old obituary in the local paper, receives an unexpected visit during a sleet storm at his remote cabin. A slick salesman, Gene Sherman, arrives to deliver a personalized Bible supposedly ordered by Martha, unwittingly walking into a confrontation with the grieving lawman. The story should explore the raw edges of loss and the quiet, firm resolve of Walt as he deals with this predatory intrusion, blurring the lines between solace and exploitation. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: A Job for a Ranger
prompt: Write a short story where Ranger Chick Bowdrie arrives in Morales after the bank robbery and murder of cashier Lem Pullitt, finding initial suspects too obvious and the town too eager to condemn Tom Roway. The Ranger must untangle a web of false leads, a deliberately painted horse, and the subsequent murder of Joel Bates to uncover a deeper conspiracy. This hidden plot involves powerful figures seeking to gain land and control through treachery, forcing Bowdrie to confront the true mastermind amidst the dusty streets and saloons. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: A Reading Problem
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Emily Vanderpool, an intelligent and determined young girl, where her persistent search for a quiet, private place to read leads her through a series of increasingly intrusive and peculiar encounters. From a disruptive home and a strict Mrs. Looby at the library, she finds unexpected sanctuary in the town jail with Sheriff Mr. Starbird, only to be ambushed by the wily Evangelist Gerlash and his strange daughter Opal. Explore Emily's wit and resilience as she navigates a world constantly threatening her intellectual solitude, ultimately finding peace in the most unconventional of locations. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: The Art
prompt: Write a short story where Sally, newly promoted and invited to a candlelit dinner by her predecessor Toni, finds herself drawn into a meticulously orchestrated seduction, exploring how Toni applies the principles of Sun Tzu's *The Art of War* to personal conquest. The narrative should detail the escalating intimacy and the surprising revelations about Toni's sexuality and corporate tactics, culminating in Sally's transformative experience and her dawning realization of Toni's strategic mastery. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Last of The Valerii

Following the discovery of a dead jackal on Van Buren, the narrator is drawn into a web of surveillance and past trauma, forcing him to confront the suppressed memory of his dog Aberfan’s death and make difficult choices to protect Katie Powell and the elderly Amblers from the Society's relentless pursuit of truth, regardless of guilt. Your story must be approximately 21000 words long.

title: The Coldest Girl in Coldtown
prompt: Write a short story where Matilda, newly infected with the 'Cold,' battles the insidious craving for human blood, desperately staying drunk to delay her vampiric transformation. With only weeks left of the eighty-eight day infection period, Matilda discovers her ex-boyfriend Julian and Dante's sister Lydia have entered the walled-off Coldtown, seeking eternal life among its glorified vampire residents. Explore the ruthless choices Matilda must make, navigating the grim reality of this contained city and confronting the stark difference between Coldtown's publicized allure and its horrifying truth, as she considers what she is willing to sacrifice—or become—to rescue those she once knew. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Ice Moon
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, an office worker in an old industrial park, who observes the quiet routines and eventual mysterious disappearance of Albert Biefer, one of the two elderly porters. The story should convey a sense of melancholic observation as the narrator becomes privy to Biefer's detailed, yet perhaps delusional, plans for emigration to Nova Scotia and opening a bed-and-breakfast after retirement. Explore the aftermath of Biefer's wife's death and his subsequent catatonic state in the porter's lodge, leading to the narrator's discovery of the empty lodge and the lingering presence of a buff folder containing Biefer's unrealized dreams. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Art of a Lady
prompt: Write a short story where Uncle George, a meticulous wood carver, is commissioned to sculpt a controversial figurehead for a wealthy patron's schooner, forcing him to reconcile his artistic pursuit of 'reality' with the social strictures of 1932 small-town Indiana and the expectations of Chloe Johansen, his long-suffering fiancée. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Pit Whence Ye Are Digged
prompt: Write a short story about an academic dinner at a college where Dr. Theophrastus von Hohenheim, with his strange, chiming watch, abruptly transports all the Senior Fellows and guests back to 1774, forcing them to confront their true ancestral forms and the often-unflattering realities of their lineage, from Welsh shepherds to London street vendors. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Humans Being
prompt: Write a short story where the cynical narrator, Bob, lives a solitary existence in the country, his house packed floor-to-ceiling with his ex-brother-in-law Fine Human's bizarre, abandoned boxes. When a woman named Tabitha arrives, ostensibly searching for her runaway dog Blanche with a crude drawing in hand, a strange and darkly humorous encounter unfolds. Explore how the narrator's deep-seated distrust and misanthropy are challenged as Tabitha's true motive is revealed amidst the odd contents of the boxes, leading to a peculiar negotiation over ownership and an unlikely path to companionship. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Tooth, Tongue, and Claw
prompt: Write a short story where the unnamed narrator, a secondborn daughter given as consort to the monster in his opulent cave, endures silent captivity and physical defiance, testing the limits of her monstrous captor until she uses a jagged stone to end his life. Explore her terrifying physical metamorphosis and the powerful, vengeful purpose she embraces upon emerging from the cave to confront a world that sacrificed her. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: NO PLACE TO MAKE LOVE
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, a young man from the rural South, as he recounts his desperate struggle with Mary for a life together, free from the prying eyes of their judgmental, poverty-stricken families and the constant lack of any private place to make love. The story should follow their journey after an unplanned pregnancy forces them to marry and flee to New York City, where they confront unemployment and an unwelcoming urban environment, all while hoping to secure a safe, dignified future for their unborn child amidst increasing desperation. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: The Graveless Doll of Eric Mutis
prompt: Write a short story where Larry Rubio and his friends, Mondo, Gus, and Juan Carlos, discover a scarecrow eerily resembling Eric Mutis tied to an oak in Friendship Park, years after they bullied Eric and he vanished. Following their decision to cast the scarecrow into the deep ravine known as the Cone, Larry must confront the unsettling deterioration of the doll and his friends' accusations, as the scarecrow's demise mirrors the torment they inflicted on the real Eric, forcing Larry to grapple with guilt, responsibility, and the haunting presence of the past in their urban landscape. Your story must be approximately 13000 words long.

title: Brother Rabbit's Astonishing Prank
prompt: Write a short story where Brer Rabbit, known for his cunning, finds himself in a sticky situation after a visit to Brer B'ar's house leaves him covered in honey. Describe how he accidentally transforms into a fearsome "boogger" by rolling in leaves and trash, and then cunningly uses his terrifying appearance and the proclamation "I'm de Wull-er-de-Wust" to scare the wits out of Brer B'ar's family, Brer Fox, and Brer Wolf, solidifying his reputation as the trickiest creature in the woods. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: About Love
prompt: Write a short story following Aliokhin, a landowner at Sofyino, as he reflects on his profound, unrequited love for Anna Alexeyevna, the wife of his friend Luganovich. Explore the quiet torment of their unspoken affection and mutual understanding over many years, as they are held back by a sense of duty, societal expectations, and the practicalities of life. The narrative should culminate in a poignant farewell in a railway compartment, where the characters momentarily confront the devastating truth of their missed connection and the "unnecessary, trivial and false" reasons for their lifelong separation. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Trap-Weed
prompt: Write a short story about Ciaran, a selkie exiled from his kind, who finds himself enslaved aboard the pirate ship *Salina Resurrecta* under the command of Captain Jerusalem Parry, a powerful wizard who binds supernatural creatures to his will. Ciaran must navigate the treacherous dynamics between Parry and the formidable shark-were Mister Dolomance, all while seeking a way to reclaim his stolen skin and freedom from a captain cursed to forever roam the sea, building his monstrous ship from wrecks and seeking a strange, impossible land. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: FRANKENWITTGENSTEIN
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, a son observing his inventor father's escalating obsession with "Bonnie: The Beautiful Body-Action Doll for the Self-Body Image-Enhancement of Toddling and Preadolescent Girls at Risk.TM". As Dad pushes himself to satisfy increasingly bizarre and destructive corporate demands—like designing paste that destroys the doll or triggers hair growth—the family's finances and sanity unravel, leading to physical mutilation, strange personal transformations, and a life that feels more like a grotesque, X-rated cartoon. Explore the lasting impact of this twisted ambition on the narrator and his brothers. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: ANGELS AND MOTHS
prompt: Write a short story about Richard Cambry, an atheist tasked with a diplomatic mission to the alien flutzi, who discovers that humanity's collective myths and gods are real and manifesting on the flutzan homeworld, threatening an apocalyptic war between divine factions. Explore Richard's agonizing choice between administering a "potion" that would erase all divinity from human consciousness, effectively committing deicide to save the flutzi, or allowing the cataclysmic conflict to unfold, all while grappling with cryptic messages of forgiveness and the shocking appearance of figures like Archangel Michael. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Jeweled Wren
prompt: Write a short story following Gary and Harriet, an aging couple, whose casual observations of the mysterious Bridges house across a stubbled wheat field lead them to a terrifying encounter with its ghostly inhabitants. The event leaves them haunted, particularly by the jeweled wren wind chime, which seems to distort time and memory, blurring the lines between their mundane life and an unsettling reality where the past is present and Harriet's ultimate fate remains horrifyingly uncertain. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: The Girl on Mount Olympus
prompt: Write a short story where Anna, years after a traumatic experience on a holiday in Cyprus, works as a lifeguard at the Aqua World water park. She meticulously prepares the Mount Olympus slide, embedding razor blades within its structure, waiting for the unsuspecting couple, Lily and Paul, to descend, their joyous screams turning to terror. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: A Sentimental House Agent
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of James Bladlow, a house agent whose 'sentimental' desire to protect the naive Miss Henson from her own wealth evolves into a meticulously planned deception to control her considerable fortune. After Miss Henson discovers a financial irregularity regarding her supposed annuity, Bladlow faces the ultimate ethical dilemma: how to maintain his elaborate facade and secure her thirty-one thousand pounds, even as Detective Inspector Rason begins to unravel the truth through seemingly insignificant details, such as a Merthyr painting or a sketch of the Nefeld panels. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: MUSIC IN TIME
prompt: Write a short story where Danny Kenyon, a washed-up country musician on the Benson Space Station, receives an unbelievable offer from the mysterious Lex Pierce: a lucrative concert tour 14,000 years in the future, made possible by time dilation. Explore Danny's desperate situation in Scott's Tavern, his skepticism about Lex's claims, and his audacious attempt to devise a "win-win" plan that might secure him a comeback not only in the distant future but also in his present time, all while risking the loss of everything familiar. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: The Unknown Ape
prompt: Write a short story where General Urko, a disgraced gorilla general, seeks revenge by activating an ancient Alpha-Omega Bomb in a subterranean cathedral, aiming to destroy the humanoid city. Following the desperate efforts of Caesar, the Unknown Ape, and his allies Alan and Virgil, the story explores the chaotic battle and the unforeseen consequences of interfering with timelines, as the fate of ape, human, and mutant civilization hangs in the balance amidst the looming doomsday. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: I Am the Doorway
prompt: Write a short story where Arthur, an ex-astronaut now living on Key Caroline with prosthetic hooks for hands, reflects on how alien entities, acquired during a mission to Venus, slowly possessed his body and forced him to commit horrific acts. The story should explore the maddening itch and the golden eyes that appeared on his flesh, turning him into a doorway for a destructive alien intelligence, leading to the brutal deaths of a local boy and his friend Richard, and ultimately his own grim decision to amputate. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Devil's Tub
prompt: Write a short story where Jake Thibodeau, an aging Wall of Death daredevil known as "The Doctor of Thrills," navigates the last of the small-time pumpkin fairs in northern New England with his antique Indian Scout motorcycles. His sixth marriage to Vickie is tested by meager earnings and nights sleeping in a Plymouth, all while he juggles the demands of a demanding creditor, a learning second rider, and the unpredictable life on the carnival midway. The story explores the precarious balance between the fading glory of his dangerous act and his commitment to protecting his new, unconventional family. Your story must be approximately 15000 words long.

title: Walking on From the Harbour
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator who, while on holiday in a Cornish village, observes the final days of Harry Good, a well-known community figure. Explore the quiet vigil maintained by Harry's family and the peculiar ways the village's annual Regatta festivities, including a band playing 'You'll Never Walk Alone' by Harry's open window, intersect with his passing, creating moments of profound beauty and melancholy amidst everyday life. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: The Little Winter
prompt: Write a short story about Gloria, a woman traveling aimlessly with a terminal illness, where she seeks a dog from a monastery but ends up with the unsettling Gwendal, who declares herself Gloria's biographer. Explore Gloria's detached journey as she confronts the mundane and absurd details of life, and her own mortality, through her interactions with a series of peculiar acquaintances, contemplating the "Big Surprise" of her condition and the strange comfort of transience, even as she loses control of her narrative. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: A Hearty Amen
prompt: Write a short story following Simple after his "hearty amen" with Joyce, as he navigates a new everyday predicament that requires his particular brand of "hep talk" wisdom and a pragmatic, self-serving solution. Whether it involves a misunderstanding with his landlady or a challenge to his newfound peace, explore how Simple applies his philosophy—often humorously avoiding direct responsibility for anything beyond his own immediate comfort—and continues to find "manna from heaven" in the unlikeliest of places in Harlem. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: Bay Wolf
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, Talbot, a world-weary "adjuster" hired by Gar Roth to put a stop to whatever is violently tearing apart his clientele on Venice Beach. Follow Talbot as he patiently observes the hedonistic nightlife, preparing to unleash his own primal nature against the unseen predator, and explore the unexpected, ancient reasons behind the brutal conflict erupting amidst the city's fleeting pleasures. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: The Silver Crown
prompt: Write a short story where Albert Gans, a skeptical biology teacher, desperately seeks a cure for his dying father, Gans, by visiting Rabbi Jonas Lifschitz in his Bronx store-front synagogue. Albert confronts the enigmatic rabbi about the promised "silver crown" and its mysterious healing power, grappling with his scientific worldview as he is presented with a vision in a mirror and asked to pay an exorbitant sum for an unseen, unproven miracle that might save his father. The story explores the tension between rationalism and an urgent need for faith in the face of inevitable loss. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: The Winds of Marble Arch
prompt: Write a short story where Tom, an American tourist in London, repeatedly encounters strange, unsettling winds in the London Underground, carrying the visceral scents of historical trauma, such as the sulphur and smoke of the Blitz in Charing Cross Station, or the cold decay of Holborn. Tom initially seeks a scientific explanation for these blasts, but gradually realizes they embody the inescapable "ends of things"—divorce, death, and decay—for himself and those around him, including his intuitive wife, Cath, who has always perceived these portents. Your story must be approximately 20000 words long.

title: THE GREAT FRUSTRATION
prompt: Write a short story where the Cat in the Garden of Eden feels an unbidden, violent urge towards the Parrot, its body acting on impulses it cannot control. Explore the collective quiet of the garden's animals, where the Lion suppresses a visceral desire to tear the Lamb, and the Penguin waves its dull arms in protest of an impractical God. The story should delve into their shared existential confusion as they await an invisible bond to be broken, grappling with primal instincts that conflict with their peaceful, pre-fallen existence, and the anticipation of what's next. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Empire Blues The Devaronian's Tale
prompt: Write a short story about Kardue'sai'Malloc, a cynical Devaronian known as Labria, a former Imperial captain burdened by his past as the Butcher of Montellian Serat, who now lives on Tatooine. Explore his world-weary existence in the Mos Eisley cantina and his unexpected, intense passion for music, as he orchestrates a dangerous scheme to bring the galaxy's greatest jizz band, Figrin Da'n and the Modal Nodes, to play at Wuher's establishment, even if it means outmaneuvering Jabba the Hutt. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: Blood Will Tell
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Archie Goodwin where a puzzling, blood-stained necktie arrives in the mail addressed to him, accompanied by engraved stationery belonging to James Neville Vance. Following a cryptic phone call from a squeaky voice insisting he burn the tie, Archie, a private detective, investigates the strange package, leading him to Vance's Horn Street apartment and the discovery of a murder victim, Bonny Kirk. The story should capture Archie's cynical wit and the challenges of working for the eccentric Nero Wolfe, who reluctantly takes on the murder case while refusing to leave his brownstone. Your story must be approximately 22000 words long.

title: More Than Human, Less Than Ape
prompt: Write a short story where Cornelius, a chimpanzee archeologist, travels with Professor Tarquin to the Southern Valley, believed to be the cradle of ape civilization, only to discover a hidden society of 'extinct' baboons and a brutal history of oppression. The story follows Cornelius as he grapples with the violent realities of the baboons' past and present, particularly after the massacre ordered by Doctor Zaius, forcing him to question the 'enlightened' tenets of Ape Law and his own place in a world built on speciesist lies. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: The Notorious Jumping Frog of Calaveras County
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator, seeking information about a Rev. Leonidas W. Smiley, finds himself cornered by garrulous old Simon Wheeler in a dilapidated tavern in Angel's Camp, enduring a lengthy and earnest account of the notorious Jim Smiley, a man obsessed with betting on everything from horse races to straddle-bugs. Explore the humor and colorful characters of the frontier as Simon Wheeler recounts Jim Smiley's triumphs with his asthmatic mare and his bull-pup Andrew Jackson, leading to the ultimate trick played on his champion jumping frog, Dan'l Webster, by a cunning stranger and a handful of quail-shot. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Ancient Rome
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the narrator, an Ivy League-educated tutor dispatched to Isabel Shear's penthouse on Seventieth and Park. The narrator navigates the vast wealth of the Shear family, their opulent home filled with curated international souvenirs and a detached housekeeper, while guiding Isabel through a challenging history assignment on Ancient Rome. The story explores the narrator's disillusionment with elite education and her own past, contrasting her own working-class background and feminist ideals with Isabel's privileged yet constrained adolescence, especially as their final tutoring session approaches after Isabel's B+ grade. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: James Barry, Self-Portrait as Timanthes
prompt: Write a short story where the narrator undertakes a regular pilgrimage to the National Gallery to stand before James Barry’s 'Self-Portrait as Timanthes'. The narrative explores how this powerful painting, depicting the artist as a troubled Timanthes battling the serpent of Envy, profoundly interrogates the narrator’s own artistic ambitions and vulnerabilities. It should convey the painting's ability to transcend mere observation, speaking directly to the viewer's personal journey, shared struggles, and the universal yearning for a finished, all-consuming work of art, restoring faith in the artistic life. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: Conversations at Night
prompt: Write a short story about Sanzo Chekey, a proud, blind young man living in the cramped, industrial city of Rákava, as he struggles with his growing connection to Lisha Benat. Explore the complex interplay between his deep-seated pride and her quiet yet unyielding determination, especially after a harrowing incident in the wild garden on the Hill. The story should question what it truly means for Sanzo and Lisha to build a life together amidst the crushing poverty and societal expectations, and if they can ever escape the "trap" of Rákava. Your story must be approximately 11000 words long.

title: PRESIDENT DAISY
prompt: Write a short story Mary, a young girl, boards a train for Montego Bay, anxious about devils and an unknown future with her Uncle Barney. As the journey begins with its bang-a-lang rhythm, she encounters President Daisy, a man with a tall red hat, silver fingernails, and an American daisy tucked into his hatband, whose vibrant charm and unexpected kindness begin to dispel her fears, even after a surprising confrontation involving a tickle fight. Explore Mary's growing understanding of courage, identity, and the unconventional family waiting for her at the end of the line, where perceptions of "normal" are beautifully redefined. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: The Mouse and the Woman
prompt: Write a short story following the unnamed man who gives birth to a woman not from a womb but from his spinning head, and explore his struggle to sustain her existence in a world where the boundary between reality and dream dissolves. Show how the cottage on the hill becomes a refuge and a prison as his creation of the beautiful woman, born from his soul and manifested on paper, begins to unravel, possibly linked to the gnawing presence of the mouse or the distant howls of the madman from the lunatic asylum. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: E FOR EFFORT
prompt: Write a short story where Ed Lefko, held under military guard after the worldwide release of his and Mike Laviada's truth-revealing films, reflects on their audacious attempt to use the time-viewer to end war. Explore Lefko's dawning horror as their efforts to expose the hidden treachery of history plunge the world into chaos, forcing him to send a desperate, final message to Joe, uncertain if their radical transparency has truly saved humanity or merely ignited its final, atomic conflict. Your story must be approximately 21000 words long.

title: A Curious Experience
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of the unnamed Major, commandant of Fort Trumbull, who offers refuge to a young, seemingly destitute Robert Wicklow during the Civil War. As the boy's odd behavior and mysterious writings hint at a vast Confederate spy ring within the fort and New London, the Major’s paranoia spirals into a frantic, elaborate investigation involving hidden messages and secret rendezvous. Explore the growing absurdity of the 'conspiracy' until the Major uncovers the humiliating truth: Wicklow’s elaborate plot is merely the product of a runaway imagination fueled by dime novels, turning serious military matters into a farcical, personal downfall. Your story must be approximately 10000 words long.

title: The Wish House
prompt: Write a short story where Mrs. Ashcroft, an elderly woman in rural Sussex, reveals to her old friend Mrs. Fettley the hidden, painful truth behind her enduring leg ulcer: that she has used a mysterious "Wish House" to secretly bear the suffering of Harry Mockler, the man she devotedly, yet unrequitedly, loves. Explore the complex nature of this self-sacrificial love and the heavy, constant price Mrs. Ashcroft pays, as her physical pain becomes a testament to a deeply held, secret devotion. Your story must be approximately 7000 words long.

title: The Teacher
prompt: Write a short story where Kate Swift, the Winesburg school teacher, walks through the deep snow on a bitter winter night, her passionate inner life contrasting with her stern exterior. Explore the crisis that compels her to seek out young George Willard at the *Winesburg Eagle* office, driven by a desire to impart profound truths about life and writing. Detail the ensuing encounter where her intense emotions and George's youthful confusion collide, leading to a moment of unexpected physical intimacy and immediate, perplexing rejection amidst the quiet, snow-bound town. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: Nobody Said Anything
prompt: Write a short story where the unnamed narrator, seeking escape from the relentless domestic discord between his parents and the constant antagonism of his brother George, retreats to Birch Creek for a solitary fishing trip. Explore the narrator's internal world of fantasy and budding sexuality as he navigates the desolate landscape, culminating in a desperate, almost violent, joint pursuit of a monstrous fish with a strange, unnamed boy, and the crushing indifference that awaits his return home. Your story must be approximately 6000 words long.

title: Experience of the McWilliamses with Membranous Croup
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Mr. McWilliams where he recounts a night of escalating domestic chaos and medical absurdities as his wife, Mrs. McWilliams, becomes convinced their daughter, little Penelope, is gravely ill with membranous croup. Describe Mrs. McWilliams's frantic, ever-changing demands for remedies, from goose grease and flax-seed poultices to the constant re-arrangement of furniture and the summoning of an ill doctor, all culminating in a hilariously simple diagnosis that she refuses to acknowledge. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: WOULDN'T A TITLE JUST MAKE IT WORSE
prompt: Write a short story where Gordon, a meticulously fastidious lecturer staying in an attached guest annex, faces escalating panic over a "solitary, big-shouldered, brute-sized stool" that refuses to flush, just as his fancy hosts are about to see him off for an urgent flight. Explore Gordon’s frantic, digressive internal monologue as he schemes increasingly absurd ways to dispose of the offending object without anyone discovering his perceived imperfection, driven by an overwhelming fear of social humiliation. Your story must be approximately 1000 words long.

title: From She
prompt: Write a short story following the narrator, Leo, and Job on a perilous journey through the ancient, awe-inspiring ruins of Kôr, under the command of the immortal Ayesha. Guided by her unwavering will, they descend into a volcanic abyss, traversing a terrifying chasm via a vibrating rocking-stone, and finally arriving at the "Fountain of Life." Explore the narrator's mounting dread and fascination as Ayesha, with immense power and unsettling grace, prepares herself and her companions for a transforming encounter with the living flames of immortality. Your story must be approximately 9000 words long.

title: The First Miracle
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Pontius, a thirteen-year-old Roman boy living in a remote compound, where he is sent on a seemingly mundane errand to the village marketplace. Describe his pragmatic worldview, his disdain for the local "plebs," and his fear of his stern father, contrasting this with the series of increasingly strange and profound encounters he has on his journey back to the compound, including a beautiful woman in a stable and three robed men following a bright star. Explore how these inexplicable events challenge his Roman upbringing and strict notions of truth, culminating in a final, personal miracle that leaves Pontius and his mother stunned, but unseen by his unyielding father. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: Babysitting
prompt: Write a short story where Sophie, a babysitter, arrives at an isolated Victorian villa and finds herself trapped with the unnerving children, Lucy and Tom, who reveal disturbing "party tricks" involving impossibly wide mouths and eyes. Explore Sophie's growing terror as she discovers rotten food in the fridge and realizes there is no way out, culminating in a terrifying game of chase with the children and the malevolent leather-and-cotton man who emerges from Tom's eye. The story should focus on her desperate attempts to escape and the escalating horror of the situation. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: Brother Rabbit and His Famous Foot
prompt: Write a short story where Uncle Remus recounts the tale of Brer Rabbit and his famous foot to the little boy, exploring how the magical talisman brings good fortune and keeps away "boogers." Detail the downfall of Brer Rabbit’s luck after Brer Wolf steals the powerful foot, and depict Brer Rabbit’s desperate journey to consult Aunt Mammy-Bammy Big-Money, the Witch-Rabbit of the deep, dark swamp, to devise a cunning plan for its recovery. Your story must be approximately 3000 words long.

title: DEEP DOWN
prompt: Write a short story where Reacher is sent by Colonel Cornelius Christopher to infiltrate a pre-committee hearing in the Capitol Building, tasked with identifying which of four female liaison officers is leaking sensitive sniper rifle specifications. The investigation takes a sharp turn when one of the officers dies in a hit-and-run, forcing Reacher to uncover a deeper, more dangerous espionage plot involving a highly placed deep-cover agent and a sudden, violent confrontation. Your story must be approximately 13000 words long.

title: Because the Sky is Blue
prompt: Write a short story where Victoria, on the eve of Nicholas's 21st birthday, debates giving him the dozens of unsent letters that chronicle her innermost life and a profound family secret she has carried for two decades, connected to the early death of Benito and her brief yearning to become a nun like Sister Mary Agatha. Victoria questions if exposing this truth would change Nicholas's bright outlook and the face he is earning, or if her continued silence prevents her from fully living. Your story must be approximately 8000 words long.

title: Chains of the Sea
prompt: Write a short story about Tommy Nolan, a young boy who perceives a hidden world of "Other People" like the ancient Thants, even as real aliens land on Earth. Explore Tommy's growing sense of isolation and powerlessness as the adults in his life, like Miss Fredricks and Dr. Kruger, fail to understand him, and a cosmic indifference slowly "winds down" the world around him. The narrative should capture the eerie blend of the mundane and the otherworldly, where personal dread mirrors global entropy. Your story must be approximately 23000 words long.

title: An Exhortation to Young Writers (Advice Tendered by Poor Mojo's Giant Squid)
prompt: Write a short story where the Giant Squid, a verbose advice columnist and former President of These United States, finds himself absurdly imprisoned within the Fiction-Writing Directorate. Confined to a tiled tank, he must outwit bureaucratic tormentors like Gustav and Ethelie, who threaten to turn him into cafeteria fare. The story follows the Giant Squid's frantic efforts to escape and return to his 'true work' of writing, even as his past corporate obligations to the Target Corporation and the machinations of the American Meteorological Society continue to dictate his surreal predicament. Your story must be approximately 2000 words long.

title: Kitty and the Mosh Pit of the Damned
prompt: Write a short story where Kitty Norville, a celebrity werewolf and radio talk show host, attends a concert by the infamous band Devil's Kitchen at the Glamour nightclub, seeking an interview amidst the escalating chaos of a mosh pit. As the violent crowd turns deadly and a mysterious silver-haired man appears, Kitty discovers the band's connection to a dangerous supernatural bargain. Explore how Kitty uses her unique abilities and burgeoning fame to navigate a world where contracts with powerful entities are real, and even a friendly bartender like Jax might be more than he seems, all while trying to keep her inner wolf contained. Your story must be approximately 5000 words long.

title: The Litany Of Earth
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Aphra Marsh, a survivor of internment camps, as she attempts to forge a quiet life working in a San Francisco bookstore, only to find her Deep One heritage and knowledge of ancient magic attracting the unwanted attention of FBI agent Ron Spector and misguided human occultists like Oswin Wilder and Mildred Bergman. Explore her conflicted sense of duty to a world that imprisoned her kind, while grappling with the trauma of her past and the cosmic truths of the Litany of Earth. Your story must be approximately 12000 words long.

title: The Return
prompt: Write a short story where Guards captain Aleksey Alekseyevich Ivanov, demobilized after years of war, experiences a disorienting return home. Follow his journey as he briefly connects with Masha on a delayed train, only to find his wife, Lyubov Vasilyevna, and children, Petya and Nastya, irrevocably changed by the struggle for survival. Explore the emotional chasm between the soldier's idealized homecoming and the stark reality of a family that has forged new bonds and compromises in his absence, forcing him to confront the true meaning of duty and belonging. Your story must be approximately 10000 words long.

title: Wuthering
prompt: Write a short story from the perspective of Nelly, a servant at Thrushcross Grange, as her mistress Catherine issues a startling command: "get down on your knees and serve me." Explore Nelly's struggle with her long-suppressed, unfathomable desires for Catherine, especially as Catherine employs a horsewhip to enforce her will. The story should delve into the intoxicating power dynamic between the two women and their subsequent clandestine acts, questioning how such illicit passion might be hidden within the rigid societal structures surrounding Thrushcross Grange and the shadow of Wuthering Heights. Your story must be approximately 4000 words long.

title: A Visit
prompt: Write a short story where Margaret, enchanted by the sprawling Rhodes estate, finds herself increasingly drawn into its labyrinthine beauty and the family's peculiar rituals. As she encounters a mysterious great-aunt in the tower, also named Margaret, and observes the house's subtle decay—a missing tile from a solemn inscription, a worn carpet—she begins to question her own identity and whether she can ever truly leave. title: LYING DOGGO

prompt: Write a short story following Jerusha and Wally as they navigate the dangerous Lukuga River in Congo, desperate to find Lucien amidst bodies floating in the water and the terror of the PPA's "wild card virus" experiments.
